jobs.title: Data engineer - Careium
jobs.description: Careium is looking for a Data Engineer to help us shape and build a modern data and delivery platform from the ground up. If you have a strong drive to do things properly and take ownership of your work, then this is the job for you.About CareiumCareium delivers solutions within personal safety and connected care. We have a global presence but work with a strong local feel, and right now we are in a phase where there is real work to be done - automation, data infrastructure, and smarter ways of building and shipping software are all on the table.About the RoleAs a Data Engineer in the platform team, you will be the driving force behind our data infrastructure. You will work closely with both software developers and the wider organization to ensure that our data is accessible, reliable, and structured for the future.Day to day you will be working with things like:    Implementing and expanding our central data lake and data warehouse, building upon the completed initial design and its main components.    Setting up and maintaining robust ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest data from various internal and external sources.    Continuing the groundwork of our event-driven platform enabling real-time alarm data and user activity.    Moving existing data integrations and legacy data streams onto the new modern platform.    Getting data documentation, a data catalogue, and data governance frameworks in place.    Collaborating with DevOps colleagues in the team to automate data infrastructure deployments and monitoring.    Coaching developers and analysts in data engineering best practices and efficient querying.Who We Are Looking ForYou should have solid hands-on experience from a Data Engineering role and a genuine interest in cloud architecture, data modeling, and streaming data. Since you will be part of a platform team, a DevOps mindset regarding automation, containerization, and infrastructure as code is a big plus.It helps if you have worked with tools like:    Python, Bash, Ansible, Terraform, or equivalent.    AWS, or other cloud providers.    Docker, Kubernetes, or equivalent.    Streaming and event-hub technologies like Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS Kinesis.    Data transformation and orchestration tools (dbt, Apache Airflow, or similar) as well as modern data warehousing.Just as important as the technical side, you communicate well, you are easy to work with, and you bring a calm, structured approach when things get complicated. You follow through on what you commit to, and you are not afraid to flag when something is not working.Practical InformationLocation: Malmö Scope: Full-time Work model: Hybrid, as agreed Employment type: 6-month assignment through A-hub. The recruitment process is managed by A-hub. Questions about the role are answered by the recruiter responsible.

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description: **About the Role**We are looking for a **Financial Controller** to join our finance team in Tampere. This is a full-time, permanent position.In this role, you will be at the center of our revenue, fixed asset and working capital processes, working closely with our local Financial Manager, our global accounting team and both local and global colleagues across Sales, Supply Chain and Procurement.With us you will learn, develop, and grow right alongside a fast-moving global company working in an interesting field.**Location:** Tampere, onsite**Key responsibilities**- Coordinate sales invoicing and accounts receivable. Making sure invoices are accurate, follow up on payment terms and advance payments, and support collections. - Ensure correct revenue recognition and cut-off, reconcile sales revenue, and prepare sales-related accruals and provisions. - Maintain the fixed asset register for tangible and intangible assets, including additions, disposals, write-offs, transfers and depreciation plans. - Work with the Financial Manager on capitalization decisions, assets under construction, capitalized development costs and impairment testing. - Monitor capital expenditure against budget and run physical fixed asset counts and controls. - Prepare financial reporting, payment claims and audit documentation for publicly funded projects, including cost eligibility checks and personnel cost calculations, together with project managers and auditors. - Monitor and report on net working capital, especially inventory, together with Sales, Supply Chain and Procurement. Spot improvement opportunities and escalate them where needed. - Support the purchase process by developing the process flow, monitoring payments and maintaining the purchase approval tool. - Contribute to month-end and year-end closing, including reconciliations, and support our global accounting team. **What we require**To succeed in this role, you should have:- A degree in accounting, finance or business administration. - Around 3–5 years of hands-on accounting experience, including month-end and year-end closing. - Solid knowledge of Finnish accounting standards (FAS). Familiarity with IFRS, especially revenue recognition, fixed assets and impairment. - Experience with accounts receivable, revenue cut-off, accruals and reconciliations. - Understanding of fixed asset accounting, including capitalization, depreciation and assets under construction. - Experience with ERP systems (Microsoft Dynamics Business Central is an advantage). - An analytical, accurate and well-organized approach, with the ability to handle several deadlines at once. - Good communication and cooperation skills for working with Sales, Supply Chain, Procurement, managers and auditors. - Fluent English and Finnish language skills. **What we see as a plus**- Experience in international / multi-entity structures **What We Offer****Paid Time Off**You are entitled to an annual holiday 4 + 1 weeks from the start **Health & Wellness Package**- Lunch Benefit: daily lunch allowance up to the tax-free limit as a fringe benefit. - Sport & Culture: annual budget for gyms, sports activities, cultural events, and hobbies. - Wellbeing Allowance: additional allowance for massage and other wellness support. - Extended Occupational Healthcare: enhanced coverage including partial dental care. - Accident Insurance (24/7): full coverage for accidents during both work and free time. - Business Travel Insurance: coverage for work-related travel. - Snacks & Office Comforts: coffee, snacks, fruits and other office perks. **Work Model**- Flexible Working Hours: core hours from 10:00 to 15:00. - No-Crunch Policy: no systematic overtime; overtime is compensated or reimbursed. - Meeting-Light Culture: protected focus time and minimal unnecessary meetings. **Growth & Innovation**- High-End Equipment: premium laptop, monitor, and peripherals. **Travel & Mobility**- Business Travel Expenses: full coverage of tickets, accommodation, and transportation. - Per Diem (Vero Max): daily allowances according to the maximum tax-free Vero rates. **Impact & Culture**- Low-hierarchy, engineering-driven environment with strong autonomy and zero micromanagement. **Culture Statement**Don't meet every requirement? Research shows that many candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet every qualification. At Sine Engineering, we value authenticity and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't perfectly match every listed requirement. You might be the ideal candidate for this role- or for another opportunity with us.Join our dynamic team and play a key role in shaping the future of UAV technology.**Some questions?**If there is something in your mind, you can send your question to careers\_finland@sineeng.com. Please note that we don't accept applications via email.

jobs.title: Hair Transplant Technician
jobs.description: About the jobWe are looking for a hair transplant technician to join us at ZARC Hair Clinic in Malmö. This role combines meticulous, hands-on work with close contact with people. You will contribute to the treatment itself while helping each client feel safe, comfortable and well cared for.We believe you have an eye for detail, enjoy working in a team and bring a warm, welcoming approach. At our clinic, quality and care go hand in hand—from the first meeting to follow-up.About the roleAs a technician, you will take part in our hair transplant procedures and help ensure a positive experience for each client. Your responsibilities include preparing the client and treatment room, sorting, assessing and separating grafts during the procedure, and keeping the client comfortable and reassured throughout their treatment.During a hair transplant, hair follicles are moved from a donor area, usually at the back of the head, to areas where the client would like greater hair density, such as the temples or crown. The follicles are extracted and then implanted into the recipient area. The procedure is performed under local anaesthesia and typically takes 3–6 hours.The work requires attention to detail, excellent fine motor skills and the ability to stay focused for extended periods. You should enjoy practical, precise work and close teamwork. A calm, attentive manner, good hygiene practices and care for the client throughout the procedure are equally important.The role is based at our clinic in Varvsstaden, Malmö.About youYou have at least eight years of experience in hair transplantation. You are confident in the different stages of the procedure and enjoy precise work that requires fine motor skills, patience and concentration.You are meticulous, organised and responsible, with a desire to continue developing your skills with us. Ideally, you are looking for a long-term role where you can contribute both your expertise and your commitment.Above all, you have a warm and attentive approach. You take the time to listen, put people at ease and go the extra mile to make our clients feel well cared for.About ZARC Hair ClinicZARC Hair Clinic provides hair transplants and PRP treatments in Varvsstaden, Malmö. We are a dedicated team that values close collaboration, attention to detail and a warm, welcoming approach. Quality and care shape both how we look after our clients and how we work together. We aim to build a workplace where everyone feels involved, takes responsibility and has the opportunity to grow with the clinic.We look forward to meeting you!

Vi söker:Arbete hos oss ställer höga krav på flexibilitet, kommunikation och god samarbetsförmåga. Personlig matchning är högt prioriterat. Vi söker dig som är anpassningsbar, har ett lågaffektivt bemötande och god förmåga att hantera stress.För att trivas i rollen som behandlingspedagog hos oss tror vi att du är kommunikativ, lyhörd och relationsskapande med en välförankrad trygghet i dig själv. Du bör vara praktiska lagd och lösningsfokuserad samt vid behov kan sätta lämpliga gränser för att skapa tydlighet och trygghet - men även kunna vägleda klienter i att själva också göra detta. Du bör tycka om att arbeta självständigt och ha ett stort egenansvar i ditt dagliga arbete, men med tät samverkan med övrig arbetsgrupp. Att ha ett strukturerat arbetssätt och klara av att göra prioriteringsbedömningar är av stor vikt. Att vara flexibel är en viktig del av arbetet då vi arbetar med myndigheter och med människor där det finns snabbt växlande behov. KvalifikationerDet är mycket positivt om du har dokumenterad utbildning och erfarenhet inom arbetsområdena våld i nära relation, hedersrelaterat våld och att arbeta med personer i kris. Vidare är det en stor fördel om du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn som har bevittnat/varit utsatta för våld. Även utbildning i TMO, MI, FREDA, SARA, Trappansamtal och PATRIARK samt språkkunskaper (utöver svenska och engelska) är meriterande. Minst 2 års eftergymnasial utbildning inom socialt, omsorg eller hälsoarbete Kännedom om BBIC och SOL God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska samt datorvana, B-körkort samt godkänt utdrag från polisens misstanke- och belastningsregister Utbildning inom Patriark/Sara, MI, Trappansamtal, empowerment eller TMO är meriterande. Stor vikt läggs vid personliga egenskaper.Tjänsten innebär 5 pass i veckan med flexibla arbetstider. Du kommer att vara delaktig i din schemaläggning men behöver kunna arbeta både dag- och kvällstid, samt vissa helger vid behov. Det kan även bli aktuellt med personal även på 50-75 % tjänst samt timanställda/vid behov så skicka gärna in CV även om du ej kan arbeta 100%. Intervjuer kommer ske fortlöpande då vi önskar en snar tillsättning med rätt person som vi hoppas kommer bli del i ett fantastiskt team. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan! Övrigt: Utifrån tidsaspekten kommer vi endast kontakta dem vi önskar kalla till intervju via telefon eller mail, där man då ges mer information och kan ställa ytterligare frågor om verksamheten samt tjänsten innan en digital intervju bokas. Personligt möte kommer vara del i rekryteringsprocessen och utdrag ur misstanke- och belastningsregister kommer då begäras. Eftersom verksamheten är skyddad kan vi inte uppge exakt vart våra boenden är belägna. Det är därför viktigt att du uppger vart du bor för att bedöma rimlig restid till arbete.

jobs.title: Regional Vice President, Sales Benelux & Nordics
jobs.description:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the role

We're hiring a Regional Vice President in EMEA to own and lead our Benelux and Nordics business. You'll inherit a team of four quota-carrying enterprise AEs across two hubs: Amsterdam and Stockholm and be responsible for building the management layer, operating model and partner ecosystem that takes both the Benelux and Nordics regions from early traction to consistent, scaled revenue.

This is a Director-level hire with second-line ambition. You'll report directly to the VP EMEA and operate with meaningful autonomy across pipeline, hiring, partner relationships and executive engagement.

 

What you'll own

Team leadership and performance

  • Lead, develop and expand the Enterprise Sales teams across Benelux and Nordics from day one

  • Run weekly pipeline reviews, deal coaching sessions and forecast calls with precision and consistency

  • Identify and close performance gaps early: coach the team to close larger deals faster and navigate complex, multi-stakeholder cycles

  • Build a culture of accountability and development; create clear career paths for senior individual contributors, including first-line management opportunities as the team scales

Revenue

  • Own the Benelux and Nordics regional number: quarterly and annual quota attainment across all two sub-regions

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline that supports consistent delivery and predictable forecasting to VP EMEA and leadership

  • Engage directly in strategic deals as executive sponsor, bringing credibility and commercial weight to enterprise negotiations

  • Establish the region's strongest lighthouse accounts across key industry verticals, building referenceable wins that anchor LangChain's market position in the Benelux and Nordics regions

Hiring

  • Manage multiple open roles across Benelux and Nordics simultaneously: owning the full hiring lifecycle across pipeline, assessment, and closing

  • Partner with the retained search firm and internal talent team to move at pace without compromising on quality

  • Define the headcount profile for Benelux and Nordics regions beyond Q1 and feed into H2 planning, ensuring the team is built ahead of the revenue curve

Partner ecosystem

  • Owns hyperscaler and GSI/RSI relationships (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, and key SIs) across UKI, Nordics and Benelux

  • Develop a structured partner motion that generates qualified pipeline and supports deal acceleration, reduces risk and drives expansion

  • Represent LangChain at partner QBRs and executive engagements in region

Market presence

  • Represent LangChain as a keynote-ready leader at partner events, customer engagements, and industry conferences across the region: including KubeCon, Money20/20, Nordic AI summits and customer EBCs

  • Build LangChain's brand with technical buyers, CIOs, and innovation leaders across Benelux and Nordics most important enterprise accounts

  • Bring intelligence on the Benelux and Nordics markets back to the VP EMEA and product teams to inform roadmap and go-to-market positioning

 

What we're looking for

Experience

  • 8+ years in enterprise SaaS sales, with at least 3 years in a regional or sub-regional leadership role managing quota-carrying AEs

  • Demonstrable track record of hitting and exceeding regional revenue targets across multiple quarters

  • Experience managing teams across multiple countries and time zones, with the cultural intelligence to operate across Benelux and Nordics

  • Background selling to technical buyers (engineering leaders, CTOs, platform teams): you understand how developer tools get evaluated and adopted

  • Experience in the AI, data, or developer tooling space strongly preferred; familiarity with the LangChain ecosystem is a meaningful plus

Leadership

  • You've run teams of 6+ AEs before and know the difference between managing and coaching

  • You can hold a forecast conversation with a VP and a deal coaching session with an AE in the same afternoon and add value in both

  • You hire well and fast. You know what good looks like for enterprise AE profiles and you can run structured hiring processes across four open roles simultaneously

  • You've built or contributed to a partner motion before: you understand what "partner pipeline" means in practice, not just in theory

Operating style

  • You bias toward action. You don't wait for a playbook to be handed to you: you build it

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage scale. This is not a role with a fully defined motion; you'll shape a significant part of it

  • You communicate clearly and directly, to your team and to leadership

  • You're present in the market. You attend the right events, know the right people and build relationships that translate into pipeline and retention

     

Compensation Philosophy:

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer .NET / Azure
jobs.description:
About the Company

S4D is a Software as Service (SaaS) company that provides Quick Service Restaurants (QSRs) with the omnichannel operating system to run their business in the most effective and efficient way. In other words, we help restaurants to get more orders. Our team builds and services innovative products based on the newest technologies, consisting of a wide variety of functionalities and innovative modules while offering our employees flexible working conditions. Our key values are teamwork and ownership. S4D is part of the Deloitte Technology Fast 50 and Saas100 company (selected by MT/Sprout).

About the role

We are looking for a Senior .NET Backend Developer who combines strong system design skills with a passion for engineering excellence. In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of core backend services - driving solutions from initial architecture through deployment and production across our cloud platforms. 

Beyond shipping high-quality code, you will play a key role in raising the engineering bar across the team. You’ll mentor mid-level and junior developers, establish best practices around testability and clean architecture, and foster a collaborative environment. We also encourage our engineers to utilize modern AI developer tools (like Cursor, Claude code) to accelerate daily workflows and problem-solving.

No unsolicited services from recruitment agencies.


Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: Own backend services across their full lifecycle—from initial architectural design and technical scoping to coding, deployment, and operational health.

  • Mentorship & Team Leadership: Coach and mentor junior and mid-level developers, conduct constructive code reviews, and help elevate engineering standards across the team.

  • System Design & Architecture: Help define architectural patterns, design scalable microservices, and ensure our event-driven integration flows are resilient and decoupled.

  • Hands-on Service Development: Write clean, modular, and maintainable C# code targeting modern .NET Core runtimes.

  • Messaging & Workflows: Build robust asynchronous integrations using Azure Service Bus and MassTransit.

  • Quality & Performance: Champion automated unit testing, continuous integration, and proactive performance profiling.

  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Utilize AI coding tools to boost daily productivity and streamline system troubleshooting.

What You Bring (Mandatory) 

  • 5+ years of hands-on backend software engineering experience with C# and .NET Core.

  • Mentorship Experience: A proven track record of guiding junior/mid-level engineers, sharing knowledge, and fostering best practices (TDD, clean code, peer reviews).

  • End-to-End Feature Ownership: Demonstrated experience designing and delivering backend features from initial idea to production deployment.

  • Event-Driven Mastery: Solid understanding of microservices patterns and event-driven messaging (Azure Service Bus, MassTransit, RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc.).

  • Azure Cloud Experience: Practical experience working with core Microsoft Azure infrastructure and cloud components.

  • Testing Mindset: Deep appreciation for testable architecture and unit testing best practices.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration.

  • Knowledge of SQL Server relational database design and optimization.

  • Familiarity with modern CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows (Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions).

  • Hands-on experience with MassTransit specifically.

  • Experience with legacy system migration (.NET Framework to modern .NET).

  • Familiarity with developer AI tooling (e.g., Cursor, Claude code).

This is a Hybrid working model meaning you need to be at our office in Amsterdam 2-3 times a week.

jobs.description:
La société CSM-AD du groupe NADIA, basée à Mions (69780), conçoit, fabrique et installe des équipements de signalisation routière et autoroutière, des remorques spécifiques et du mobilier urbain.

Nous recherchons un profil commercial à forte dominante technique, capable de comprendre les contraintes opérationnelles de ses clients et de leur proposer des solutions adaptées.

Vos missions :

En tant que Technico-Commercial itinérant, vous aurez pour mission d’assurer la promotion des produits des marques CSM-AD - Nadia Signalisation et d’établir un plan de prospection pour les clients exploitants :

Les autoroutes et ouvrages à péages, les DIR routes nationales, les voies rapides urbaines des Métropoles et les Départements, les Aéroports, les Travaux Publics spécialisés et société de pose intervenants pour ces mêmes catégories.

Sur les secteurs géographiques suivant :

  • Région Hauts-de-France: Départements : Aisne (02), Nord (59), Oise (60), Pas-de-Calais (62), Somme (80).

  • Région Normandie :Départements : Calvados (14), Eure (27), Manche (50), Orne (61), Seine-Maritime (76).

  • Région Île-de-France: Départements : Paris (75), Seine-et-Marne (77), Yvelines (78), Essonne (91), Hauts-de-Seine (92), Seine-Saint-Denis (93), Val-de-Marne (94), Val-d’Oise (95).

  • Région Grand Est: Départements : Ardennes (08), Aube (10), Marne (51), Haute-Marne (52), Meurthe-et-Moselle (54), Meuse (55), Moselle (57), Bas-Rhin (67), Haut-Rhin (68), Vosges (88).

En contact permanent avec vos clients vous serez chargé de :

  • Animer, développer et fidéliser le portefeuille client.

  • Etablir un plan de prospection sur le secteur géographique défini.

  • Argumenter les ventes afin de faire connaitre les produits et services de l’entreprise.

  • Déterminer les besoins des clients/prospects et les conseiller au niveau technique et commercial (produits et services, règlementation, tarifs, délais…).

  • Négocier les conditions tarifaires en respectant la politique commerciale.

  • Conseiller et former les clients sur l’utilisation des produits de l’entreprise et assurer leur suivi en lien avec le service client.

  • Assurer le suivi des affaires de fourniture et pose des matériels, faire le lien entre le client et les différents services de l’entreprise et les éventuels partenaires installateurs.

Profil recherché :

Vous êtes issu d’un niveau BTS Technico-commercial ou similaire.

De formation BTS Technico-commercial ou équivalent, vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans une fonction commerciale à dominante technique.

Vous avez idéalement évolué dans l'univers de la signalisation, des métiers de la route, des travaux publics (conduite de chantier), des matériels roulants, des engins de viabilité hivernale, des espaces verts ou du secteur agricole.

Une appétence pour les sujets liés à l'électromécanique, l'électrotechnique ou l'électronique sera un véritable atout.

Doté d'un bon relationnel, vous êtes reconnu pour votre dynamisme, votre autonomie, votre rigueur et votre sens commercial.

Ce poste nécessite une forte mobilité, avec des déplacements fréquents sur l'ensemble du secteur, principalement du mardi au jeudi, et des nuitées à prévoir.

Vous résidez sur le secteur indiqué.

Vous résidez idéalement sur le secteur concerné et êtes autonome dans l'organisation de votre activité.

L’éloignement géographique implique une autonomie naturelle dans l’organisation de travail avec un déplacement sur site CSM-AD, 1 à 2 fois par trimestre.

Informations complémentaires :

CDI dont période d’essai de 4+2 mois.

Pack commercial : véhicule de fonction, téléphone et ordinateur portable

Home office avec au minimum 4 jours sur 5 en clientèle

Déplacements fréquents sur l'ensemble du secteur, principalement du mardi au jeudi, avec nuitées à prévoir

Rémunération à définir selon profil et expérience

Prêt(e) à relever le défi ? Faites rayonner des produits innovants, performants et esthétiques sur un secteur à fort potentiel.

Vi søger en erfaren og passioneret Head Chef, som kan lede vores køkkenteam og have det overordnede ansvar for alle køkkenets kulinariske aktiviteter med særligt fokus på autentiske vietnamesiske specialiteter.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

·       Planlægge, lede og føre tilsyn med alle forberedelses- og madlavningsaktiviteter.

·       Udvikle og vedligeholde autentiske vietnamesiske menuer samt sæsonbaserede specialiteter.

·       Sikre høje standarder for hygiejne, fødevaresikkerhed og rengøring.

·       Opretholde høje standarder for madens kvalitet, præsentation og ensartethed.

Kvalifikationer

·       Obligatorisk: Fremragende kulinariske kompetencer samt dokumenteret professionel erfaring med tilberedning af autentiske vietnamesiske specialiteter.

·       Solidt kendskab til traditionelle vietnamesiske urter, krydderier, smagsprofiler og madlavningsteknikker.

·       Tidligere erfaring fra etablerede vietnamesiske restauranter eller asiatiske restauranter med høj aktivitet.

Vi tilbyder

·       En fuldtidsstilling på 37 timer om ugen under almindelige danske arbejdsforhold.

·       En løn, der fuldt ud overholder kravene i den supplerede beløbsordning.

·       Et professionelt og støttende arbejdsmiljø.

jobs.title: Two PhD Students in Atmospheric science
jobs.description: Are you ready to take the next step in your academic journey? As a doctoral student with us, you will work closely with leading researchers in a strong, international research environment, with access to advanced laboratory equipment and solid funding opportunities. You will be offered secure employment, high-quality supervision, and room to grow, both as a researcher and as a person.At the Department of Computer Science, Electrical, and Space Engineering, we are looking for two Ph.D. students in Planetary Science. At LTU, Planetary Science is formally part of the research subject Atmospheric Science. Both projects investigate planetary solid surfaces. The projects will be conducted at Luleå University’s Space Campus in Kiruna. Subject description Atmospheric science deals with research on the atmosphere of Earth and other planets by modelling along with development and use of instruments for remote sensing and in situ observations. Special focus is on the atmosphere's dynamical, chemical, and physical processes, as well as better weather and climate predictions. Project description Both PhD projects address the evolution of volatile-rich surfaces on planetary bodies. You will be welcomed into a supportive group of researchers in Luleå University of Technology’s Division of Space Technology, whose focus is on investigating physical properties and processes of solar system bodies using the laboratory experiments and spacecraft measurements. Project A addresses an enigmatic process without terrestrial equivalent: the formation of crusts on the martian surface. You will be tasked with reproducing a crust-like surface regolith in the laboratory under Martian conditions, measure its thermal and mechanical properties, attempt to derive mechanical properties from imagery and accelerometer data of past missions to Mars including InSight and rovers, and compare these. Your results will inform drilling and sample return missions to Mars and your findings may help mitigate the risk to ExoMars and other planetary exploration missions of the future and support projects on planetary mobility in science, education and engineering. Project B is, quite literally, even cooler: it will investigate the surfaces of the icy moons in the outer Solar System. The project will simulate volatile extrusion and ejection, precipitation, crust formation and surface evolution processes in cold vacuum environments. Using laboratory simulations and physical models, you will investigate the link between volatile deposition, surface morphology, and surface mechanical properties. You will compare your results to theoretical models and spacecraft imagery. Your results will help explain spacecraft observations and inform future space missions to the outer solar system. As in project A, the outcomes of this project are expected to be useful for future missions aiming to explore the surfaces of minor bodies in the outer solar system, such as Ceres, Enceladus and Europa. Duties As a PhD student you are expected to perform both experimental and theoretical work within your research studies. You will communicate your results at national and international conferences and in scientific journals. Most of your working time will be devoted to your own research project, of which you are gradually expected to take ownership. In collaboration with your supervisors, you will engage in the following research activities: -laboratory experiments involving environmental simulations; -analytical modelling of experimental results; -analysis of remote sensing data and comparison with experimental results; -dissemination of results at international conferences and in scientific publications. In addition to learning and improving your skills while performing these tasks, you will conduct literature reviews and attend courses as part of your graduate education. Optionally, you may support teaching and other departmental duties, limited to a maximum of one year of the total period not exceeding five years. Qualifications We are looking for enthusiastic candidates with the ability to work independently. You must have a master’s degree or equivalent in (geo)physics, astronomy, space or planetary science, or a related subject. Good analytical skills with an affinity for experiments are desired. Ideally, you are an effective communicator and fluent in English. For further information about a specific subject see http://www.ltu.se/research/Utbildning-pa-forskarniva/Studieplaner/Allmanna-studieplaner-Teknisk-fakultetsnamnd?l=en Further information Employment as a PhD student is limited to 4 years, teaching and other department duties may be added with max 20%. jobs.title: Brukerstyrt personlig assistent søkes til voksen kvinne
jobs.description:
Brukerstyrt personlig assistanse (BPA) er en ordning som gir mennesker med funksjonsnedsettelse praktisk bistand til å gjøre ting som andre kan gjøre selv. BPA gir mulighet til å styre egen hverdag ved å bestemme når, og av hvem en trenger assistanse. Det gir større muligheter til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv.

Kvinnen bor alene i egen leilighet Hun trenger å ansette 1-2 assistenter, som skal jobbe hver 3.helg, samt tilkalling ved behov. Stillingen er lyst ut som tilkallingsvikarstilling, men med mulighet for fast ansettelse.  

Den som ansettes må kunne forevise politiattest ikke eldre enn 3 mnd.

Det må vedlegges attester/vitnemål ved søknaden. Dette for at vi skal kunne beregne riktig ansiennitet og lønnsplassering.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Jobben innebærer hjelp personlig hygiene, husarbeid, handling m.m
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Gode muntlige kunnskaper i norsk er viktig. Det betyr at du må kunne snakke flytende norsk
  • Erfaring fra lignende arbeid er en fordel, men ingen krav
  Personlige egenskaper
  • Du må være pålitelig, tålmodig, ansvarsfull, fleksibel og positiv
Vi tilbyr
  • God opplæring
  • Lønn etter gjeldende avtaleverk som pleiemedarbeider/assistent  
KontaktinformasjonBodil Aasen, BPA veileder - BPA tjenesten, 90516127, bodil.aasen@kristiansand.kommune.no ArbeidsstedKjøita 17 4630 Kristiansand Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Kristiansand kommune Referansenr.: 5209896354 Stillingsprosent: 0% Midlertidig Søknadsfrist: 29.11.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Bli med å styrke laget!

Kristiansand kommune har 115 000 innbyggere og er Agders største arbeidsgiver. Vi er over 9 000 ansatte med allsidige oppgaver innen et bredt spekter av tjenesteområder. Som en av landets største kommuner trenger vi stadig nye, engasjerte og motiverte medarbeidere.

Helse og mestring er ett av 6 direktørområder i Kristiansand kommune. Området har om lag 4 500 fast ansatte, et driftsbudsjett på 3,5 mrd. kr og består av 6 kommunalsjefsområder; Forvaltning og koordinering, omsorgssenter, livsmestring, helsefremming og inkludering, hjemmetjenester og rehabilitering og helse og mestringsdirektørens stab. Helse og mestring har ansvaret for å levere helse-, sosial- og omsorgstjenester til befolkingen i Kristiansand. Kristiansand kommune skal ha et høyt utviklingsfokus for å sikre bærekraftige tjenester. Det innebærer at oppgaver og funksjoner vil være i stadig utvikling.

Sterkere sammen er vår visjon. De beste resultatene blir til i samhandling. Våre arbeidsplasser skal kjennetegnes av verdiene på lag, på stell, på hugget. Vi ser hverandre, deler kompetanse og har et større perspektiv enn vårt eget. Vi legger vekt på god dialog med innbyggerne og ønsker sammen å skape stadig bedre tjenester. Vi er alltid på jakt etter effektive og bærekraftige måter å jobbe på – for fellesskapet, miljøet og fremtiden.

Vår kommune har fokus på et inkluderende arbeidsliv og er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet. Vi ønsker medarbeidere med ulike kompetanser, fagkombinasjoner, livserfaring og perspektiver for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsning. Vi oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke, uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. Vi vil tilrettelegge for medarbeidere som har behov for det der det er mulig. Aktuell tilrettelegging kan for eksempel være tekniske hjelpemidler, tilpasning av møbler eller endring av rutiner, arbeidsoppgaver og arbeidstid.

Velkommen til en veldrevet organisasjon.

Kristiansand kommune praktiserer meroffentlighet, jf. offentleglova § 11. Offentlig søkerliste vil normalt inneholde navn på samtlige søkere. Det må foreligge særskilte omstendigheter for å få innvilget unntak, jf. offentleglova § 25.

jobs.title: Kjøkkensjef vikariat 15.03.-31.08.2027
jobs.description:
Er det du som skal ta over?

Hos Scandic Leknes Lofoten er maten en stor del av grunnen til at gjestene kommer tilbake. Fra den første kaffen ved frokost til siste dessert på et bryllup som varer til langt på natt.

Nå trenger vi en kjøkkensjef i vikariat som vil eie det. Du får tillit, frihet og et team som er klare for en leder som setter retningen. Til gjengjeld vil vi ha ambisjoner, kvalitet på tallerkenen og kontroll på tallene.

Dette blir hverdagen din

  • Du leder kjøkkenet og har ansvaret for alt som går ut av det

  • Du utvikler menyer som gjestene snakker om, til à la carte, frokost, konferanse og selskap

  • Du bygger et team folk vil jobbe i, og du løfter hver enkelt

  • Du har kontroll på varekost, budsjett, svinn og bemanning

  • Du sørger for at HMS og mattrygghet sitter i ryggmargen hos alle

  • Du er en viktig del av hotellets ledergruppe

Vi tror du

  • Har fagbrev som kokk og erfaring som kjøkkensjef eller souschef

  • Trives best når det er fullt i restauranten og tempoet er høyt

  • Kan lede både med hjertet og med regnearket

  • Har høye standarder og gir deg ikke før det smaker riktig

  • Får folk med deg uten å måtte heve stemmen

Dette får du hos oss

  • En nøkkelrolle der du får sette ditt eget preg

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med kollegaer som bryr seg

  • Utviklingsmuligheter i Norlandia Hotel Group

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser og ansatterabatter på hotellene våre

Vi går gjennom søknadene fortløpende. Ikke vent med å søke!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Scandic er Nordens ledende hotellkjede med rundt 280 hoteller, i drift eller under oppføring, fordelt på nærmere 55 000 hotellrom i seks land. Med en sterk tilstedeværelse i Norden og et bredt tilbud av hoteller, skaper Scandic gode opplevelser for gjester, enten de reiser i forbindelse med jobb eller fritid.

Hver dag jobber medarbeiderne våre mot ett felles mål: å få gjestene til å føle seg velkommen og ivaretatt. Med et sterkt fokus på bærekraft, samfunnsansvar og tilgjengelighet jobber Scandic kontinuerlig for å bidra positivt til både mennesker og miljø.

Norlandia Hotel Group drifter totalt 37 hoteller i Norge og Sverige. Med fokus på våre ansatte er vi et av Nordens beste hotelldriftsselskaper. Vårt viktigste mål er å skape gode gjeste- og medarbeideropplevelser. Fornøyde gjester og medarbeidere som trives på arbeidsplassen, er avgjørende for vår felles suksess.

jobs.title: Drømmejobben for deg som søker både mening og moro
jobs.employer: PRIMA ASSISTANSE AS AVD MØRE OG ROMSDAL
jobs.description:
Er du på jakt etter en deltidsjobb som gir mening og glede? Da kan dette være muligheten du ser etter! Vi leter etter omsorgsfulle og engasjerte assistenter, for ei fantastisk jente. Vi har ledig 75% stilling fordelt på to nattevakter i uken, samt noe helg (mulighet for noen dagvakter innimellom). For den rette kandidaten kan vi tilpasse turnus/stillingsprosent noe.

Hvem er jeg?

Hei! Jeg heter Hannah og er 9 år gammel. Jeg går i femte klasse og bor på Skodje sammen med mamma, pappa og mine to storebrødre. Jeg elsker alt som har med lek, fart og spenning å gjøre – enten det er å disse, sykle, hoppe på trampoline, bade eller bare være ute og trille tur. Jeg er kjent for å sjarmere de fleste jeg møter, og både gir og får gjerne masse kos. Nå ser jeg etter en snill, leken og tålmodig assistent som kan hjelpe meg i hverdagen.

Hva vil du gjøre som min assistent?

Som assistent vil du være med på å gjøre min hverdag både morsom og trygg. Du vil hjelpe meg med lek, forflytning, måltider, personlig stell og andre daglige aktiviteter. Det er viktig at du er tålmodig og følger mitt tempo, slik at jeg kan trives og ha det gøy. Noen ganger vil du også hjelpe mamma og pappa med småoppgaver.

Du får god opplæring, så du vil være trygg på oppgavene dine – og jeg gleder meg veldig til å bli kjent med deg!

Egenskaper jeg ser etter i deg:

  • Omsorgsfull og snill
  • Tålmodig og livlig
  • Punktlig og ansvarsfull
  • Glad i barn og full av energi
  • Initiativrik og flink til å motivere
  • God fysisk form og glad i å være ute

Arbeidsoppgavene dine:

  • Følge med på videoovervåkning om natten og gå inn til meg ved behov
  • Ta imot meg når jeg kommer hjem fra skolen
  • Hjelpe meg med måltider og medisiner
  • Delta i aktiviteter og leke sammen med meg
  • Hjelpe til med personlig stell og daglige rutiner
  • Bistå med legging om kvelden

Hvilken kompetanse trenger du?

  • Du må ha førerkort klasse B
  • Plettfri vandel, og kunne fremvise en gyldig politiattest
  • Du må snakke og skrive flytende norsk

På grunn av stillingens art oppfordres kvinner til å søke

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Hvis du er ute etter en jobb der du virkelig kan utgjøre en forskjell i hverdagen til en herlig jente som elsker liv og lek, så vil vi veldig gjerne bli kjent med deg! Ikke nøl med å søke – vi ser frem til å høre fra deg.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

BPA er en forkortelse for brukerstyrt personlig assistanse. Det er i hovedsak en alternativ måte å organisere praktisk bistand på for funksjonshemmede. BPA skiller seg fra mer tradisjonelle tjenester ved at det er personen med assistansebehov som selv bestemmer hvordan assistansen skal være. BPA er et frigjørings- og likestillingsverktøy som bidrar til at den med assistansebehov får frihet til å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv - på lik linje med andre i samfunnet. Prima Assistanse har spesialisert seg på BPA, og er i dag en betydelig leverandør i hele Norge. jobs.title: HiveAI Engineering Manager
jobs.description: AI is changing not only what software we build, but how we build it. As our HiveAI Engineering Manager, you will lead the team at the centre of that shift. You will combine people leadership, strong engineering judgement and AI-assisted development to turn ideas into production-ready products faster.This is an opportunity to help shape both a product and the way of working around it. You will build and lead a small, high-trust development team where AI accelerates engineering without compromising quality, security or maintainability.About the roleAs Engineering Manager for HiveAI, you lead the people and shape how the team works and delivers. You will lead an international team with developers based across several Fellowmind countries, so building trust, alignment and a strong team culture across locations will be an important part of your leadership.You will work as a peer alongside our Product Manager and Chief Architect, each with a clear but closely connected area of ownership. The Product Manager drives the why and what. The Chief Architect sets the technical direction and guardrails. You lead the team and create the conditions for great engineering.The way we build matters. The HiveAI team works from problems and hypotheses, using AI to move quickly from idea to experiment and prototype. What proves valuable is then hardened into secure, scalable and maintainable software. You will help define what this way of working looks like in practice as the team grows.You will lead a team that brings together platform developers, who build and maintain HiveAI itself, and Frontier Fellows (Forward Deployed Engineers), who work close to our implementation teams and customers and bring what they learn and build back into the product. Your job is to bring these two perspectives together as one engineering team.What you will do:    Build and lead the team. Own hiring, 1:1s, development and performance conversations, and build a strong, high-trust engineering culture across a distributed international team.    Design the way we deliver. Drive fast build-and-learn cycles, remove impediments and favour working demos and clear ship, change or stop decisions.    Turn prototypes into products. Together with the Chief Architect, make sure promising experiments cross the line into production with the engineering quality they need.    Make AI a real engineering capability. Coach developers in prompting, coding agents, AI-assisted testing and code review, and continuously evolve how the team works with AI.    Protect engineering understanding. AI should make engineers faster and help them learn, not become a substitute for understanding the systems they build.    Keep the focus on outcomes. Build a team that makes good decisions about what to build, how to build it and when AI is, and is not, the right tool.Who are you?You are a people leader who still thinks like an engineer.You probably spent a significant part of your career as a software developer before moving into technical and people leadership. Today, you might be an Engineering Manager, Software Development Manager or a Tech Lead with people responsibility, ideally in a SaaS or software product company.You are comfortable when the destination is clearer than the route to get there. You coach and enable your team, make good decisions with incomplete information and know when a fast prototype is good enough to learn from, but not good enough to ship.We believe that you bring:    Extensive professional experience in software development, followed by at least 2–3 years of people leadership, either as an Engineering Manager or as a Tech Lead with direct people responsibility.    Hands-on experience using AI coding tools and agents, such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code or similar, as part of real software development.    Strong engineering practices across CI/CD, automated testing, code review and secure development.    Experience from a SaaS or software product environment, where teams own what they build beyond the first release.    Experience leading distributed or international teams, with the ability to coach, communicate and build a strong team culture across locations, mainly through digital ways of working.    Experience with Azure and the Microsoft technology stack, which is highly valuable given HiveAI's technology landscape.    The ability to start from a problem statement and a hypothesis, and to shape the route to a solution together with the team as you learn.    Professional proficiency in English and the local language of the country in which you are applying: Swedish, Danish or Dutch.You do not need to be the person writing the most code in the team. What matters is your technical background. It gives you the credibility and judgement to coach great engineers and challenge decisions. It also lets you create an environment where they can move exceptionally fast without losing control of what they build.What is HiveAI?At Fellowmind, we're building HiveAI, a platform for developing, deploying and operating AI solutions at scale. It provides a secure and scalable foundation for enterprise AI and enables organisations to move beyond isolated experiments towards AI solutions that become part of how the business actually operates.At its core is the HiveAI Technology, built on Microsoft Azure, which provides the foundation for deploying, scaling and managing AI agents securely. Around it sits the HiveAI Agent Lifecycle, helping organisations develop, deploy, manage and continuously improve their AI agents over time.Why Fellowmind?You will join HiveAI at a stage where there is still plenty to shape. You will have real influence on how the team, the product and the way of working take form, with an international organisation and the Microsoft ecosystem behind you.Fellowmind combines deep industry knowledge and personal guidance with Microsoft cloud technology across ERP, cloud infrastructure, data & AI, CRM, intranet and Modern Workplace. We are an international organisation with more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe.Our culture is built around putting people at the heart of what we do. We value collaboration, personal responsibility, development and the freedom to find a sustainable balance between work and life.

jobs.title: Junior Key Account Manager – Renewable Energy Solutions
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about technical sales, building customer relationships and the future of renewable energy?

At Photomate, we are looking for a motivated and proactive Junior Key Account Manager to join our team in Denmark.

This is a great opportunity for someone with a technical mindset and commercial drive who wants to develop their sales career in the fast-growing renewable energy sector.

About Photomate

Photomate is an international renewable energy company specializing in solar PV, battery energy storage systems (BESS), EV charging and smart energy solutions.

We support our business partners with innovative technologies, technical expertise and reliable service. As our business in Denmark continues to grow, we are looking for a new colleague to strengthen our commercial team.

Your Responsibilities

As a Junior Key Account Manager, you will work with both existing customers and new business opportunities in the Danish market.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Building and developing relationships with customers and business partners.

  • Identifying and approaching potential new B2B customers.

  • Participating in customer meetings and presenting our technical products and solutions.

  • Following up on quotations, sales opportunities and customer inquiries.

  • Working closely with our technical team to understand customer needs and identify suitable solutions.

  • Maintaining customer information and sales activities in our CRM system.

  • Supporting Photomate's business growth in Denmark.

Who Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a commercially minded person who is genuinely interested in technology, enjoys understanding how technical solutions work and is motivated by developing customer relationships.

Ideally, you:

  • Have initial experience in technical B2B sales, account management or a customer-facing role within a technical industry, or have a relevant technical education combined with strong commercial motivation.

  • Have a genuine interest in technical products and enjoy learning how different solutions work.

  • Enjoy building relationships and actively approaching new customers.

  • Are structured, proactive and results-oriented.

  • Are curious, eager to learn and comfortable discussing technical topics with customers and colleagues.

  • Are fluent in both Danish and English, written and spoken (mandatory).

  • Are willing to travel within Denmark for customer meetings.

Experience in solar energy, battery storage, electrical distribution, EV charging, HVAC, industrial equipment or other technically driven B2B sectors is highly valued.

Direct experience in renewable energy is not essential, but a technical mindset and genuine enthusiasm for technology are key requirements. We are looking for someone who wants to understand the products they sell, not just sell them.

What We Offer

  • An exciting opportunity in a growing international renewable energy company.

  • Product training and support from experienced sales and technical colleagues.

  • The opportunity to develop your own customer portfolio and grow into a Key Account Management role.

  • Professional development and increasing responsibility.

  • An international and collaborative working environment.

  • The chance to contribute to the green energy transition.

Interested in Joining Us?

If you are commercially driven, technically curious and want to build your career in renewable energy sales, we would love to hear from you!

Location: Denmark – Copenhagen

Start date: By agreement

Apply: career@photomate.eu

We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Bovärd
jobs.description: Willhem söker bovärd till GöteborgÄr du händig och genuint intresserad av att hjälpa människor? Då är detta tjänsten för dig! Vi söker en kreativ problemlösare som vill bli en del av vårt goa gäng i Göteborg. Du kommer att utgå från något av våra kontor i Bergsjön eller Biskopsgården.Willhem Göteborg äger och förvaltar idag drygt 4000 lägenheter uppdelat på 2 förvaltningsområden med fastigheter i olika delar av Göteborg. Vi är ett team av engagerade kollegor som hjälps åt och tillsammans jobbar för att uppnå våra mål. Som bovärd hos oss är du den som har ögonen ute i fastigheten och den som säkerställer att våra hyresgäster får en fortsatt riktigt bra service. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att felsöka, reparera och avhjälpa fel som uppstår ute i våra kunders lägenheter.Således spenderar du största delen av dagen ute i våra fastigheter men vi ser också till att ses regelbundet på kontoret och är måna om att skapa trivsel och delaktighet. Som bovärd hos oss erbjuds du ett varierande jobb med stort eget ansvar. Du kommer att arbeta både självständigt och i nära samarbete med dina kollegor, i synnerhet bovärdar och biträdande förvaltare.Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter: - skapa och upprätthålla en bra relation till hyresgäster, entreprenörer och medarbetare- utföra systematisk rondering enligt fastlagt schema - planering och utförande av reparationer och löpande underhåll - delaktig vid besiktningar vid av- och inflyttning - hantera serviceanmälan, klagomål och reklamationer samt att återkoppla till hyresgästen - beställa och följa upp fastighetsförnödenheter och mindre entreprenadarbete - utföra tillsyn av ventilations-, värme och elsystem i våra fastigheter Din profilVi söker dig som har gymnasieutbildning, gärna med inriktning mot, eller påbyggnad inom, teknik och/eller fastighet. Du är en händig problemlösare med kunskap och erfarenhet inom minst några av områdena, VVS, lägenhetsbesiktning, SBA, ronderingsarbete, bygg eller el. Vidare har du erfarenhet av kundnära fastighetsarbeten och har goda kunskaper i svenska i både tal och skrift. Du bör ha god vana av att arbeta i datasystem och B-körkort är ett krav.Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. Som bovärd styr du mycket över din tid så vi söker dig som är ansvarsfull och som kan prioritera. Du har ett stort driv och får gärna komma med idéer om hur vi kan förbättra i ditt område. Din förmåga att arbeta självständigt är god men du fungerar lika bra i grupp då vi lägger stor vikt vid att samarbeta och hjälpas åt. Vårt mål är att leverera en riktigt bra service till våra hyresgäster samtidigt som vi är affärsmässiga och där kommer du att ha en nyckelroll.   Willhems erbjudandeHos Willhem välkomnas du till ett stabilt och långsiktigt bostadsbolag med en företagskultur som präglas av framåtanda, prestigelöshet och kollegor som månar om varandra. Vårt kunniga gäng i Göteborg kommer att ge dig den bästa starten genom att dela med sig av sin kunskap och ge dig möjlighet att både utveckla och utvecklas. Willhem vill ge dig som anställd de bästa förutsättningarna för välmående och därför erbjuder vi förmåner som friskvårdstimme och ett generöst friskvårdsbidrag, kompetensutveckling och regelbundna trivselaktiviteter.Ansökan:Välkommen med din ansökan via http://jobb.willhem.se/ senast den 6 december. Urvalet kommer att ske löpande så vänta inte med att skicka in din ansökan!Har du några frågor om tjänsten ber vi dig kontakta någon av våra områdeschefer Henrik Freed henrik.freed@willhem.se eller Zayda Sanchez zayda.sanchez@willhem.seInnan erbjudande om anställning genomförs en bakgrundskontroll innehållande rättslig och ekonomisk bakgrund. På Willhem jobbar vi för att både hus och människor ska må bra. Som ett av de ledande bostadsbolagen i Sverige är vår vision att skapa hyresbostäder där människor trivs och kan känna sig stolta över sitt boende. Huvudkontoret ligger i Göteborg och ca 310 personer arbetar idag hos Willhem. Marknadsvärdet på fastigheterna uppgår till ca 62 miljarder och ägare är Tredje och Fjärde AP-fonden. Läs mer om oss, vår historia och våra värderingar på story.willhem.se

jobs.title: AI-Driven HR Operations Specialist
jobs.description: About the roleImagine HR where efficient, trusted processes and AI go hand in hand: smooth onboarding, people data everyone can trust, and reliable AI answers to everyday questions about how we work. As our AI-Driven HR Operations Specialist, you make that happen. You design, document, and automate our core HR processes, and you put AI to work wherever it does the job better, so managers and employees across Tacton spend less time on admin and more time on what matters. This is the role for someone who thinks in processes, rules, and data flows, gets a real buzz from what AI can do, and wants to turn that into everyday impact.You'll report directly to Eva Lessing, our CHRO, and team up with the HR team, our AI Automation Specialist, IT, and Security and Compliance to bring your ideas to life.What you will do• Build the HR automation and AI roadmap, prioritizing by business value, process readiness, data sensitivity, and effort, and choosing between automation, AI, or leaving a process as it is. Then build and run the solutions that make HR work smarter for everyone at Tacton.• Run, document and continuously improve our core HR processes: onboarding and offboarding, goal setting, performance review, and our engagement survey.• Own our HRIS (Workday) and Performance system (Leapsome), and set up, maintain, and reconfigure integrations with other systems such as our ATS (Teamtailor), LMS (Docebo), and Microsoft Entra ID.• Set up dashboards and self-service reporting so managers and HR get reliable people data whenever they need it.• Make sure every solution meets our security and privacy requirements, including ISO 27001 and SOC 2.• Measure results in time saved, error rates, and adoption, and enable HR colleagues and managers so the changes stick.What we are looking for• 5+ years in HR, ideally in HR operations, HR systems, or HR technology, with hands-on experience designing and automating HR processes and a solid understanding of people data.• A genuine curiosity and passion for what AI can do, backed by hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude (our main AI tool at Tacton), ChatGPT, or Microsoft Copilot, including AI and automation solutions you have built and maintained, such as workflows and assistants, with measurable results.• Strong skills in documenting processes so others can follow them.• A self-driven way of working, comfort with ambiguity, and a collaborative style. You bring HR, IT, Security, and Compliance colleagues along and can explain trade-offs to senior stakeholders.• Good judgment with confidential employee data.• Fluent English. Swedish and Workday experience are a plus.Your first six months• Map how our HR processes and integrations work today.• Agree a roadmap with priorities and baseline measures.• Get at least two improvements live and measured.• Introduce a documentation standard that the HR team uses.Why join us• You build it from the ground up. This is a brand-new role with no playbook to inherit. The processes, standards, and AI solutions you create become how HR works at Tacton.• Your expertise matters from day one. Our HR team already uses AI and is eager to do more, but we need an expert to lead the way. You will raise the bar for all of us, and because the need is big, your work will be seen and truly appreciated.• Your impact reaches the whole company. Every process you simplify saves time and increases quality for employees and managers in every country we operate in.• You have room to move fast. You report to our CHRO, who sees her job as removing obstacles for you. You join an engaged HR team of six in Stockholm, Chicago, and Karlsruhe that loves trying new things.• You grow with a company on the move. Tacton develops every day and is expanding from a single product into a full platform, so the role grows as you grow.What to expect during the recruitment process• Screening call with Global Talent Acquisition Partner• First interview with our hiring manager• Personality and logical ability test• Second interview and peer meeting, which will include a case• Interview with senior management• Reference checks• Background checksWhat we offerAt Tacton, you'll develop your career in an organization that values teamwork and promotes individual growth. We offer a global and open environment, working with the latest technology to solve important and complex problems in the manufacturing industry.• Flexible hybrid setup: 3 days a week in the office.• 33 days of paid time off: 30 vacation days plus 3 extra to make sure you get the rest you deserve.• Premium occupational pension: Our pension plan goes beyond ITP1, with higher employer contributions depending on your age and salary level.• Generous wellness allowance: 5,000 SEK annually to support your health and wellbeing.• Private healthcare insurance: Skip the waiting lines and get quick access to private medical care, including specialist consultations and treatments.• Parental leave top-up: We top up your parental leave, so you receive up to 90% of your base salary for up to 6 months, helping you focus on your family without financial stress.• Weekly treats: Fika one week, breakfast the next, because good food brings people together.Promise what you can build. Build what you promised. For 26 years, Tacton has helped manufacturers of complex products around the world do exactly that. Now we’re taking configuration intelligence further than ever. Through Tacton’s Connected Suite, every configuration flows on one digital thread from product definition to the factory floor, and AI agents can promise only what can actually be built. Learn more at www.tacton.com.

jobs.title: Administrative Assistant needed!
jobs.description: Are you an organized and service-minded professional who thrives in an administrative role? Do you have the ability to multitask and work proactively in a dynamic environment? Do you want to contribute to efficiency and structure in a workplace where your efforts truly make a difference? Then you might be the right person for this position! Apply today with your application in English and in the Europass CV template.About the positionWe are looking for an Administrative Assistant for our client, an independent and important agency of the European Union. This position is based at their office, just north of central Stockholm.Your daily tasks    Provide daily administrative management of the project, including drafting notes, minutes, correspondence, and necessary follow-up    Organise and coordinate appointments, business trips, and meetings, including the logistical preparations, documentation, and follow-up    Assist in the preparation and follow-up of financial documents, such as orders and reimbursements    Manage electronic and paper documents (contact lists, mailing, scanning, filing, and archiving    Work closely with the project manager/members and centralised support functions to identify and resolve issues related to the project    Communicate, cooperate, and liaise with a range of internal stakeholders    Travel, alongside other staff, for the purposes of supporting logistics during missions and meetings abroadYour characteristicsWe are looking for an administrative assistant with excellent teamwork skills and strong interpersonal abilities, capable of communicating effectively with people at all levels within the organization. The role requires a highly service-oriented mindset, combined with tact and discretion. The ideal candidate has a strong sense of responsibility, can work independently, deliver results, and pays close attention to detail. In addition, they possess excellent organizational skills, can prioritize tasks efficiently, and manage multiple issues simultaneously.Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? jobs.title: Nattevakt og tilkallingsvikarer til avdeling i Kvæfjord
jobs.description:
Vår avdeling i Kvæfjord søker nå etter tre faste våkne nattevakter i 53 % stilling, samt tilkallingsvikarer som kan jobbe natt ved behov. De faste stillingene inngår i en turnusordning med 3-7–4-7, mens tilkallingsvikarer arbeider etter behov.

Helse og omsorgsdivisjonen i region Nord, tilbyr heldøgns helse og omsorgstjenester til mennesker med sammensatte behov. Hver dag gjør våre ansatte en innsats som betyr alt for menneskene vi er her for. I Humana omsorg og assistanse har vi en klar visjon: Alle har rett til et godt liv, ja alle.

Som våken nattevakt vil du ha ansvar for å skape trygghet, ro og forutsigbarhet gjennom natten. Du vil bidra til at våre beboere får nødvendig omsorg, støtte og oppfølging ut fra individuelle behov. Det stilles ikke krav om formell kompetanse for stillingene, men vi legger stor vekt på personlig egnethet og motivasjon for å arbeide med mennesker. Relevant erfaring er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Arbeidsoppgavene innebærer blant annet:

  • Ivareta beboernes individuelle behov gjennom natten.

  • Følge gjeldende rutiner, tiltaksplaner og prosedyrer.

  • Følge lokale brannvernrutiner og bidra til å ivareta brannsikkerheten gjennom natten.

  • Observere, dokumentere og rapportere relevante hendelser.

  • Samarbeide med kollegaer og bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø.

  • Håndtere uforutsette situasjoner på en trygg og profesjonell måte.

Hvorfor velge et av Nordens ledende omsorgsforetak?

Vi tror på våre kjerneverdier glede, engasjement og ansvar, og vi ønsker at våre ansatte skal være med på å påvirke hverdagen både faglig og sosialt. Som en av Norges største private aktører innen velferd, tilbyr vi tryggheten ved å være ansatt i en stor organisasjon med tariffavtale og gode betingelser. Vi har stort fokus på faglig utvikling og kontinuerlig kompetanseheving. Hos oss får du i tillegg gjennomarbeidede HMS-rutiner, en profesjonell intern HR-avdeling og tilgang til et omfattende fordelsprogram.

For spørsmål om stillingen ta gjerne kontakt med avdelingsleder Tanja Bjørsvik, tanja.bjorsvik@humananorge.no

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: Tiltaksstilling, barneverntjenesten
jobs.description:
Vil du bruke din barnevernfaglige kompetanse til å gjøre en forskjell – på tvers av kommuner?

Fjellregionen søker en medarbeider i en inntil ettårig 100 % prosjektstillingstilling som ønsker å bidra til utvikling av barnevernstjenestene og bedre oppfølging av barn, unge og familier.

Fjellregionen består av  barneverntjenestene i Midtre Gauldal, Røros/Holtålen/Os og Oppdal/Rennebu. Arbeidsgiver er Midtre Gauldal kommune.

Vi står overfor flere spennende og krevende faglige oppgaver innen barnevernsfeltet. Nå ønsker vi å styrke kapasiteten og kompetansen i tjenestene gjennom en tiltaksstilling som kan arbeide på tvers av kommunene og bidra der behovene er størst.

Om tiltaksstillingen

Stillingen skal bidra til å styrke tiltakskjeden i barnevernstjenestene i Fjellregionen. Arbeidet vil blant annet omfatte:

  • veiledning og faglig støtte til ansatte og kontaktpersoner i barneverntjenestene
  • oppfølging og veiledning av fosterforeldre utover det som kan ivaretas gjennom ordinære oppfølgingsbesøk
  • arbeid med saker som omhandler vold/rus mellom barn og foreldre
  • bistand i saker med store konflikter mellom foreldre som bor sammen
  • oppfølging av konfliktfylte familiesituasjoner der foreldrene ikke bor sammen
  • arbeid i grenseflaten mellom barnevern og familievern
  • utvikling og utprøving av nye arbeidsformer og tiltak, blant annet elementer fra Omsorgspakken
  • bidra til kompetanse- og erfaringsdeling på tvers av tjenestene i Fjellregionen

Stillingen er tenkt som en fleksibel tiltaksressurs på tvers av tjenestene, og skal ikke samtidig være kontaktperson/saksbehandler i barnevernet. Dette gir mulighet til å arbeide mer målrettet med fagutvikling,veiledning og komplekse problemstillinger i tett samarbeid med aktuelle familier. Det må påregnes  ettermiddags- og kveldsarbeid.

 

Vi ser etter deg som

  • har relevant 3-årig høgskole-/universitetsutdanning
  • har erfaring fra barnevern, familiearbeid eller annet relevant arbeid med barn, unge og familier
  • har god faglig forståelse og interesse for barnevernsfeltet
  • har erfaring med veiledning og relasjonsarbeid
  • gjerne har kompetanse innen arbeid med vold, høykonfliktfamilier eller fosterhjem
  • kan arbeide selvstendig og strukturert
  • har gode samarbeidsevner og evne til å skape tillit
  • er opptatt av faglig utvikling og kunnskapsdeling
  • trives med å arbeide på tvers av kommuner og tjenester
  • Har førerkort for bil og er komfertabel med trønderske veier i alle årstider

Det vil bli lagt stor vekt på personlig egnethet, relevant erfaring og evne til å bidra positivt til fagmiljøene i regionen.

En stilling med mulighet til å gjøre en forskjell

Fjellregionen består av tjenester som møter komplekse og varierte problemstillinger. Samtidig kan det være krevende å rekruttere og beholde fagutdannede medarbeidere til smale og tidsavgrensede arbeidsoppgaver.

Denne stillingen er derfor utformet med tanke på å kunne dekke flere faglige behov for tiltak innen barnevernstjenestene. Vi ønsker å skape en arbeidsplass der du får brukt kompetansen din bredt, samtidig som du får mulighet til å utvikle deg faglig.

En viktig del av arbeidet vil være å sikre erfarings- og kunnskapsdeling mellom ansatte og kontaktpersoner i tjenestene. Det vil blant annet legges opp til felles erfaringsdager, både fysisk og digitalt.

Vi tilbyr

  • 100 % prosjektstilling i inntil ett år, med avslutning av prosjektet innen 31.12.2027, med mindre tjenenesten får tilskudd til å videreføre stillingen.
  • en spennende og variert arbeidshverdag
  • mulighet til å arbeide på tvers av kommuner og fagmiljøer
  • gode muligheter for faglig utvikling og kompetansebygging
  • mulighet til å være med på å utvikle nye arbeidsformer
  • et fagmiljø med fokus på samarbeid, kunnskapsdeling og kvalitet
  • telefon og nødvendig datautstyr

Arbeidssted

Arbeidet vil foregå på tvers av barnevernstjenestene i Fjellregionen, og det må påregnes mye reisevirksomhet. Oppmøtested er Støren.

Vil du bli vår nye fagressurs?

Dette er en mulighet for deg som ønsker å bruke kompetansen din til å styrke barneverntjenestene og bidra til bedre oppfølging av barn og familier.

Vi håper å høre fra deg!

Søknadsfrist:17.11.2026 Tiltredelse: 15.01.27 eller etter avtale Spørsmål om stillingen: Avdelingsleder Sigrid Antonsen, tlf: 994 80 662 eller enhetsleder Oddveig Børset tlf: 958 99 412

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Helse og Mestring i Midtre Gauldal kommune består av enhetene Pleie og omsorg, NAV, Helse og familie, samt Helse- og velferdskontoret. Sammen tilbyr de et bredt spekter av tjenester som fremmer helse, mestring og livskvalitet for kommunens innbygger

jobs.title: 💛 Glad i shopping, konserter og hyggelige opplevelser? Kanskje du er min nye BPA-assistent!
jobs.description:
Hei!Jeg er en sosial jente på 17 år som nå skal starte med BPA for aller første gang. Derfor søker jeg flere assistenter som kan bli med på laget mitt og gjøre det lettere for meg å leve det livet jeg ønsker.

Jeg liker å dra på shopping, kino, kafé og konserter, og er veldig glad i sminke og hudpleie. Jeg synger også i kor og er alltid med på en hyggelig brettspillkveld. Som mange andre på min alder liker jeg også å se på TikTok og Instagram.

Hva går jobben ut på?
  • Bistå med personlig stell og hygiene
  • Matlaging
  • Praktiske gjøremål
  • Være med på aktiviteter
  • Være med på trening og svømming
  • Du trenger ikke å ha jobbet som BPA før. Det viktigste er at vi passer godt sammen, og du får selvfølgelig opplæringen du trenger.
Hvem ser jeg etter?
  • Jeg ser etter deg som er rolig, tålmodig og trygg, men samtidig sosial og ikke redd for å ta initiativ.
  • Du må være pålitelig og kunne tilpasse deg at energien og behovene mine kan variere fra dag til dag.
  • På grunn av arbeidets art søker jeg kvinnelige assistenter.
  • Jeg har egen bil med automatgir som du kan bruke når vi skal ut på ulike aktiviteter. Derfor er førerkort er en fordel, men ikke et krav.
Arbeidstid

Følgende vakter fordeles mellom flere assistenter:

  • 3–4 ettermiddagsvakter i ukedagene
  • Noe lengre dagvakter lørdag og søndag
  • I skoleferier vil det være behov for mer bistand, med dagvakter på opptil 8 timer
  • Jeg bor på Sandsli, med kort vei til både Bybanen og buss.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?Da håper jeg du vil søke! 💛

Du trenger ikke skrive en lang eller perfekt søknad. Fortell om deg selv, hvorfor du kunne tenke deg jobben, og svar på spørsmålene som følger stillingen.

Det viktigste for meg er at du har lyst på jobben, ønsker å bli kjent med meg og bli en assistent jeg kan stole på.

Hva tilbyr Medvind Assistanse?
  • Tariffestet lønn fra 236,49 kr/t + tillegg for kveld, natt og helg
  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med utviklingsmuligheter
  • Ryddige arbeidsforhold med forsikring og pensjon
  • Enkle digitale systemer for vaktplan og timeføring
  • Gode ansattfordeler, som rabattert trening på SATS

Før eventuell ansettelse må det fremlegges politiattest, jf. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4. Attesten skal ikke være eldre enn tre måneder.

Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.
