Ragna Ringdals dagsenter, avdeling Lavblokka, søker miljøarbeidere/assistenter, som kan stille opp som tilkallingsvikarer ved fravær.Vi ser etter deg som har noe erfaring med, eller kjennskap til, vår brukergruppe. Du trives i arbeid med mennesker, møter den enkelte med respekt og nysgjerrighet, og er motivert for å lære om brukernes ulike behov, ressurser og måter å kommunisere på.

Mange av våre brukere har omfattende bistandsbehov. De fleste har diagnoser innen utviklingshemming og/eller autismespekteret. Vi gir også tjenester til brukere med vedtak etter helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven kapittel 9, og har i tillegg en egen døvblindgruppe.Hos oss er målet å skape en trygg, aktiv og meningsfull hverdag der den enkelte får mulighet til å bruke sine ressurser og utvikle seg ut fra egne forutsetninger.

Ragna Ringdals dagsenter har over tid arbeidet systematisk med fagutvikling. Positiv atferdsstøtte (PAS) og aktiv støtte står sentralt i vårt faglige rammeverk.Tjenestene utformes med utgangspunkt i den enkelte brukers behov, ressurser, kompetanse og erfaring. Vi ønsker å legge til rette for mestring, selvstendighet, deltakelse og livskvalitet, og for at våre brukere skal få mulighet til å være aktive borgere i eget liv.Vi arbeider etter avtale med Oslo kommune, med en overordnet målsetting om å gi brukerne et dagtilbud som ivaretar best mulig funksjons- og mestringsevne og styrker selvstendighet, deltakelse og livskvalitet.

Vi ser etter deg som har noe erfaring med vår brukergruppe og som synes det er meningsfullt å bidra til gode dager for mennesker med ulike bistandsbehov. Du trenger ikke kunne alt fra før, men vi ønsker at du er trygg, nysgjerrig og motivert for å lære. 

Som tilkallingsvikar hos oss blir du en viktig del av hverdagen til både brukerne og avdelingen du jobber på.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper vi du søker!

Mer informasjon om Ragna Ringdals dagsenter finner du på www.rrd.no.

Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Direkte miljøarbeid i henhold til brukers tjenestetilbud
  • Tilrettelegge grad av støtte slik at bruker opplever den gode hverdagen
  • Bidra med egen fagkompetanse inn i brukers team
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Fagbrev innenfor helse- og oppvekst fag. Relevant og lang erfaring kan kompensere for manglende formell utdanning
  • Erfaring med eller kunnskap om tjenester til personer med utviklingshemming
  • Beherske norsk skriftlig og muntlig
  • Kunne delta på bading 
  • Kunne delta på riding (leie hesten, ikke nødvendig å kunne ri selv)

 

I tillegg er det ønskelig med:

  • Ferdigheter innenfor tegnspråk/tegn til tale
  • Erfaring med brukere med store og sammensatte funksjonsvansker, som funksjonstap, sansetap og epilepsi
  • Kjennskap til Lov om kommunale helse- og omsorgstjenester kapittel 9
  • Kjennskap til og erfaring med forebygging og håndtering av atferd som kan utfordre
  • Kjennskap til og eller interesse for positiv atferdsstøtte og aktiv støtte
  • Gode dataferdigheter
Personlige egenskaper
  • Gjenkjenner deg selv i våre verdier: Respekt, ansvar, tillitt og trygghet
  • Er engasjert i brukergruppen og vårt fagområde
  • Er trygg, ansvarsbevisst og omsorgsfull
  • Er nysgjerrig på den enkelte bruker og ønsker å lære
  • Kan samarbeide godt med kolleger
  • Kan være fleksibel og stille opp ved behov
  • Bidrar til et godt arbeidsmiljø og en god hverdag for våre brukere
  • Personlig egnethet vektlegges
Vi tilbyr
  • Ordinær arbeidstid på dagtid fra mandag til fredag
  • Gode pensjonsordninger
  • Mulighet for parkeringsplass
  • Nærhet til knutepunkt for offentlig kommunikasjon

 

Det kreves godkjent politiattest iht. § 5-4 - Helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven

Aktuelle kandidater kontaktes fortløpende for intervju frem mot søknadsfristen.

 

KontaktinformasjonJanne Sand, Daglig leder, 930 11 231, janne.sand@rrd.no Mona Da Cruz, Assisterende daglig leder, 907 22 303, mona.dacruz@rrd.no ArbeidsstedHans Nielsen Hauges gate 44A 0481 OSLO Nøkkelinformasjon:Arbeidsgiver: Ragna Ringdals Dagsenter Referansenr.: 5211046291 Stillingsprosent: 40% Vikariat Søknadsfrist: 11.12.2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ragna Ringdals Dagsenter er en ideell stiftelse som gir tjenester til mennesker med utviklingshemming og andre funksjonsnedsettelser. Dagsenteret ble opprettet i 1953 som en av de første av sitt slag i Europa.

Dagsentertjenesten skal utformes og ytes i samsvar med brukeres individuelle målsettinger, behov, ressurser og være tilpasset den enkeltes forutsetninger. Hovedmålet med dagsentertilbudet er å øke livskvaliteten til brukere, dens nærpersoner, oppnå meningsfulle liv og sikre aktiv deltagelse i relasjoner, aktiviteter og samfunnet, i tråd med Ragna Ringdals Dagsenter sin visjon «Den gode hverdagen».

Vi er fordelt på fem avdelinger. Avdelingene er ulikt utformet etter ulike behov. For tiden har vi 90 brukere og 130 ansatte. Dagsenteret ligger sentralt i rolige og tilbaketrukne omgivelser ved Sinsen T-banestasjon i Oslo.

jobs.title: Responsable HSE F/H/X
jobs.description:
À propos de Symrise

Symrise est un fournisseur mondial de fragrances, de parfums, d'arômes, d'ingrédients actifs cosmétiques et d'ingrédients fonctionnels. L'entreprise compte parmi les leaders mondiaux de son secteur et dessert des fabricants de parfums, de cosmétiques, de produits alimentaires et de boissons, ainsi que l'industrie pharmaceutique et les producteurs de compléments nutritionnels et d'aliments pour animaux.

Vos missions

Rattaché(e) au Secrétaire Général, avec un rattachement fonctionnel au Regional Head of Safety EAME, vous définissez, pilotez et faites évoluer la stratégie EHS du site de Clichy.

Véritable partenaire de la Direction du site et des responsables opérationnels, vous veillez à intégrer pleinement les enjeux EHS aussi bien dans les activités quotidiennes que dans les projets de transformation, de développement et d'investissement du site.

Vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes :

  • Définir et déployer la stratégie EHS du site de Clichy, en cohérence avec les objectifs EHS globaux de Symrise et les priorités du business.

  • Manager et développer l'équipe EHS, en définissant les priorités et en veillant à disposer des compétences et ressources nécessaires.

  • Identifier, évaluer et prioriser les principaux risques environnementaux, santé et sécurité, et assurer la mise en œuvre de plans de prévention adaptés.

  • Développer une véritable culture de la sécurité et de la prévention auprès de l'ensemble des activités du site : laboratoires, bureaux et fonctions support.

  • Accompagner la Direction dans ses prises de décision en apportant votre expertise sur les risques EHS, les contraintes réglementaires et leurs impacts opérationnels.

  • Intégrer les exigences EHS dès les premières étapes des projets de transformation, immobiliers, laboratoires et de développement du site.

  • Piloter la conformité réglementaire et anticiper les évolutions de la réglementation française et européenne en matière d'EHS susceptibles d'impacter les activités du site.

  • Développer et entretenir des relations constructives avec les autorités et parties prenantes externes, notamment l'Inspection du travail, la CRAMIF, les services de santé au travail ainsi que les autorités environnementales et locales.

  • Représenter le site lors des inspections et audits réglementaires et assurer le suivi des plans d'action associés.

  • Piloter les analyses d'incidents et garantir la mise en œuvre d'actions correctives et préventives durables.

  • Suivre la performance EHS, les indicateurs clés et le reporting associé, dans une logique d'amélioration continue.

  • Être l'interface privilégiée entre le site de Clichy et les équipes EHS régionales et globales de Symrise.

Profil recherché

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'une formation supérieure en Hygiène, Sécurité et Environnement (HSE/EHS), sciences environnementales, ingénierie ou dans un domaine connexe.

Vous justifiez d'au moins 10 ans d'expérience progressive dans une fonction EHS, idéalement acquise au sein d'une organisation internationale et dans des environnements complexes combinant activités industrielles, laboratoires ou opérations.

Au-delà de votre expertise technique, nous recherchons un profil capable d'allier vision stratégique et pragmatisme opérationnel.

Vous vous distinguez notamment par :

  • Une solide expertise en management EHS, évaluation des risques et conformité réglementaire.

  • Une expérience confirmée dans le management et le développement d'équipes EHS.

  • Une expérience significative dans l'accompagnement de projets de transformation, de développement ou d'investissement.

  • Une bonne maîtrise des relations avec les autorités réglementaires et les parties prenantes externes.

  • Une capacité à anticiper les risques et à transformer des problématiques EHS complexes en recommandations concrètes et pragmatiques pour le business.

  • De solides compétences en leadership, en influence et en accompagnement du changement dans une organisation matricielle et internationale.

  • Une excellente capacité à communiquer et à interagir avec des interlocuteurs variés, notamment avec le senior management.

  • De fortes capacités d'analyse, de résolution de problèmes et d'aide à la décision.

  • Une expérience en conduite du changement et en gouvernance de projets.

  • Une maîtrise courante du français et de l'anglais.

Avantages

Ce poste vous offre l'opportunité de prendre la responsabilité des enjeux EHS au sein d'un site stratégique de Symrise, en collaboration étroite avec la Direction locale ainsi qu'avec les équipes régionales et globales du Groupe.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement en transformation, où l'EHS joue un rôle essentiel dans la continuité des activités, le développement du site, l'excellence opérationnelle et la croissance durable.

Au-delà des enjeux de conformité, vous aurez l'opportunité de façonner la feuille de route EHS du site de Clichy, d'influencer des décisions structurantes et de contribuer directement au développement d'une culture forte et proactive de la sécurité.

Localisation : Clichy (92)
Intitulé : EHS Manager – Site de Clichy

Rémunération

La rémunération proposée pour ce poste est de EUR 60,000–72,000 par an.

Vos premiers mois chez Symrise

Vous prenez en main la gestion des dossiers HSE du site de Clichy et collaborez étroitement avec les équipes opérationnelles. Votre période d'essai de 3 mois vous permet de vous familiariser avec nos standards de sécurité et nos exigences réglementaires. Vous disposez de 25 jours de congés payés par an pour organiser votre équilibre personnel.

jobs.title: Uthyrare / Fastighetsutvecklare inom kommersiella lokaler – Trollhättan
jobs.description: För vår kunds räkning söker vi just nu en interim uthyrare/fastighetsutvecklare inom kommersiella lokaler. Uppdraget är på deltid 80% och förväntas starta januari 2027 och pågå till och med juli 2027.Om uppdragetVår kund är ett fastighetsbolag med ett omfattande fastighetsbestånd bestående av bland annat industri-, kontors- och verksamhetslokaler.Vi söker nu en självgående och engagerad uthyrare/fastighetsutvecklare som kan stärka kundens fastighetsorganisation under en tidsbegränsad period.I rollen ansvarar du för uthyrning av kommersiella lokaler och driver både nya och pågående hyresgäst- och etableringsdialoger. Du arbetar nära fastighetschef, förvaltare, projektledare och externa aktörer för att skapa långsiktiga och affärsmässiga lösningar.Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter    Ansvara för uthyrning av kommersiella lokaler, inklusive förfrågningar, visningar, offerter och marknadsföring.    Driva pågående hyresgäst- och etableringsprocesser till tecknat avtal.    Självständigt förhandla och upprätta kommersiella hyresavtal enligt 12 kap. jordabalken.    Hantera omförhandlingar, avtalstillägg och uppsägningar.    Ta fram underlag och hyreskalkyler för hyresgästanpassningar i samarbete med förvaltare och projektledare.    Arbeta med uthyrning och etablering i utvecklingsområden.    Samverka med kommunala funktioner och andra externa aktörer kring etableringsfrågor.    Delta i interna möten och rapportera till ansvarig fastighetschef Övrigt: Start: 11 januari 2027 Slut: 10 juli 2027 Omfattning: 80% (ca 32 timmar i veckan) Placering: TrollhättanOm dig Vi söker dig som uppfyller nedan obligatoriska krav:    Minst 3 års erfarenhet av uthyrning av kommersiella lokaler under de senaste 10 åren, exempelvis kontor, industri, lager eller logistik.    Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att självständigt förhandla och upprätta kommersiella hyresavtal enligt 12 kap. jordabalken.    B-körkort.Det är meriterande om du även uppfyller följande krav:    Erfarenhet av uthyrning och etablering i utvecklingsområden.    Erfarenhet av industri-, lager- eller logistikfastigheter.    Bakgrund inom kommunalt eller offentligt ägda fastighetsbolag.    God lokalkännedom om fastighetsmarknaden i Trollhättan eller Fyrbodal.    Erfarenhet av hyres- och investeringskalkyler för hyresgästanpassningar.    Erfarenhet av fastighetssystem för avtals- och hyresadministration. Ansökan Låter uppdraget intressant? Skicka in din ansökan snarast då urvalsarbetet och intervjuer kommer ske löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.Du ansöker enkelt genom att skicka in ditt CV samt svara på några frågor. De kandidater som bäst matchar rollen kommer telefonintervjuas och sedan bli kallade till en intervju hos oss på Devotum. Nästa steg är en intervju hos vår kund. Referenstagning är en del av processen.Har du några frågor om uppdraget är du välkommen att höra av dig till ansvarig Konsultchef Vanessa Tummings på vanessa.tummings@devotum.se  Känn dig trygg som konsult hos Devotum Som konsult hos Devotum har du möjlighet att välja om du vill fakturera genom ditt eget bolag eller bli direkt anställd hos oss. Som anställd hos Devotum erbjuds du alltid schyssta villkor enligt kollektivavtal (Almega) som bland annat innefattar friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och försäkringar. Hos oss är varje konsult viktig och våra konsultchefer finns alltid till hands för att ge dig den support och vägledning du behöver under hela uppdragsperioden.

jobs.title: Työnjohtaja/Team Leader datakeskukseen
jobs.description: Haluatko olla mukana rakentamassa täysin uutta toimintaa Suomeen?Carlsson RPS käynnistää Suomessa uuden liiketoiminnan, ja rakentaa ammattimaisen asennusorganisaatio palvelemaan kasvavia asiakastarpeita. Etsimme nyt kolmea työnjohtajaa (Team Leader), jotka pääsevät mukaan aivan alusta asti rakentamaan toimintaa yhdessä suomalaisen organisaation kanssa. Tehtävät ovat vakituisia, kokoaikaisia. Yrityksen nykyaikaiset toimitilat sijaitsevat Espoossa.Työtehtävä alkaa viimeistään alkuvuonna 2027 kattavalla perehdytys-, koulutus- ja työjaksolla Ruotsissa emoyhtiön toiminnan parissa. Ruotsin-jakson tarkemmasta kestosta ja rotaatiomallista sovitaan erikseen valittujen henkilöiden kanssa.TehtäväsiTyönjohtajana vastaat oman asennustiimisi päivittäisestä johtamisesta ja työn organisoinnista. Johdat noin kuuden asentajan tiimiä ja osallistut tarvittaessa myös itse käytännön asennustyöhön.Roolissa toimit tärkeänä linkkinä asiakkaiden, asentajien ja muun organisaation välillä sekä varmistat, että työ suoritetaan turvallisesti, laadukkaasti ja aikataulussa.Tyypillisiä vastuualueitasi ovat:- Asennustiimin päivittäinen työnjohto ja ohjaus- Töiden suunnittelu ja organisointi työmaille- Asennuksiin liittyvästä logistiikasta vastaaminen- Asennustöiden laadun ja turvallisuuden varmistaminen- Piirustusten ja työohjeiden tulkinta- Asiakasyhteistyö ja käytännön asioiden koordinointi- Tiimin perehdyttäminen ja osaamisen kehittäminen- Tarvittaessa osallistuminen käytännön asennustyöhönMitä odotamme sinulta?Voit tulla tehtävään monenlaisesta teknisestä ympäristöstä. jobs.title: CNC Operator - Jordbro
jobs.description: Do you have experience working with CNC machines and enjoy the combination of technology, precision, and high-quality craftsmanship? We are now looking for a CNC Operator to become an important part of our joinery workshop in Jordbro.CNC is still relatively new to our workshop, which means you will play a key role and have the opportunity to help shape and develop how we work with CNC going forward.About the roleIn our in-house joinery workshop, we manufacture bespoke fitted interiors such as kitchens, wardrobes, bookcases, and furniture. You will work closely with our skilled joiners and project managers and be responsible for ensuring a high standard of programming, production, and quality.Your main responsibilities will include:    Programming the CNC machine based on technical drawings.    Operating and maintaining the machine, including setup, tooling, and basic maintenance.    Manufacturing components for bespoke fitted interiors.    Reading technical drawings and planning material usage to minimise waste.    Checking dimensions, precision, and overall quality.    Contributing to a clean, safe, and well-organised workshop.    When required, visiting customers in the Stockholm area to take measurements.Who are we looking for?We are looking for someone with at least three years of experience programming and operating CNC machines within joinery, interior manufacturing, or furniture production. You are familiar with CAD/CAM software, confident reading technical drawings, and comfortable working independently.No specific formal education is required. What matters most is your hands-on experience and your understanding of what it takes to achieve a high-quality finished product.As a person, we believe you are detail-oriented, independent, and quality-conscious. You appreciate an organised workplace and work well with others.Experience in fine joinery, high-end bespoke interiors, or taking measurements at customer sites is a strong advantage.What we offerYou will join a family-owned company with around 50 employees, including temporary staff, with broad expertise in areas such as joinery, fine woodworking, painting, and tiling.Decision-making is quick and straightforward, and you will have a role where your knowledge and experience can make a real difference. Most importantly, you will have the opportunity to take significant responsibility for our CNC operations and help develop this area from the ground up.Practical information    Employment: Full-time    Working hours: Monday–Friday, 07:00–16:00    Location: Jordbro    Contract: Six-month probationary employment, with the intention of transitioning into permanent employment    Start date: By agreement    Travel: Occasional travel within the Stockholm area. No overnight stays.Does this sound like the right next step for you? We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Junior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Graag stellen we onszelf eerst even voor

Wij zijn Altrad Services Benelux, een wereldwijde marktleider binnen industriële services. Met onze multidisciplinaire teams zorgen wij voor vakmanschap op het gebied van stellingbouw, access solutions, isolatie, painting, asbestverwijdering, thermografie en elektrische- en stoomtracing. Wij bieden oplossingen op maat voor de specifieke behoeften van de klant.

Met 4 vestigingen verspreid over heel België leggen we samen de focus op gegarandeerde groei en succes voor zowel de klanten als onze werknemers!

Zet jij graag mee jouw schouders onder ons bedrijf als Junior Project Manager Isolatie in onze vestiging te Terneuzen? Lees dan zéker verder!

Wat kan je van de functie verwachten?

Als Junior Project Manager word je klaargestoomd om volledig zelfstandig aan de slag te gaan als projectleider en de operationele leiding te nemen over bepaalde projecten op de werf in Terneuzen. In het begin zal de focus liggen op de dagelijkse opvolging van de administratieve en financiële flow met de nodige rapportages. Geleidelijk aan zal je ook meer operationele en commerciële taken uitvoeren. Jouw takenpakket is zeer uitgebreid en bestaat verder uit:

  • Je onderhoudt dagelijks de projectadministratie (van opdracht t.e.m. facturatie) en je zorgt voor de nodige rapportages
  • Je zorgt mee voor een efficiënte inzet van mensen en middelen op de werf
  • Je bent mede verantwoordelijk voor de opvolging van het budget
  • Je stuurt op termijn mee de medewerkers aan en je bent het aanspreekpunt bij o.a. problemen, ziekte, planningen … Je stimuleert het teamwerk hierbij en dit doe je met een coachende aanpak!
  • Veiligheid van de werknemers is de belangrijkste waarde van Altrad. Daarom zorg je ook voor en goede opvolging van de veiligheidsvoorschriften en je spreekt collega’s aan die dit niet doen
  • Je organiseert het werfoverleg en je zorgt voor de nodige opvolgingen en briefing m.b.t eisen opdrachtgever, instructies business unit manager …
  • Je werkt actief mee aan verbetertrajecten op de werf om ervoor te zorgen dat de klant de beste service krijgt!

Ben jij de nieuwe collega die we zoeken?

  • Je hebt een technische opleiding op bachelor niveau gevolgd of je bent gelijkwaardig door ervaring. Schoolverlaters zijn ook welkom.
  • Je hebt een analytische mindset en je haalt energie uit dagelijkse problemsolving
  • Je ben flexibel ingesteld en dit zowel naar taken als naar uren
  • Je kan vlot multitasken en je bent stressbestendig
  • Je bent administratief sterk
  • Je bent een vlotte communicator en je kan jezelf zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken in het Nederlands, Engels en Frans
  • Je kan vlot werken met Excel
  • Je bezit een VCA certificaat of je bent bereid om dit op korte termijn te behalen

jobs.title: Vik matematiklärare Snitz Resursskola åk 7 - 9
jobs.description: Snitz grundskola ligger vid Telefonplan i Hägersten. På skolan går ca 100 elever i åk 7-9. Snitz Skolor riktar sig till elever med neuropsykiatriska funktionsnedsättningar och har utvecklat en pedagogik för att möta elever som är i behov av ett uttalat särskilt stöd.På Snitz Grundskola i Stockholm går ca 100 elever fördelade på årskurs 7-9. Snitz Grundskola är en verksamhet som riktar sig till elever med NPF, neuropsykiatriska funktionsnedsättningar och ett uttalat behov av särskilt stöd. All undervisning sker i särskild undervisningsgrupp med färre elever och hög pedagogtäthet. Skolan finns i nya lokaler vid Telefonplan, Hägersten. Vi sökerVi söker dig som är en legitimerad och erfaren lärare i matematik och som under vårterminen 2027 vill vara en del av en verksamhet som brinner för elevers lärande utifrån deras individuella förutsättningar. Detta då vi har en av våra kollegor som kommer att vara föräldraledig under vårterminen. Du är genuint intresserad av att upptäcka elevers unika styrkor och utmaningar. Du är trygg i din förmåga att hitta lösningar som passar bäst för varje enskild elev genom bemötande och anpassning av undervisningen.Du har lätt för att skapa förtroendefulla relationer och ett välfungerande samarbete med både elever, vårdnadshavare och med kollegor som på ett eller annat sätt samverkar kring elevernas hälsa och kunskapsutveckling. Du förstår vikten av att bygga ett solitt förtroendekapital i rollen som mentor för ca 5 elever där en god relation är viktig för alla elever men direkt avgörande för en del.Vi söker dig som vill utmanas i din profession och utveckla din undervisning på en skola där du behöver använda såväl hjärna som hjärta för att nå framgång. Du behöver ha legitimation men kan ha längre eller kortare erfarenhet. Det är kompetens, inställning och nyfikenhet vi är ute efter. Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet. Mycket meriterande är om du tidigare undervisat elever med NPF. Om uppdraget  Uppdraget är en matematik-lärartjänst som vikarie under vårterminen 2027 på 100%. Delat mentorskap ingår för en klass med 10-12 elever tillsammans med en kollega. Du kommer att ingå ett arbetslag där du blir en viktig del i att utveckla verksamheten framåt.  Du kommer att kunna samverka med en ämneskollega som också undervisar i matematik.Det här blir du en del avPå Snitz Grundskola möts du av glädje, vänlighet och kreativitet. Nya idéer, infallsvinklar och en ambition att utveckla vår skola genomsyrar verksamheten. Vi är inte bara en mötesplats för lärande och måluppfyllelse utan även en mötesplats där våra elever har möjligheten att tillsammans med personal och skolkamrater växa som individer utifrån sina förutsättningar. Låter detta intressant? Du söker tjänsten genom att klicka på nedanstående länk. Vi tar ej emot ansökningar via post eller mail. Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-12-07. Tjänsten har tillträde från 7 januari  2027 till och med 15 juni 2027. Ansök gärna snarast då urval sker löpande. Kom ihåg att bifoga lärarlegitimation med behörighetsförteckning till din ansökan.Om du har frågor angående tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rektor AnnSofi Rydholm på annsofi.rydholm@vittra.se alt på tel  070-556 26 24. Kontakt med rekryteringsfirmor undanbedes. Välkommen med din ansökan!

jobs.title: Matematiklärare åk 6-9, Noblaskolan Lindholmen, Göteborg
jobs.description: Noblaskolan består av 18 för- och grundskolor som arbetar enligt devisen att elever som utmanas når längre. Genom en kombination av tydliga strukturer, höga förväntningar, undervisning av hög kvalitet samt trygghet och studiero ska eleverna få de bästa förutsättningarna för en bra skolgång. Noblaskolan är en del av AcadeMedias grundskolor.Vi utökar och förstärker vårt stöd i matematikundervisningen och söker en en legitimerad lärare i Matematik för årskurserna 6-9. Start i samband med terminsstart i januari eller enligt överenskommelse. Vi söker dig som vet att lärande startar med relation. På vår skola har vi höga ambitioner för våra elevers lärande och utveckling och vårt arbete präglas av ett gemensamt engagemang. Du är ödmjuk, har lätt för att samarbeta, når fram till kollegor och elever samt är trygg i din roll som lärare. Du lockas av att få varje elev att nå sin fulla potential och vågar anpassa din undervisning för att nå fler.  Dina arbetsuppgifter    Planera, genomföra och utvärdera undervisning tillsammans med ämneskollegor.    Utveckla undervisningen i linje med skolans mål och styrdokument, samt anpassa den efter varje elevs behov och förutsättningar.    Bidra aktivt till att skapa en trygg och motiverande lärandemiljö där varje elev känner sig sedd och hörd.    Samarbeta nära med kollegor, specialpedagog och rektorer för att säkerställa elevernas utveckling.    Du är en del av ett arbetslag, där ni tillsammans ansvarar för elevernas skoldag, mentorskap ingår.    Tjänsten innebär undervisning i både helklass och i mindre grupper.Vi erbjuderVi erbjuder dig möjligheten att arbeta på en fantastisk skola med engagerade kollegor och elever. Du blir en del av ett arbetslag med andra kollegor och får samtidigt ett nära samarbete med dina ämneskollegor, som du träffar regelbundet för att tillsammans utveckla undervisningen.Som en skola inom AcadeMedia erbjuder vi våra medarbetare kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling genom Academedia Academy samt intern och extern professionsutveckling. För oss är det viktigt att det går bra för dig och därför får du självklart kollektivavtalade förmåner och försäkringar men även friskvårdsbidrag, pensionsrådgivning och möjlighet till fördelaktiga köp genom netto- och bruttolöneväxling.ÖvrigtTjänsten är just nu en visstidsanställning fram till och med juni, men med goda möjligheter till en tillsvidaretjänst. Tillträde vid terminsstart i januari eller enligt överenskommelse.Du är varmt välkommen med din ansökan via vårt rekryteringssystem. Tillsättning kan komma att ske innan sista ansökningsdag. Vid frågor kring tjänsten, kontakta rektor Malin Forsberg. malin.forsberg@noblaskolan.se

jobs.title: Supercell: Audiovisual Support Intern
jobs.description: **Type:** Full-time, fixed-term (8-month internship)**Location:** Jätkäsaarenlaituri 1, 00180 Helsinki**Application deadline:** 27.11.2026Become the go-to audiovisual support at one of Finland's most creative workspaces – join Supercell as an Audiovisual Support Intern!**What will you be doing?**Supercell is looking for two enthusiastic Audiovisual Support Interns to join its in-house IT-Collaboration team for an 8-month full-time internship starting in February 2027 and September 2027. In this role, you'll support hundreds of live and hybrid events at Supercells headquarters, especially in the auditorium, collaborating with game teams, leadership, external partners, and handling a wide range of daily operations. You'll be part of a small in-house team of ten collaboration professionals, working closely with consultants and the wider IT-Organization.You'll get hands-on experience with digital signage, live mixing, equipment management, troubleshooting technical issues, and user guidance in digital tools and meeting rooms. You'll also have the freedom to explore opportunities for projects aligned with the team's broader goals. The role gives you a front-row seat to some of Supercells highest-profile internal and external events and to how technology enables company-wide collaboration. Were looking for someone who thrives in dynamic situations and doesn't shy away from grabbing a mic (or helping someone else wear one right).You'll also contribute to digital tool development, service documentation, and internal projects – whether that means piloting a new video platform or documenting our digital infrastructure.**What makes you a great fit?**You'll do well in this role if you're curious about event technology, interested in how audiovisual systems work, and keen to learn through doing. Confidence, self-reliance, and professionalism are essential: you'll interact daily with people across the company, including leadership.**What Supercell requires from you:**- A genuine interest in technology, live events, and how things work behind the scenes - 2–4 years of relevant studies in AV technology, IT, event production or similar fields - Some previous work experience - Good IT skills and a basic understanding of IP networks - An independent, proactive and curious mindset with solid problem-solving skills - Good social skills and an ability to communicate clearly under pressure - Full working proficiency in English **What Supercell considers an asset:**- Experience with digital/live events or technical support - A genuine interest in games (experience of Supercells games is a big plus!) Don't meet every requirement? No worries! We encourage you to apply even if your background doesn't tick every box. We're open to different backgrounds and value your motivation and willingness to learn.**Why you will love it at Supercell:**- Dive into a high-tech environment with hundreds of events annually and a strong support team - Work with cutting-edge equipment and see your impact in daily operations and high-profile events - Learn by doing – get involved in digital installations, vibecoding, tool improvements and documentation - You'll be surrounded by an international work environment; you'll hear chatter in different languages from all over the world around the office - You'll get to work with the newest tools and technologies. Supercell will offer you everything that you need to succeed in your role - the rest is up to you! **Practicalities:**This is a full-time, fixed-term internship for 8 months. We are looking for two interns, one starting in February 2027 and the other in September 2027. In this position, you will be employed directly by Supercell. Your main work location will be Supercells headquarters in Helsinki, and we expect you to work mostly on-site given the nature of the tasks. Flexibility is required, as events occasionally take place outside of office hours or on weekends. Please note that you need to have a valid work permit in Finland. Unfortunately, we do not offer any relocation support for this position.**Recruitment process timeline:**- Application period ends: Friday 27th of November - Phone interviews with aTalent: week 49 - Interview rounds with Supercell: week 50 – week 51 - Final decisions and selections: week 1 at the latest Does this sound like the next step in your career? Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by the latest 27th of November via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/397409/create/. Please apply for the position as soon as we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to also use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email.To familiarize yourself with Supercell, please visit http://supercell.com/en/. For more information about the position and recruitment process, contact aTalent's Recruitment Consultant Sofia Hyvärinen (+358 503 613288, sofia.hyvarinen\[ät\]atalent.fi). For any questions regarding the position, I will be available by phone 25th of November at 13.00 - 14.30. If I'm unable to answer your call, please leave me a message, and I'll call you back.

jobs.title: HR Generalist / HR Administration (Part-Time, 20–25h/week)
jobs.description:
Middelharnis, Netherlands | Thermoheat B.V.

Join Thermoheat B.V. and help shape the future of HR in an international industrial environment.

We are looking for a HR Generalist (m/f/d) to support and develop our HR processes across the Thermoheat Group. This is a part-time position (20–25 hours/week).

Company Overview

Thermoheat B.V. is an established company with over 40 years of experience in the refractory industry and part of the internationally active LOEWE Group, a family-owned business founded in 1962.

With locations in the Netherlands and Portugal, Thermoheat delivers tailor-made refractory solutions for industrial clients worldwide. Our core markets include petrochemical, steel, aluminum, non-ferrous metals, energy, waste incineration, ceramics and glass.

Our portfolio covers the full range of refractory products and services, including thermal seals, refractory pre-shapes, and passive fire protection systems, all from a single source.

We are VCA certified, ISO 9001:2015 compliant, and audited according to NEN 4400-1, ensuring the highest standards in quality, safety, and compliance.

Your Role

You will take ownership of both operational HR tasks and strategic HR initiatives, working closely with management to strengthen our organization and people development.

Key Responsibilities

HR Strategy & Policies


  • Develop and improve HR policies across the group
  • Ensure compliance with Dutch and EU labor law
  • Support HR projects and organizational development initiatives


Operational HR Management


  • Advise management on HR-related topics
  • Manage end-to-end recruitment and hiring processes
  • Coordinate onboarding and employee development programs
  • Maintain job descriptions, compensation structures and performance processes
  • Collaborate with international teams (e.g. Portugal)


HR Administration


  • Maintain employee records, contracts and HR systems
  • Support payroll preparation with external providers
  • Manage absences (vacation, sick leave, etc.)
  • Prepare HR reports (headcount, turnover, KPIs)
  • Act as a point of contact for employee inquiries


Your Profile


  • Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or similar
  • Minimum 2 years of HR experience (HR Generalist or similar role)
  • Knowledge of labor law (NL/EU preferred)
  • Experience with MS Office and HR systems
  • Fluent in English and Dutch


What We Offer


  • Competitive salary package and attractive corporate benefits
  • Full-time equivalent salary: €4,000–€4,500 per month
  • Permanent role in a stable, internationally operating company
  • Professional training and development opportunities
  • Flexible working conditions
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture
  • Long-term perspective within a family-owned industrial group


Apply now and become part of the LOEWE Group!

jobs.description: Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.We partner with major global platforms such as Booking.com, Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and Flygresor.se, Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.The RoleThe RoleAs the Team Lead for Noco (Notification & Communication), you own two of the most trusted touchpoints in the traveler’s journey: the messages that keep customers informed, and the account experience that lets them manage their own journey. Every booking confirmation, schedule-change alert, receipt, and proactive notification a customer receives runs through your team’s systems — and so does the account functionality we’re actively building out to give travelers more control and visibility over their own data.You won’t just lead a team; you will be the bridge between Product, Platform, and the many domain teams who depend on reliable, well-governed communication and account infrastructure. Collaborate with your manager to make sure the team follows their agreed upon ways of working. You will lead a group of experienced engineers in maintaining a high-trust, high-reliability platform while helping shape where it goes next.Your ResponsibilitiesCoordinate Efforts: Keep the team aligned across two active fronts — communication infrastructure and the evolving Customer Account as well as future initiatives — ensuring both move forward smoothly without one starving the other of attention.Facilitate Communication: Serve as the bridge between your engineers and the stakeholders who depend on your systems, from Product Owners to stakeholders to the many domain teams whose customer-facing flows rely on your infrastructure.Technical Guidance: Drive the technical quality bar across both domains. Coordinate direction on complex technical issues with the help of the team.Team Empowerment: Empower your engineers to do their best work without micromanaging. Foster a culture of ownership for the health and performance of everything the team builds.Stakeholder Management: Keep everyone informed from your engineers to management, and communicate expectations as priorities shift.Ownership: Take end-to-end accountability for the team’s output — staying hands-on enough to guide technical decisions credibly, participating in recruitment, and providing appraisal input to your manager.Requirements    6+ years of experience in Java development, with exposure to system design and architecture.    Proven leadership or mentorship experience in a technical role.    A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.    Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.    Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to build bridges between technical and business teams.BenefitsAt the Etraveli Group Gothenburg office, you will be part of +200 people, all with different cutting-edge skills and personalities. Our shared ambition, passion, and strong work ethic are what drive us toward the same goals. This foundation allows us to value our individual differences, which we believe are precisely what make us a strong team. With us you can enjoy:    Our office is located in Merkurhuset in Gothenburg, a few steps away from public transport and lunch restaurants.    We work on a hybrid-model where you can choose to work two days from home and you have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location    We love gaming and after work activities.    We know the value of personal development and continuous training.    Hackathons and Dev Weeks - We believe in promoting creativity and trying new things.    Healthcare allowance – Each employee receives a maximum allowable amount each year according to the Swedish Tax Agency to spend on health-promoting activities such as a gym card, massage etc.    Pension and health insurance – Through partners we offer a comprehensive pension and health insurance so that you can get help quickly in case of an accident.    Daily breakfast – To kick the day off just right, breakfast is available at the office every morning.As part of this recruitment process, we will be conducting background checks. You will be able to read more information and give your consent to this process in the application form.

jobs.title: We need 2 rescue zookeeper in rescue zoo
jobs.description:
Are You Our Next Rescue Zookeeper at Odsherred Zoo Rescue?

We are looking for two qualified zookeepers with a passion for exotic animals and animal rescue!Fonden Odsherred Zoo Rescue is Denmark's first and only approved rescue centre for exotic animals in need. We provide a permanent home for animals that have experienced difficult circumstances and need specialised care.

We are currently looking for two dedicated, qualified zookeepers to join our team.

About the PositionsThe positions primarily involve caring for our larger animals and a variety of other species, including small wild cats, camels, meerkats, llamas, deer, birds and more.

Our rescue centre is home to approximately 600 animals, representing a wide range of exotic species.

You will work closely with our existing team of six zookeepers and a maintenance colleague. Teamwork is an essential part of our daily operations, and we expect everyone to contribute to a supportive and responsible working environment.

Both positions are full-time and include weekend duties approximately twice a month.

We are looking to fill:

  • One longer-term position, potentially permanent or lasting 1–2 years.

  • One shorter-term position, lasting approximately 6–12 months.

We would like the successful candidates to start as soon as possible.

What We Expect From You

We are looking for colleagues who are genuinely passionate about animal welfare and understand the responsibility that comes with working at a rescue centre.

You should be:

  • A qualified zookeeper with experience or a strong interest in exotic animals.

  • Reliable, punctual, honest and hardworking.

  • Positive, adaptable and willing to take responsibility.

  • A team player who actively supports and communicates with colleagues.

  • Observant and attentive to the animals in your care, recognising changes in their health, behaviour and general well-being.

  • Willing to learn and adapt to the different challenges of working with rescued animals.

  • Comfortable with the practical and sometimes physically demanding nature of animal care.

Teamwork is particularly important to us. We have a working culture in which colleagues help one another complete the day's responsibilities. We expect everyone to contribute, communicate openly and take their responsibilities seriously.

Working at a rescue centre is more than a traditional zookeeping job. It requires dedication, flexibility and an understanding that the needs of rescued animals can be very different from those of animals in conventional zoological collections.

Visitor Presentations and Social Media For approximately half the year, our rescue centre is open to the public.

During this period, all zookeepers participate in educational presentations for visitors, introducing the animals they care for and explaining their stories, behaviour and needs.

Public speaking is a mandatory part of the position, but previous presentation experience is not required as long as you are willing to learn.

We also regularly produce content for our social media platforms to raise awareness of our rescue work and the animals in our care.

This includes livestreams, photographs and recorded videos. Our zookeepers participate in this work by helping communicate the stories of the animals and the daily life of our rescue centre.

Understanding Our Mission, Odsherred Zoo Rescue is built around three main areas of work:

1. Rescue and Rehabilitation — Our Primary Mission

First and foremost, we are a rescue centre for exotic animals in need.

Our animals come from a variety of backgrounds, including the pharmaceutical and cosmetics industries, confiscations, former private ownership and other zoological institutions across Denmark and Europe.

Many of these animals have experienced difficult circumstances and require specialised care, patience and understanding.

Providing them with a safe and permanent home is our highest priority.

2. Conservation and Breeding Programmes

When resources and funding allow, we participate in conservation breeding programmes for rare and endangered species, including tamarins from South America.

Although this is an important part of our work, it remains secondary to our primary rescue mission.

3. Providing Homes for Surplus Zoo Animals

When we have the necessary space and resources, we also welcome surplus animals from other zoological institutions, providing them with a home when they might otherwise face euthanasia.

A Different Approach to Zookeeping, We want to emphasise that working at Odsherred Zoo Rescue is not the same as working at a traditional zoo.

We welcome applicants with experience from conventional zoological institutions, but it is essential that you are open-minded and willing to understand the different principles and challenges involved in operating a rescue centre.

Our focus is not simply on maintaining a zoological collection. It is on providing individual animals with the care, security and permanent home they deserve.

We are looking for colleagues who genuinely share these values and are willing to learn, adapt and contribute to our mission.

How to Apply, If you are passionate about exotic animals, dedicated to animal welfare and would like to become part of our rescue team, we would love to hear from you.

Please send your written application and CV to: post@odsherreds-zoo.dk only written inquiries.

Yours sincerely

Joan Thygesen

Director and founder of

Found Odsherred Zoo Rescue

Jeg trives godt med rolige dager, men når været er fint, går jeg gjerne en lenger tur i nærområdet. Jeg bruker også tredemøllen hjemme for å holde meg i aktivitet.

Nå skal jeg få min egen BPA-ordning, og derfor ser jeg etter trygge og hyggelige assistenter som vil bli kjent med meg og være med på å skape gode dager. Siden ordningen er helt ny, får du også mulighet til å være med fra starten og bidra til gode rutiner rundt meg.

Jeg er nonverbal og viser hva jeg ønsker og trenger gjennom signaler og kroppsspråk. Det er derfor viktig at du tar deg tid til å bli kjent med meg og lærer å forstå uttrykkene mine. Jeg har også epilepsi. Dersom jeg får et anfall, trenger jeg en assistent som klarer å beholde roen og følge rutinene mine. Du får god opplæring, så det er ikke nødvendig å ha erfaring med dette fra før.

Som assistent blir din viktigste oppgave å være til stede, gi meg støtte når jeg trenger det og bidra til at jeg får fine og trygge dager. Noen ganger passer det godt med en aktivitet eller en tur, mens andre ganger trenger jeg ro hjemme.

Hvem ser jeg etter?

Jeg søker deg som:

  • Er rolig, tålmodig og ansvarsbevisst
  • Er observant og god til å lese signaler
  • Trives med rolige arbeidsdager
  • Tar initiativ til enkle aktiviteter
  • Er komfortabel med å bistå med personlig stell
Arbeidstid og stilling

Vi søker tilkallingsvikarer og deltidsansatte.Arbeidstidene vil hovedsakelig være:

Ukedager

  • Fra ca. kl. 15.00 til 19.00. Det er behov for assistenter tre ukedager, men hvilke dager dette gjelder er fleksibelt og kan avtales nærmere i forbindelse med intervju.

Helger

  • Lørdag og søndag ca. kl. 12:00-19:00

Skriv gjerne i søknaden hvor mange dager i uken du ønsker å jobbe, og hvilke dager som passer best for deg.

Arbeidsoppgaver kan være:
  • Tilsyn og støtte i hverdagen
  • Bli med på turer og andre aktiviteter
  • Motivere til aktivitet og sosialt samvær
  • Bistå med personlig stell

Dersom du kjører bil til jobb, er det gode parkeringsmuligheter rett utenfor boligen.

Før eventuell ansettelse må det fremlegges politiattest, jf. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4. Attesten skal ikke være eldre enn tre måneder.

Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

jobs.title: Fagkonsulent
jobs.description:
Barne- og familieetaten søker en engasjert og faglig sterk fagansvarlig barnevernkonsulent til beredskapshjemavdelingen og spesialiserte fosterhjem. 100% fast stilling.Vil du bidra til at barn og unge i akutte og krevende livssituasjoner får trygge omsorgsrammer og god oppfølging? Har du erfaring fra fosterhjemsfeltet, et sterkt faglig engasjement og evne til å veilede og lede andre faglig? Da kan dette være stillingen for deg!Beredskapshjemavdelingen og spesialiserte fosterhjem er organisert med tre team, bestående av beredskapshjem og barnevernkonsulenter som jobber aldersinndelt. Team 0-6 år, team 4-18 år og team spesialiserte fosterhjem. Hvert team har en fagansvarlig som har ansvar for å sikre fremdrift i sakene, gi veiledning til konsulenter, bistå i veiledning med og opplæring av beredskapshjem, bistå avdelingsleder i å sikre god kvalitet i arbeidet i tråd med avdelingens faglige standard.

Vitnemål og attester skal vedlegges søknaden elektronisk.

Førstegangsintervju blir avholdt i uke 50

Andregangsintervju blir avholdt i uke 51

  •  Er faglig trygg og opptatt av kvalitet
  •  Klarer å være tydelig og ta faglig ledelse når det er behov for det

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

jobs.title: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
jobs.description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track). The positions are with the department's research groups located at the university campus in Copenhagen.

Your profile and work tasksWe seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.

The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

  • Cyber security
  • Privacy engineering
  • Computer Systems
  • Edge/cloud computing
  • High-Performance Computing (HPC)
  • Data Engineering
  • Big Data Infrastructure
  • Machine Learning Systems

The main tasks and responsibilities include:

  • developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.
  • providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.
  • participating in grant application activities
  • coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment

Your competenciesYou have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.

Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Who we areIn electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model. 

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, cyber security, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide. 

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Qualification requirementsAppointment as Assistant Professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level.

Tenure-trackWhen appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on:

  • The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
  • The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
  • The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
  • The candidate is a skilled communicator
  • The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
  • The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process

Evaluation and promotion proces:

  • Annual internal follow-ups to review progress on the promotion plan and ensure the assistant professor remains on track.
  • A mid-term evaluation, based on external review, conducted by an internal assessment committee after three years.
  • A final review by an external committee after 5.5 years. A positive outcome leads to a tenured appointment as Associate Professor.
  • Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorship

Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorshipThe assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

  • Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
  • Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
  • Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
  • The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
  • The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 

If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications. Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.      Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.description: Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien lapsiperheiden kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten sote-alan opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai sote-alan koulutuksen omaava konkari, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme, isäämme, ystäväämme tai lastamme.Mikä on helpperi?Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua ja seuraa omalle nimetylle avustettavalle henkilölle, kuten lapselle. Helpperi tukee asiakasta kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, päivittäisissä toimissa, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain seurana ollessa ja huolehtien. Ajan myötä helpperistä, asiakkaasta ja hänen perheestään voi tulla läheisiä keskenään.Etsimme tiimiimme sote-alan koulutettuja hoitajia auttamaan lapsiperheitäAsiakkaisiimme kuuluu niin lapsia kuin lapsiperheitä. Tässä tehtävässä pääset tukemaan lapsiperheitä heidän hektisessä ja kiireisessä elämäntilanteessa tarjoamalla arvokasta aikaasi lapsiperheen arjen pyörittämiseen. Tehtävät voivat liittyä lapsien kanssa leikkimiseen ja ulkoiluun aina kodinhoidollisiin askareisiin, kuten roskien viemiseen. Välillä käynnit voivat sujua ihan vain yhdessä puuhaillen vaikkapa värityskirjan äärellä.Mitä helpperin työ vaatii?Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Helppereitämme yhdistää halu viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa. Tässä työssä pääset aidosti vaikuttamaan siihen, että asiakkaidemme arki olisi parempaa ja helpompaa. Annamme lisäpisteitä, jos sinulta löytyy kokemusta lapsiperheiden kanssa työskentelystä!Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat: "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen asiakkaan kanssa." "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne." "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."Helpperinä saat:- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana - Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan. - Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 15,29-17,29 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. - Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi! Mikäli sinulla on kysyttävää helpperiksi ryhtymisestä, laita meille sähköpostia osoitteeseen rekry@hemby.fi, niin jutellaan lisää!

jobs.title: PhD Position in Large-Signal Modelling and Transient Stability Analysis of Wind Turbine Generators under Grid Fault Conditions
jobs.description:
The WindConnect (wind farm control and integration in sector-coupled power systems https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101227683) consortium unites leading experts from academia and industry across Europe, leveraging expertise in wind energy, power systems, power electronics, control engineering, artificial intelligence, and energy economics. This multidisciplinary collaboration addresses the pressing challenges of integrating wind energy into sector-coupled power systems including green hydrogen production, while ensuring grid stability, flexibility, and sustainability.

At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The PhD stipend is open for appointments from 1st March 2027 or soon after. The position is for 3 years, and it is funded by the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Networks programme under the WindConnect project.

  • On the date of recruitment (expected to be 1 March 2027), applicants must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months during the 36 months immediately preceding the recruitment date. Applicants must not hold a doctoral degree at the date of recruitment.
  • The project offers you competitive salaries (plus allowances) and funding for technical and personal skills training and participation in international research events.
  • You will participate in international secondments to other organisations in the network.

AAU Energy is a dynamic engineering research department in continuous growth and inspiring surroundings. AAU Energy has a very international environment and covers all areas of clean and sustainable energy systems of the future within electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technology. AAU Energy has campuses in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, this position is located in Aalborg.

The mission is to be world leading in both research and research-based education of the energy engineers of the future. AAU Energy has approx. 300 employees of many nationalities, of which 25 are administrative staff. In addition, AAU Energy constantly has approx. 50-70 guest researchers from around the world.

Research and teaching are in the absolute world elite in the field of energy, and we have extensive and leading workshop and laboratory facilities, where research and innovation are carried out in direct collaboration with industry to a great extent.

The position is offered in relation to the research program "Power Electronic Control Reliability and System Optimization" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Applied Power Electronic Systems”.

The increasing integration of wind turbine generators significantly alters power system dynamics, particularly under grid fault conditions. While grid-forming (GFM) wind turbine generators contribute to voltage and frequency regulation, they may exhibit significant nonlinear large-signal behaviour during disturbances, including current limiting, control mode switching, and loss of synchronism. In multi-converter systems, these transient dynamics are further shaped by interactions among multiple GFM units and the surrounding grid strength. Conventional small-signal models are therefore inadequate, motivating large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis frameworks for GFM wind turbine generators under grid faults.

This poses the following key research questions:

  • How can large-signal models of GFM wind turbine generators be developed to accurately capture nonlinear dynamics, particularly current limiting and control mode transitions during grid faults?
  • How do multiple wind turbine generators interact during grid faults, and how do grid strength and system configurations influence their transient stability?
  • What are the dominant dynamic mechanisms governing transient stability, and how can reduced-order models be developed while preserving the essential nonlinear dynamics and stability characteristics?

This project will be in close collaboration with Ørsted. The PhD student is expected to work closely with colleagues from Ørsted and visit their facilities. The aim of this PhD project is to develop large-signal modelling and transient stability analysis methods for wind turbine generators under grid fault conditions, with particular emphasis on multi-inverter systems. The project seeks to identify key mechanisms affecting transient stability and to provide modelling and analysis tools that support robust control and protection design for future wind-dominated power systems.

Qualification requirementsPhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

How to applyYour application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Project description (3-5 pages), which describes the applicant’s initial thoughts and ideas related to the specific project applied for. This includes a brief state-of-the-art (including short list of references), a time schedule and how the applicant intends to shed light on the project objectives. All documentation should be in English and merged in a single PDF document. Please note that applications which do not follow the announcement’s guidelines will not be considered.
  • Other relevant documents

Applicants should have an excellent academic background and hold a master’s degree or equivalent qualification in Electrical Engineering, Control Engineering, Energy Engineering, Mathematics, or a closely related field. Knowledge or experience in power electronic converters and their control will be an advantage. Applicants who are in the final stage of their master’s studies are also encouraged to apply, provided that they complete their degree before the fellowship begins.

  • Strong motivation and potential for academic research, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively. Creativity, initiative, and an open-minded approach to research are highly valued.
  • Knowledge or experience in modelling, control and stability analysis of grid-connected power electronic converters, particularly GFM converters, and power system stability analysis will be an advantage.
  • Experience with simulation and programming tools, such as MATLAB/Simulink, PSCAD, or equivalent platforms, will be an advantage.
  • Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Publications in international peer-reviewed journals or conferences will be considered an advantage.

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. Do you have any questions?     If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information  Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

jobs.description:
📍 Arbeidsgiver: Mio BPA📅 Tiltredelse: 1/2-27📌 Stillingstype: Fast⏰ Arbeidstid: Hovedsakelig dagtid, men noen kvelder og helger kan bli aktuelt

Hei!

Jeg er en voksen og positiv dame i 60-årene som bor i Arendal. Nå ser jeg etter en fast assistent som kan bli en viktig del av hverdagen min. Jeg liker å være ute med rullestol når været er fint og på besøk til venner og familie, og det hadde vært ekstra hyggelig om du kunne være med på opplevelsene. Jeg liker å lage mat hjemme, og hos familien når jeg er hos dem. Da lager jeg mat fra bunnen og prøver gjerne nye retter fra ulike kulturer. Kanskje vi kan lage noe spennende sammen? Jeg har også barnebarn, som jeg ønsker at du kan være med og tilrettelegge slik at vi kan være med dem og leke og ha det moro sammen!

Jeg lever med en muskelsykdom som gradvis gjør at jeg trenger mer praktisk hjelp i hverdagen. Det betyr at du som assistent vil være mine armer og bein i mange situasjoner. Målet mitt er å leve et selvstendig og aktivt liv på mine egne premisser – og til det trenger jeg deg! Familie, barnebarn og venner betyr mye for meg, og det gjør også firbeinte familiemedlemmer, så det er viktig at du liker både barn og dyr.

Arbeidstid og stilling:

  • En fast assistent som kan jobbe ca. 11 timer i uken, med mulighet for å også være vikar ved sykdom/ferie.

Det vil hovedsakelig være dagtid to dager i uken, fra hhv. kl. 9 til 15 og 09 til 14. Ønsker gjerne at du kan være fleksibel, slik at vaktene kan endres ved behov. Det kan også tidvis bli aktuelt med arbeid på kveld og i helg.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Assistere under trening hjemme og ute

  • Være med på besøk til venner og familie

  • Personlig stell/hygiene

  • Hjelpe til med matlaging

  • Snømåking

  • Hagearbeid

  • Husarbeid

  • Bistå ved forflytning hjemme og utenfor hjemmet

  • Håndtere og løfte rullestol og andre hjelpemidler

  • Hjelpe meg med å kjøre dit jeg skal

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Tålmodig og omsorgsfull

  • Følge system og rutiner

  • Engasjert og selvstendig

  • Ærlig og pålitelig

  • God humor og glimt i øyet

  • Trives med barn og dyr

  • Fysisk sterk for å kunne løfte utstyr og hjelpe meg dersom jeg skulle falle

  • Være proaktiv, kreativ og se løsninger

  • Trygg på bilkjøring

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Kan fremlegge gyldig politiattest

  • Førerkort klasse B

  • Egen bil er en fordel

Send inn søknad snarest – aktuelle kandidater kontaktes fortløpende.

Gleder meg til å høre fra deg! 🙋‍♀️

Ved spørsmål angående stillingen, kontakt rekrutterer Jenny Dolven på epost: jenny.dolven@mio.no. Søknader sendes inn via eget søknadsskjema.

Vi tilbyr:

  • En meningsfylt jobb

  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren

  • Lønn etter tariff: Timelønn 236,49,-, kveldstillegg på 67,- og helgetillegg på 70,-

  • Teoretisk og praktisk opplæring, i tillegg til relevante kurs

  • Fordelsportal med rabattavtaler på blant annet hotell, hvitevarer, nettbutikker etc.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Mio BPA er en av Norges største BPA-leverandører. Vi har lang og bred erfaring, og leverer tjenester i over 150 norske kommuner. Vi har som mål å levere Norges beste BPA-tjenester, og tilbyr skreddersydde BPA-løsninger i henhold til den enkeltes behov. Det er viktig for oss å kunne gi våre kunder den aller beste tjenesten og at vi er den beste arbeidsplassen for våre medarbeidere. Mio BPA er en del av Mio-konsernet som er 100 prosent norskeid.

Vi jobber alltid ut ifra disse verdiene:

• Respektfull: Vi er åpne og møter andre med vennlighet og forståelse. Alle vi møter skal føle seg sett, anerkjent for den de er og verdifulle.

• Pålitelig: Vi er til å stole på og holder det vi lover. Vi opptrer på en måte som gir tillit og trygghet.

• Modig: Vi utgjør en forskjell for hvert enkelt menneske vi møter. Vi gir mennesker et bedre liv og frihet til å leve slik de vil.
