jobs.title: Location Data engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Location Data Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work with large-scale datasets generated by our products and turn raw data into meaningful signals, insights, and features.

You will work across the entire data lifecycle: building reliable pipelines, exploring and understanding complex datasets, developing features from them, and creating the tools and visualizations needed to understand their quality and impact.

This is a technical and product-oriented data role. You'll collaborate closely with product, engineering, and data teams to find what we can learn from our data and turn those learnings into production systems.

As a Data Engineer, your day-to-day will include:

  • Making Sense of Data

    • Explore large and complex datasets to understand user behavior and identify useful patterns and signals.

    • Transform raw data into reliable, well-defined features that can be used by our products and engineering teams.

    • Develop a deep understanding of our data: where it comes from, what it represents, its limitations, and how it can be combined to answer new questions.

  • Building Data Products

    • Design, build, and maintain pipelines that process large volumes of data efficiently and reliably.

    • Take ideas from exploration to production: prototype them on historical data, evaluate their quality, and build the pipelines needed to run them at scale.

    • Build datasets and features that can power product experiences, internal systems, analytics, and machine learning models.

    • Work with technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or similar tools depending on the problem at hand.

  • Exploring & Analyzing

    • Use data to investigate hypotheses, understand behaviors, and answer ambiguous questions.

    • Develop metrics and evaluation frameworks to understand whether the signals and features we build actually work.

    • Create analyses, dashboards, and visualizations that make complex datasets understandable and help the team make better decisions.

    • Build tooling that makes it easier to inspect individual examples, debug data pipelines, and understand why a system produces a particular result.

  • From Data to Intelligence

    • Work closely with engineers and product teams to identify opportunities where data can make our products smarter.

    • Use statistical methods, heuristics, experimentation, or machine learning depending on what is most appropriate for the problem.

    • Iterate on features and models based on real-world data and continuously improve their accuracy and reliability.

    • Help bridge the gap between exploratory data work and robust systems running in production.

  • Continuous Improvement

    • Improve the performance, reliability, and maintainability of our data infrastructure.

    • Monitor data quality and proactively investigate unexpected changes or anomalies.

    • Stay up to date with developments in data engineering, analytics, and machine learning, and bring relevant ideas and technologies into our stack.

    • Contribute to a culture of curiosity, craftsmanship, and learning.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience working with data-intensive systems.

  • Very comfortable with SQL and manipulating large datasets.

  • Experience with one or more modern data technologies such as Spark, DBT, Dagster, BigQuery, ClickHouse, DuckDB, or equivalent tools.

  • Strong analytical skills: you enjoy digging into data, testing hypotheses, and understanding why something behaves the way it does.

  • Ability to turn exploratory analysis into reliable, production-ready data pipelines and features.

  • Familiarity with data modeling, pipeline orchestration, and large-scale data processing.

  • Ability to communicate findings clearly through metrics, visualizations, dashboards, or other tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building data products or features directly used by consumer-facing products.

  • Experience working with high-volume event, behavioral, sensor, geospatial, or time-series data.

  • Familiarity with statistics, machine learning, or feature engineering.

  • Experience taking a data problem from an ambiguous question through exploration, prototyping, evaluation, and production.

  • Experience building internal tools or visualizations for exploring and debugging complex datasets.

Life at amo

To ensure that everyone is set up for success within our way of working, we work together onsite 5 days a week.

We wanted to make sure coming to the office was as comfortable as possible for you:

We chose a location in central Paris, near Opéra (Metro lines 3, 8, 9 and RER A).

We have a beautiful Parisian-style office with high ceilings, balconies, and huge windows. So a lot of natural light!

Because life outside of work should also be stress-free, we cover:

  • Health care (100% coverage).

  • Maternity Leave, Paternity Leave, Second Parent Leave (salary maintained at 100%).

  • Vacation days: 8–9 weeks (total) per year:

  • 5 weeks of paid time off;

  • 1–2 additional weeks (RTT, based on our company contract);

  • ~11 bank holidays.

We shut down entirely twice a year, two weeks in summer and one week in winter, to allow everyone to truly recharge and avoid prolonged slowdowns. These pauses are part of your total vacation time, giving everyone a real chance to unplug and recharge. No Slack, no email, no FOMO.

We love the diverse perspectives we get from having people from all over the world join us (68% of our team is international), and so we of course support relocation to Paris with:

  • Help and sponsored visa process.

  • 1 month of Airbnb 100% covered by amo upon arrival.

  • Assistance from a trusted relocation agency to find your permanent home.

  • Help with French paperwork like opening a French social security account, tax forms, getting your carte vitale (free healthcare), and more.

  • French lessons to be fully set with your new Parisian life.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Inato is a Tech for Good company striving to bring clinical research to each and every patient, regardless of who they are or where they live. To do this, we’ve built an AI-powered platform that changes how pharmaceutical companies and doctors around the world collaborate to bring medical breakthroughs to patients. Leading companies and over 5,500 research sites rely on Inato to increase patient access, improve representation in trials, and deliver life-changing treatments to patients faster.

Drug development is a challenging, intellectually complex, and rewarding endeavor. We are a growing team of passionate pharmaceutical experts, software and AI engineers, professional services members, and many more—all bringing their unique perspectives to solve the challenges facing clinical research.

Inato is a recipient of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, Fierce Healthcare’s Fierce 15, and Built In's Best Places to Work 2025 and 2026.

🧑‍💻 The Role

We are looking for a dedicated and creative AI Engineer to join our team. As an essential contributor to our mission of transforming healthcare, you'll play a leading role in building AI-driven solutions that directly influence clinical research and, ultimately, improve patient care. We’ve already deployed multiple AI use cases in production, and your skills will be crucial in pushing the boundaries of healthcare AI.

💊 Responsibilities

In this role, you'll take on complex challenges that will stretch your abilities and creativity:

  • Choose and orchestrate the right models to process and analyze multimodal data

  • Design and implement cutting-edge RAG techniques to efficiently handle large medical documents and patient histories

  • Build agentic systems to revolutionize key aspects of drug development such as patient recruitment or site selection

  • Work closely with cross-functional teams (software engineers, product managers, data engineers) to seamlessly integrate AI into our platform

  • Implement robust and scalable pipelines that meet production-grade engineering standards

Here are some examples of projects you might work on:

  • Our prescreening tool: an app relying on the latest reasoning models and visual RAG to accelerate patient recruitment. It's already being used across hundreds of clinical sites to assess patient eligibility at scale. You may find more on this in our publication: https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.15374

  • Our site selection agent: an agentic assistant coupled with a mathematical optimizer to assist pharmaceutical sponsors in their search for efficient clinical sites and find the right mix of sites for every study

💊 Qualifications

  • Several years of engineering experience with machine learning, data science, or AI at the centre of your work, not alongside it.

  • You’ve shipped LLM-based features (OpenAI, Anthropic, RAG setup, agent setup, LLM observability tools etc.) that real users use, and you’ve lived with them afterwards: fixed them when they broke, iterated when they underperformed, watched how people actually used them.

  • Python proficiency

  • Strong problem-solving skills

  • Strong communication skills, oral and written, both English and French

  • Strong product mindset able to challenge the product roadmap directly with our CPO

  • Knowledge about LLM’s evaluation challenges

  • Ability to autonomously deliver clean and production-ready code

🤩 Good fits we see often

  • ML engineers and data scientists who moved into LLM work as it matured.

  • Researchers who moved into production.

  • Software engineers who went deep on AI and stayed there.

😕 Probably not a fit

  • your AI work has been research, prototypes or POCs with nothing shipped and maintained in production.

  • you’ve spent most of your career in software engineering and shipped your first AI feature in the last year.

Why Inato?

Our mission is to make clinical trials more accessible and inclusive. We value diverse backgrounds and experiences, bringing together industry veterans with fresh perspectives to advance the clinical trials industry.

Join us at Inato and be part of a team that’s making a real difference in healthcare.

  • Remote-first philosophy & flexible hours

  • Top-of-the-line equipment

  • Modern free health insurance (Benefiz)

  • Compensatory time off (RTT)

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile)

  • Gym membership (Gymlib)

  • Free books & learning material

Treasury Analyst, Markets & Analytics
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
Do you want to work in an international investment fund promoting economic and social progress through commercial investments?

Impact Fund Denmark is Denmark’s largest impact fund and is internationally recognized as a best-in-class impact investor. We manage our own private equity funds, debt capital, and concessional capital with a focus on creating sustainable businesses that deliver measurable social, economic and climate impact alongside solid financial returns.

 

About the role

We are looking for a Treasury Analyst to join our Treasury team. The role sits at the intersection of financial markets, quantitative analysis, trading and technology. You will support treasury decision-making, execute and analyse financial transactions, develop and use the tools and data infrastructure used by the Treasury function.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Negotiate, execute and support FX, money-market, interest-rate and derivative transactions, including swaps and hedging activities.

  • Perform quantitative analysis of FX, interest-rate and liquidity risk via statistics and scenario analyses.

  • Develop models for cash-flow forecasting, liquidity management, pricing and risk/position management.

  • Develop and maintain Treasury analytics and reporting using SQL, Python, Power BI and/or Excel/VBA.

  • Extract, structure and analyse data from Treasury Risk/Position Systems, Investment Management Systems, ERP systems and market-data platforms.

  • Automate Treasury processes and controls and contribute to improvements in the Treasury IT architecture.

  • Support and pursue implementation and valuation of new financial products.

  • Monitor financial markets and provide analysis supporting funding, investment and hedging decisions.

 

Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science or similar.

  • Initial relevant work experience, for example 1–3 years' experience from a student job or up to 2 years full-time experience after graduation within Treasury, trading, financial markets and quantitative finance.

  • Practical experience with FX, interest rates, derivatives and/or money-market instruments.

  • Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities.

  • Experience with SQL and ideally Python, VBA or similar programming languages.

  • Understanding of databases, APIs, data structures and financial systems.

  • Experience with Treasury Management Systems, ERP systems, Investment Management Systems and market-data platforms is an advantage. Especially Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, Microsoft Dynamics platform/data structure and Bloomberg.

  • Ability to translate complex financial requirements into robust analytical and IT solutions.

  • Proficiency in English is required, while spoken Danish is an advantage.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and a service-minded approach to collaborating with colleagues and counterparties across countries and cultures. Experience working in an international organisation is considered an advantage.

 

We offer you employment in a unique organisation, where you will get experience working in an international business environment. The position is based in our headquarter Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø.

Please submit your application as soon as possible and no later than 18 November. We conduct interviews on a rolling basis.

jobs.title: Engineer with Administrative Background and interested in Aviation.
jobs.description:
AIR ALSIE A/S is a Danish aviation company headquartered in Sønderborg, Denmark. Our core business activities include flight operations, business aviation charter services and aircraft maintenance.

AIR ALSIE A/S is Scandinavia’s largest regional airline within the business aviation segment, and we are experiencing rapid growth and continuous development. As our organisation continues to expand, we are looking to strengthen our Technical Engineering team with a dedicated and skilled professional.

The Position

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Engineer or Aircraft Technician with a strong administrative mindset and an interest in aviation regulations and compliance.

The ideal candidate combines technical knowledge of aircraft maintenance with strong administrative skills and an understanding of regulatory requirements. You will play an important role in supporting and developing our technical organisation, ensuring that documentation, procedures and processes meet applicable aviation standards and regulatory requirements.

This position offers an exciting opportunity to work across technical and administrative functions, collaborate with colleagues throughout the organisation and contribute to the continued development of AIR ALSIE A/S.

Are you passionate about aviation and motivated by being part of a dedicated team working towards shared goals? Do you want to take responsibility, make a difference and contribute to the future development of AIR ALSIE A/S? Then we would like to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage, maintain and update technical documentation and records in accordance with applicable aviation regulations and authority requirements.

  • Maintain and update the Maintenance Organisation Exposition (MOE), ensuring continued compliance with relevant regulatory requirements.

  • Establish and maintain effective communication and cooperation with aviation authorities.

  • Coordinate and collaborate with internal departments on matters relating to flight operations and aircraft maintenance.

  • Support the development and implementation of improvements to aircraft maintenance processes, procedures and working methods.

  • Assist in the planning and coordination of aircraft maintenance programmes and resource allocation.

  • Support the development and maintenance of employee training, competency and qualification programmes.

  • Contribute to ensuring a high standard of regulatory compliance and operational efficiency across the organisation.

Your Profile and Qualifications

We are looking for a structured and proactive individual who enjoys working with both technical matters and administrative tasks.

Ideally, you bring:

  • An educational background in aircraft engineering, aircraft maintenance or a related technical field, combined with administrative experience.

  • Experience with aircraft maintenance procedures, processes and practices.

  • Knowledge of aviation regulations, compliance requirements and industry standards.

  • Strong organisational skills and a structured approach to documentation and administrative tasks.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across departments.

  • Proficiency in English, both written and spoken.

  • The ability to work independently, prioritise tasks and maintain an overview in a dynamic working environment.

  • A solution-oriented mindset and the ability to handle challenges efficiently.

  • An aircraft maintenance licence, certification or other relevant professional qualifications will be considered an advantage.

What We Offer

At AIR ALSIE A/S, you will become part of an ambitious and growing aviation company where your contribution matters.

We offer:

  • An exciting position in a dynamic and developing aviation industry.

  • A varied role with a combination of technical, administrative and regulatory responsibilities.

  • Opportunities for professional development, further training and relevant certifications.

  • A collaborative and supportive working environment with highly skilled and dedicated colleagues.

  • The opportunity to influence processes and contribute to the continued development of our technical organisation.

  • Competitive salary and employment conditions in accordance with your qualifications.

A Great Place to Work

At AIR ALSIE A/S, we believe that our employees are our greatest asset. We offer an informal working environment characterised by mutual respect, strong teamwork and a high level of professional expertise.

We strive to create an inspiring workplace where employees are encouraged to take responsibility, share their knowledge and continuously develop their skills and talents.

Our continued growth and success are driven by the commitment, expertise and dedication of our employees. We believe in working together, supporting one another and creating an environment where everyone has the opportunity to make a difference.

Would you like to be part of our journey?

We look forward to welcoming a new colleague to the AIR ALSIE team!

Visit our website www.alsie.com to read more about our company.

Questions

If any questions, feel free to contact Maintenance Manager Torsten Plank Lorentzen TPL@alsie.com or by phone +45 74429888.

Does This Sound Like the Right Opportunity for You?

If you recognise yourself in the profile described above and are motivated to take on the role of Engineer or Aircraft Technician at AIR ALSIE A/S, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Please submit your motivated application, CV and relevant educational certificates through our website at www.alsie.com.

Application deadline: 1 December 2026

We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will be conducted throughout the application period. The position will be filled as soon as we find the right candidate.

Please use the reference “Engineer or Aircraft Technician – 2026” when submitting your application.

We are looking for someone who can join our team as soon as possible, or by mutual agreement.

Interviews will take place at our offices in Sønderborg, Denmark.

We look forward to receiving your application and hopefully welcoming you to the AIR ALSIE team!

jobs.title: Head of Security - Fjord Base AS
jobs.description:
Fjord Base Gruppen er et konsern med ca. 100 ansatte bestående av 3 selskaper innenfor utvikling og drift av forsyningsbasen Fjord Base i Florø. Som Norges største forsyningsbase, med hele 65 selskap etablert på området, er vi et viktig knutepunkt mellom sjø og land. Vi tilbyr effektive havneoperasjoner og totale logistikkløsninger for offshore industrien. Vi er stolt av vår historie fra etableringen i 1985, som pålitelig leverandør til internasjonale selskaper og som en hjørnesteinsbedrift i Florø-samfunnet.

Fremover skal vi videreutvikle eksisterende aktivitet, og har klare vekstambisjoner. Vi skal styrke Fjord Base som logistikknutepunkt for offshore industrien, samtidig som vi skal legge til rette for nye grønne næringer. Vi har status som «Grønn Hub» for vår kapasitet til å lykkes med det grønne skiftet. Vi satser innenfor flere nye grønne industrier, med mål om å tilrettelegge for bærekraftig virksomhet og sirkulære verdikjeder.Vår visjon: Vi kobler mennesker og teknologi for å bygge fremtidens logistikkløsninger.

Vi ser nå en Head of Security / Leder Sikring til å bli med oss på laget!

Head of Security / Leder Sikring

Sikring er et stadig viktigere fagområde for Fjord Base Gruppen, og en sentral del av fundamentet for sikker og robust drift. Som et stort logistikknutepunkt med mange aktører, kunder og samarbeidspartnere stilles det høye krav til hvordan vi arbeider med sikring og risikostyring. Samtidig er fagområdet i stadig utvikling, og økte krav gjør at vi ønsker å styrke dette arbeidet ytterligere. Vi søker derfor en leder for sikring til en nøkkelrolle i den videre utviklingen av sikringsarbeidet hos oss. Vil du være med å drive dette arbeidet fremover? Da kan dette være stillingen for deg!

Dine ansvarsområder:

Som leder for sikring får du et overordnet ansvar for å drive og videreutvikle sikringsarbeidet i Fjord Base Gruppen. Rollen er både strategisk og operativ, og innebærer både eget fagansvar, samt koordinering på tvers av fagområder, eksterne samarbeidspartnere og kunder. Du vil ha gode faglige støttespillere rundt deg, samtidig som du har en nøkkelrolle i å sikre helhet, fremdrift og systematikk i arbeidet. Sentrale oppgaver vil blant annet være:

  • Ansvarlig for ISPS-sikring ved Fjord Base og ivaretakelse av rollen som PFSO (Port Facility Security Officer)

  • Overordnet ansvar for konsernets øvrige sikringsarbeid, herunder ON091, og koordinering mot relevante fagområder som cybersikkerhet, personellsikring og beredskap

  • Drive utvikling og forbedring av konsernets sikringsarbeid

  • Følge opp overordnede risikovurderinger, sikringsrisikoanalyse, krav og tiltak, og bidra til at disse omsettes til gode løsninger i konsernet

  • Sikre at styrende dokumentasjon og planer er oppdatert og relevant

  • Være en sentral kontaktperson innen sikring overfor kunder, myndigheter og samarbeidspartnere

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som har relevant kompetanse innen sikring, og som har stor interesse og innsikt i fagområdene. Du har høy grad av integritet og etisk bevissthet. Vi ser for oss at du eksempelvis har erfaring fra politi, forsvaret, eller fra andre virksomheter med tydelige krav til sikring, beredskap og risikostyring. Vi tror du har:

  • Relevant høyere utdanning og erfaring innen sikring, sikkerhet og beredskap

  • God forståelse for risiko, forebyggende sikringsarbeid og regelverksforståelse

  • Gjerne erfaring fra komplekse virksomheter eller miljøer med høye krav til sikkerhet og sikring

  • Erfaring med ISPS og rolle som PFSO vil være en fordel, men ikke et krav

For å lykkes og trives i rollen så ser vi for oss at du er initiativrik, har høy grad av struktur, og er trygg i møte med ulike mennesker og fagmiljøer. Du evner å se helheten, samtidig som du sørger for fremdrift og følger opp det som er viktig. Du bygger gode relasjoner, kommuniserer tydelig, og har høy integritet og god rolleforståelse. Vi ser ikke etter noen som kan alt fra første dag. Vi ser etter deg som har et solid faglig fundament, er lærevillig, og som motiveres av å holde deg oppdatert og drive sikringsarbeidet videre i et fagområde i kontinuerlig utvikling.

Hva kan vi tilby deg?

Vi kan tilby en nøkkelrolle med stor påvirkning på vårt arbeid med sikring fremover, og å kunne bidra til gode og helhetlige løsninger sammen med et solid fagmiljø. Du blir en del av et sosialt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med dyktige kolleger i et konsern med høyt fokus på utvikling av våre ansatte. Vi tilbyr også gode velferdsordninger, blant annet treningsrom, Florø’s beste kantine, og hytte på Stranda – for å nevne noe! Vi har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.Stillingen har arbeidssted i våre lokaler i Florø. Det vil bli gjennomført bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater som en del av ansettelsesprosessen. Er du nysgjerrig på om dette kan være stillingen for deg? Ta gjerne kontakt med en av våre rådgivere hos Visere AS:Asbjørn Grini – 917 94 825 / Asbjorn@visere.noDaniel Klakegg Dvergsdal – 904 79 470 / Daniel@visere.no Vi ser frem til å motta din søknad og CV innen 29. november 2026.

jobs.title: Facility Manager
jobs.description:
Om rollen 🚀

Vi søker nå en Facility Manager til en tidsbegrenset stilling hos en av våre internasjonale kunder i Norge. Du vil være basert på kontoret til et globalt selskap innen teknologi og profesjonelle tjenester, i et dynamisk og internasjonalt arbeidsmiljø.

Som Facility Manager vil du ha ansvar for den daglige Facility Management-leveransen på lokasjonen og sørge for at arbeidsplassen fungerer effektivt, sikkert og med høy kvalitet.

Du vil være kundens primære kontaktperson innen Facility Management og samarbeide tett med leverandører, servicepartnere og resten av Four FM-organisasjonen. Lede, støtte og følge opp Facility Coordinator på samme lokasjon og sørge for tydelige prioriteringer, godt samarbeid og høy kvalitet i tjenesteleveransen.

Rollen kombinerer operativt ansvar med koordinering av medarbeidere, kundeoppfølging, oppfølging av tjenester og kontinuerlig forbedringsarbeid.

Du vil blant annet: ✨

• Ha ansvar for den daglige Facility Management-driften på lokasjonen.

• Lede, støtte og koordinere Facility Coordinator på lokasjonen.

• Være kundens primære kontaktperson og bygge gode relasjoner med relevante interessenter.

• Koordinere og følge opp leverandører og eksterne servicepartnere.

• Sikre at tjenester leveres i henhold til avtalte kvalitetsstandarder, KPI-er og SLA-er.

• Følge opp kostnader og bidra til god budsjettoppfølging og økonomisk kontroll.

• Sikre etterlevelse av relevante HMS-rutiner, sikkerhetskrav og lokale bestemmelser.

• Håndtere daglige operative utfordringer på en proaktiv og løsningsorientert måte.

• Sikre at avtalte prosesser, rutiner og arbeidsmetoder følges.

• Identifisere og drive kontinuerlige forbedringer for å styrke kvalitet, effektivitet og den totale arbeidsplassopplevelsen.

Kort sagt: Du sørger for at arbeidsplassen fungerer godt, at teamet på lokasjonen får støtten og retningen de trenger, og at kunden mottar profesjonelle Facility Management-tjenester av høy kvalitet.

Dette er deg! 🎯

Du er en strukturert, serviceinnstilt og løsningsorientert person som trives med å ta ansvar og sørge for at ting fungerer.

Du er komfortabel med å jobbe i et kundenært miljø og kan veksle mellom planlegging, koordinering, oppfølging og håndtering av daglige operative utfordringer. Du liker å støtte andre og kan gi tydelig retning, samtidig som du samarbeider tett med kolleger, leverandører og andre interessenter.

Du kommuniserer godt med mennesker på ulike nivåer og har et naturlig fokus på kvalitet, service og kontinuerlig forbedring.

Vi tror at du har:

  • Erfaring innen Facility Management, workplace services, eiendomsdrift eller en lignende serviceorientert virksomhet.

  • Erfaring med å koordinere, støtte eller lede medarbeidere i et operativt miljø.

  • Erfaring med å jobbe tett med kunder og håndtere ulike interessenter.

  • Erfaring med å koordinere og følge opp leverandører og servicepartnere.

  • God forståelse for HMS og trygge arbeidsmetoder.

  • Forståelse for budsjett, kostnadsoppfølging og økonomisk kontroll.

  • En strukturert, proaktiv og selvstendig arbeidsform.

  • Gode digitale ferdigheter og trygghet i bruk av ulike systemer og verktøy.

  • Gode kommunikasjons- og relasjonsbyggende ferdigheter.

  • Flytende norsk- og engelskkunnskaper, både skriftlig og muntlig.

  • Kunnskap om teknisk Facility Management og grunnleggende forståelse for tekniske bygningssystemer er en fordel.

Hvorfor du vil trives hos oss ✨

Hos Four FM blir du en del av et selskap hvor du får tillit og reelt ansvar. Vi verdsetter initiativ, kvalitet og samarbeid, og gir medarbeiderne våre mulighet til å forme sine roller og bidra til hvordan vi utvikler tjenestene våre.

Verdiene våre C.A.R.E. – Compassion, Attention, Respect & Excellence – veileder oss i alt vi gjør. Vi bryr oss om mennesker, har fokus på detaljene og er stolte av å levere tjenester av høy kvalitet til kundene våre.

Praktisk informasjon 👩‍🏫

Arbeidstid:

Heltid, hovedsakelig innenfor ordinær kontortid, med noe fleksibilitet basert på driftsmessige behov.

Ansettelsesform:

Arbeidssted:

Hos kunden på Lysaker.

Oppstart:

Så snart som mulig / etter avtale.

Søknad:

Siste søknadsfrist: 14.12.2026

Vi gjennomfører utvelgelse og intervjuer fortløpende, så vi oppfordrer deg til å sende inn søknaden din så snart som mulig.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Four FM er et nordisk facility management-selskap som leverer skreddersydde tjenester til bedrifter og eiendomsbesittere.

Vi samarbeider med selskaper som bryr seg om merkevaren sin, menneskene sine og miljøene de opererer i. Som partner – ikke bare leverandør – leverer vi fleksible løsninger med en sterk serviceinnstilling, veiledet av vår filosofi: We Take C.A.R.E.

jobs.title: HYPOXI-ohjaaja, Liikunta-ohjaaja
jobs.description: HYPOXI on luonnollinen menetelmä, jossa yhdistyvät kevyt liikunta ja alipaine. Sen avulla rasvanpolttoa voidaan kohdistaa kehon niin sanotuille ongelma-alueille. Studiollamme asiakkaat eivät jää yksin, paikalla on aina HYPOXI-ohjaaja.Nyt etsimme Turun studiolle osa-aikaista studio-ohjaajaa.Työ sijoittuu pääasiassa iltapäivään ja iltaan, ja tunteja kertyy noin 50-90 h/kk.Miltä työpäiväsi voi näyttää?- Otat asiakkaat vastaan ja luot heille tervetulleen fiiliksen - Ohjaat ja opastat HYPOXI-laitteiden käytössä - Huolehdit ajanvarauksista ja sujuvasta arjesta studiolla - Pidät yhteyttä asiakkaisiin puhelimitse ja sähköpostilla Voisit olla etsimämme henkilö, jos:- Nautit ihmisten kohtaamisesta ja hyvä asiakaskokemus on sinulle tärkeää - Sinulla on kiinnostusta liikuntaan, hyvinvointiin ja terveellisiin elämäntapoihin - Olet energinen, ulospäinsuuntautunut ja tulet toimeen erilaisten ihmisten kanssa - Pystyt työskentelemään itsenäisesti ja ottamaan vastuuta - Voit laskuttaa työsi (esim. kevytyrittäjänä tai oman yrityksen kautta) Et tarvitse valmista HYPOXI-osaamista me koulutamme sinut tehtävään. Liikunta-, ravinto- tai terveysalan tausta on plussaa, mutta ei pakollinen.Plussaa, jos olet jo hyvinvointialalla: Jos työskentelet esimerkiksi hierojana, voit yhdistää tämän työn nykyiseen työhösi. Meillä on mahdollisuus tarjota tiloistamme huone myös omaa asiakastyötäsi varten.Kuulostaako sinulta? Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemus (kerrothan siinä itsestäsi, taustastasi ja miksi kiinnostuit) osoitteeseen riina@hypoxi.fi. Otsikoksi: HYPOXI-ohjaaja TURKU

jobs.title: Svenskspråkig vårdare åt sympatisk kund på Kimitoön
jobs.description: **Vårdare till en sympatisk svenskspråkig kund**Vi söker en vårdare för deltidsarbete med uppgift att hjälpa vår sympatiska kund på Kimitoön. Besöken sker en gång i veckan.Vill du arbeta deltid som vårdassistent, i lugn takt och utan sjukvårdsuppgifter, tillsammans med trevliga äldre personer? Då kan du vara vår nästa vård helppare!Vi är Hemby, ett företag som modigt förnyar vård tjänster och erbjuder glädje och trygghet i vardagen. Vårt motto är: **Vi hjälper kunden som om de vore vår egen mamma.**Vi växer ständigt och söker fler helppare till vårt team med utbildning inom vård och omsorg. Du hittar vårt korta och lätt ifyllda ansökningsformulär här: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply**Vad gör en vård helppare?**En vård helppare är en person med utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen som erbjuder vardaglig hjälp och sällskap åt sin egen utsedda senior. Vård helpparen stöder kunden i olika vardagssysslor, såsom promenader och butiksbesök, skötsel av hemmet, stöd vid måltider, ledsagning, samvaro och samtal.Vård helpparen stöder kundens välbefinnande på ett helhetsmässigt sätt. Vård- och omsorgsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat:- hjälp vid dusch - uppföljning av hur senioren mår - stöd för att klara sig hemma - stöd vid förflyttning och rörlighet Du kan också hjälpa kunden med dusch och personlig hygien. Arbetet omfattar dock inte sjukvårdsuppgifter, såsom läkemedelsbehandling.**Vad krävs av en vård helppare?**Framför allt en stark vilja att hjälpa såna som behöver stöd. Dessutom kräver arbetet som vård helppare en utbildning inom social- och hälsovårdsbranschen eller som vårdassistent, alternativt gedigen erfarenhet av arbete som vårdassistent.Det viktigaste är att du vill tycker om att spendera tid och sällskapa med andra människor och genom ditt arbete göra deras vardag bättre. Du kan anpassa arbetet efter din egen livssituation och arbetstiderna är mycket flexibla.Vad är det bästa med arbetet som vård helppare?Vi frågade våra vård helppare och fick bland annat följande svar:Att möta människor utan stress och att bli vänner med kunden.Att hjälpa en annan människa och känna att det man gör är meningsfullt.Att hjälpa kunden på ett helhetsmässigt sätt utifrån hens behov.Som vård helppare får du:- **En egen utsedd kund** som du hjälper med vardagliga sysslor och håller sällskap. - **Flexibla arbetstider** som passar utmärkt exempelvis vid sidan av studier eller som extraarbete. Den vanligaste arbetstiden är 2–10 timmar per vecka. - **Konkurrenskraftig lön:** 15,29–17,29 €/h + tillägg enligt kollektivavtal samt semesterersättning. - **Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter:** Med erfarenhet och god kundrespons kan du avancera till pro- eller guru-helpper och få en högre lön! Ansökningar skickas in via det elektroniska ansökningsformuläret. Vi kontaktar alla sökande efter att ansökan har skickats in.Om du har frågor om att bli vårdar-helppare, skicka ett e-postmeddelande till **rekry@hemby.fi**, så berättar vi gärna mer!

jobs.title: Customer Success Engineer, Singapore
Part-time Driver Råde
jobs.employer: ODA NORWAY AS AVD OSLO DISTRIBUSJON
jobs.description:
At Oda, we come to work every day with the goal of creating affordable grocery services to make the logistics of living surprisingly easy for our customers in Norway and Sweden. That’s what gets us fired up. First, we built Norway’s leading online grocery store and now, partnered with Mathem in Sweden, we’re on our way to becoming the world’s most effective retail system. With our wide selection and competitive prices, we deliver to the doorsteps of thousands of Scandinavian homes every week.

Would you like to join us as a driver in Råde on weekends?

As a driver with us, you play an essential role in representing Oda to our customers. You will be part of our dedicated team of drivers and report to the Delivery Operating Manager and the Delivery Team Leaders on-site. You’ll be delivering groceries and packages to our many customers in the area. We believe you'll like working as a driver at Oda if you can manage your time effectively, work independently and in a team, and approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. Additionally, it would be best to enjoy being active, as this job involves a lot of physical activity, not only driving.

What you’ll be doing as a Driver 🚚

  • Delivering food and packages to our customers.

  • Maintain efficiency and quality in our work by loading and unloading goods, handling customers, and implementing routines and processes.

  • Ensuring Customer service at the highest level.

  • Be responsible for simple maintenance of the car fleet, such as changing light bulbs, topping up liquids, and keeping the cars clean and presentable at all times.

  • Training new drivers on the road.

  • Contributing to the improvement of driver routines and processes.

What you’ll need to succeed 🌟

  • Driving license (Class B) with a minimum of 2 year's driving experience.

  • Speaking English is required, and familiarity with Norwegian or another Nordic language is a plus.

What would be nice to have 💡

  • Are active and like it, as this is a physically demanding job

  • Likes working independently and with a team

  • Have a good work ethic

  • Are service-oriented and solution-oriented.

  • Have a genuine desire to succeed and make customers happy

  • Responsible and prioritizes safe behaviour in traffic

What we offer 🚀

This is your chance to make a real impact as a Driver in a fast-moving company with a product people love—while shaking up the grocery industry. You’ll experience:

  • Teammates who aim high and have each other’s backs. We care about people, and that means supporting each other every step of the way.

  • A flat structure where we team up across disciplines to solve exciting challenges. Big ideas come from everywhere!

  • A transparent way of working. We use Slack to stay in the loop—less email, fewer meetings, more getting things done.

Practical informationℹ️

  • Application deadline: 27.11.2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the process once we find the right candidates, so we encourage you to apply as early as possible.

  • Starting date: As soon as possible

  • Location: Industriveien 4, 1640 Råde

  • Working hours: Part-time 20% position, working every other weekend: Saturday 05:30-13:30 and Sunday 13:30-21:30.

At Oda, you’ll join a passionate, ambitious team working to change the future of grocery shopping. We’re all different—just like you—and we wouldn’t have it any other way. If you need any adjustments or support during the application process, just let us know, and we’ll do our best to help. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and want everyone to have an equal shot at landing the job.

Come build the future of grocery with us! Want to know more about how we work? Check out these posts on Medium!

As part of our work to ensure a fair and open-minded recruitment process, we have chosen to collaborate with Hubert.ai, a virtual recruitment assistant that helps with the selection process. As soon as you submit an application for this position, you will be invited via email to a chat-based interview. Therefore, be careful to enter your correct email address so that the invitation reaches the right person🤖

We can’t wait to hear from you! 🧡

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Oda is the leading online grocery retailer in Norway, but as a company, we’re first and foremost an ambitious tech and logistics company - not a classic retailer. We’re one of the fastest-growing startups in the Nordics, working with huge, complex challenges to make the lives of our customers simpler and easier. Want to join us? Our goal is to create the world's most efficient retail system. Through smart work, passionate customer focus and our own technology we make a difference in the lives of thousands of customers and change society for the better through a completely re-imagined value chain for grocery shopping. Our customers save more than 60 hours a year, time we believe can be better spent than going to the store. Our effective value chain and logistics save society tonnes of food waste each year and our distribution network replace almost 13,000 individual trips by car to the grocery store each year.

jobs.title: Suuhygienisti, Suun terveydenhuolto, Kaarina
jobs.description: Meillä Varhalla pääset osaksi mukavaa ja kehittymismyönteistä työyhteisöä, jossa arvostamme osaamistasi ja tuemme ammatillista kasvuasi. Tule mukaan!TehtäväsiSuuhygienistinä työskentelet itsenäisesti suun terveyden edistämisen ja hoidon parissa. Toimit oman alasi asiantuntijana ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä suun terveydenhuollon ammattilaisten sekä muiden yhteistyötahojen kanssa. Tehtäviisi kuuluu myös uusien työntekijöiden perehdyttämistä ja opiskelijoiden käytännön harjoittelun ohjaamista.Pääasiallinen työpisteesi sijaitsee Kaarinan suun terveydenhuollossa, mutta työskentelet tarvittaessa myös Varhan muilla vastaanotoilla. Halutessasi sinulla on mahdollisuus päästä työskentelemään myös liikkuvissa palveluissamme, mikä tuo mukavaa vaihtelua ja monipuolisuutta työhösi.Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?Meillä pääset osaksi energistä ja toimintaansa aktiivisesti kehittävää moniammatillista työyhteisöä. Varhan suun terveydenhuollossa työskentelee yli 700 alan ammattilaista, joten ympärilläsi on laaja joukko osaavia kollegoita, joiden kanssa voit jakaa kokemuksia ja kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi.Tarjoamme sinulle kattavan perehdytyksen sekä kollegoiden ja esihenkilöiden jatkuvan tuen. Pääset hyödyntämään omaa osaamistasi monipuolisesti ja osallistumaan myös toimintamme kehittämiseen. Meille on tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi, voit hyvin ja saat mahdollisuuksia ammatilliseen kasvuun.Mitä odotamme sinulta?Voit olla urasi alkuvaiheessa tai jo kokenut suuhygienisti. Tärkeintä meille on, että suhtaudut työhösi innostuneesti ja haluat olla mukana tarjoamassa potilaillemme mahdollisimman hyvää hoitoa.Arvostamme hyviä yhteistyötaitoja, joustavaa työskentelyotetta ja halua kehittää omaa osaamistasi. Monipuolinen kokemus suuhygienistin työstä tukee tehtävässä onnistumista, mutta ennen kaikkea toivomme sinulta sitoutumista työhösi, oma-aloitteisuutta ja myönteistä suhtautumista yhteiseen tekemiseen.Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain 559/94 mukainen laillistus (suuhygienisti AMK tai aikaisempi vastaava tutkinto).Lisäksi edellytämme hyvää suomen kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa. Arvostamme hyvää ruotsin kielen taitoa.Kiinnostuitko? Tule mukaan osaavaan ja kehittyvään työyhteisöömme! Jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana. Odotamme innolla hakemustasi!

- Pripravuje prijímateľa na lekárske vyšetrenie a podľa potreby ho sprevádza na vyšetrenie, ošetrenie alebo inú zdravotnú službu.
- Pri bezprostrednom ohrození života alebo zdravia poskytuje prvú pomoc v rozsahu svojej odbornej prípravy, privolá odbornú pomoc alebo záchrannú zdravotnú službu a postupuje podľa interných krízových a bezpečnostných postupov.
- Podporuje prijímateľa pri bežných činnostiach spojených s vedením domácnosti, najmä pri plánovaní a realizácii nákupu, príprave a podávaní jedla, umývaní riadu, upratovaní, vetraní, starostlivosti o lôžko a bielizeň, triedení odpadu a bezpečnom používaní domácich spotrebičov; ak prijímateľ činnosť nezvládne, vykoná ju v potrebnom rozsahu.
- Zabezpečuje primeranú čistotu, hygienu, poriadok a bezpečnosť spoločných priestorov komunitnej domácnosti v rozsahu pracovných úloh a interných postupov, vrátane hygienickej manipulácie so stravou, bielizňou, riadom a opatrovateľskými pomôckami.

jobs.title: Projektipäällikkö, korjausrakentaminen
jobs.description: Oletko kokenut korjausrakentamisen asiantuntija ja mietit uusia uramahdollisuuksia? Etsimme nyt Ouluun vakituiseen työsuhteeseen projektipäällikköä vaativiin korjausrakentamisen hankkeisiin. Mitä tehtävä sisältää? Projektipäällikkönä työskentelet monipuolisissa korjausrakentamisen hankkeissa omien vahvuuksiesi ja osaamisesi mukaisessa roolissa. Taustastasi riippuen tehtäväsi painottuvat esimerkiksi rakennusteknisiin tutkimuksiin, rakennesuunnitteluun, rakennuttamiseen tai valvontaan. Sinun ei siis tarvitse olla kaikkien osa-alueiden asiantuntija, vaan tehtävänkuvaa rakennetaan osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi pohjalta. Toimit asiakkaidemme asiantuntijana ja vastaat oman roolisi mukaisesti hankkeiden koordinoinnista ja ohjauksesta. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä yli toimialarajojemme, asiakkaiden, suunnittelijoiden, urakoitsijoiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa varmistaen, että hankkeet etenevät sovittujen tavoitteiden, aikataulun, kustannusten ja määräysten mukaisesti. Kulttuurimme kulmakiviä on tutkitusti ystävällinen työyhteisö ja matala hierarkia. Toimit osana monialaista korjausrakentamisen tiimiä, josta saat työkavereiksesi eri alojen asiantuntijoita. Vahva paikallinen yhteishenki ja tekeminen yhdistettynä valtakunnalliseen yhteistyöhön eri toimistojemme välillä tuo toimintaamme ketteryyttä, jota nopeasti muuttuvissa tilanteissakin tarvitaan. Päätökset teemme siellä, missä se on nopeinta ja kulloinkin järkevintä – tiimit on asetettu meillä päätöksenteon keskiöön. Talon sisäinen yhteistyö ja osaamisen jakaminen mahdollistavat sinulle pääsyn myös muiden alueiden hankkeisiin. Oulun toimistomme sijaitsee hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella keskustan kupeessa, jossa meillä on modernit toimisto- ja neuvottelutilat sekä viihtyisät taukotilat. Työsi on liikkuvaa ja kohteet sijaitsevat Pohjois-Suomessa, pääosin Oulun seudulla. Avaimia tehtävässä menestymiseen Odotamme sinulta vähintään viiden vuoden kokemusta vaativista korjausrakentamisen hankkeista sekä näyttöjä onnistuneesta asiakastyöstä. Sinulla on kokemusta pitkäjänteisestä yhteistyöstä asiakkaiden kanssa ja kykyä rakentaa luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita sekä tunnistaa asiakkaiden tulevia tarpeita. Sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulututkinto, kuten rakennustekniikan insinöörin (AMK/YAMK) tai diplomi-insinöörin tutkinto tai muu soveltuva koulutus. Kokemuksesi painottuu kiinteistöihin ja voi painottua esimerkiksi tutkimukseen, suunnitteluun, projektinjohtoon, rakennuttamiseen tai valvontaan. Tärkeintä on vahva osaaminen omalla alueellasi sekä kokemus vastuullisesta roolista korjaushankkeissa. Arvostamme kykyä hallita kokonaisuuksia ja viedä hankkeita tavoitteellisesti eteenpäin yhteistyössä asiakkaiden ja muiden hankkeen osapuolten kanssa. Arvostamme myös RTA-, RAP-, RAV- tai KHK-pätevyyksiä. Meille on tärkeää asiakaslähtöinen, yhteistyökykyinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen työskentelytapa. Olet oma-aloitteinen ja vastuullinen ammattilainen, joka kuuntelee muita ja tuo samalla rohkeasti esiin omat näkemyksensä. Haluat oppia uutta, kehittää osaamistasi ja jakaa sitä myös muiden kanssa. Mitä lupaamme sinulle - Transforming society together. Swecolla olet mukana luomassa tulevaisuuden kaupunkeja ja kestävämpää yhteiskuntaa – olet oikeasti vaikuttamassa.- Maailma avoinna. Swecolaisia on yhteensä 23 000 ympäri Euroopan, ja Suomessa meitä on 28 paikkakunnalla 3 300 henkeä. Kansainvälinen ja laaja organisaatiomme tarjoaa mahdollisuuksia työskennellä eurooppalaisten kollegojen kanssa – tai vaihtaa toimipistettä Suomessa elämäntilanteesi mukaan.- Oma urapolku ja koulutusmahdollisuudet. Meille on tärkeää, että pääset kehittymään ja suunnittelemaan omannäköistä urapolkua ja tässä me kuuntelemme sinua. Monipuolisia koulutusmahdollisuuksia sinulle tarjoaa oma Sweco Akatemiamme - Monipuolinen ja kattava henkilöstöetukokonaisuus, jonka sisältöön pystyt itse vaikuttamaan. - Työnantajana olemme joustava, ja työsi ja yksityiselämäsi kestävä yhteensovittaminen on meille prioriteetti. Mikäli mielessäsi on kysymyksiä tehtävään tai meillä työskentelyyn liittyen, tiimipäällikkö Anssi Pöllänen juttelee mielellään kanssasi lisää. 	Zabezpečuje plánované výkony základnej ošetrovateľskej starostlivosti v jednotlivých fázach ošetrovateľského procesu pri uspokojovaní bio - psycho – sociálnych potrieb klienta v spolupráci so sestrou. Pracuje formou pozorovania a zbierania informácií

-	Vykonáva ošetrovateľské úkony v kompetencii praktickej sestry
-	Zodpovedá za objednávanie liekov a zdravotníckych pomôcok
-	Vedie zdravotnú dokumentáciu v systéme Caresse
-	Zastupuje vedúcu zdravotného úseku v čase jej neprítomnosti
-	Zabezpečuje dodržiavanie bezpečného prostredia klienta a ochranu intimity pri poskytovaní základnej starostlivosti
-	Zabezpečuje hygienu prostredia vrátane dezinfekcie zdravotníckych pomôcok,  manipuluje s čistou a znečistenou bielizňou
-	Vykonáva prvú pomoc podľa svojich odborných schopností a zabezpečuje ďalšiu odbornú pomoc
-	Vykonáva hygienickú starostlivosť o pacienta (celkový kúpeľ, starostlivosť o ústnu dutinu, vlasy, nechta) a vykonáva starostlivosť o lôžko
-	Vykonáva činnosti na prevenciu vzniku syndrómu z imobility ( polohovanie, starostlivosť o pohybový režim pacienta) , vykonáva starostlivosť o kožu
-	Aplikuje zábaly, obklady, liečivé kúpele, aplikuje teplé a studené procedúry, lieky na kožu a telových dutín, podáva klystíry, zhotovuje bandáž dolných končatín, pripravuje obväzové materiály
-	Podáva stravu, sleduje príjem potravy a tekutín – zaznamenáva
-	zabezpečuje starostlivosť o vyprázdňovanie hrubého čreva a močového mechúra, stará sa o zavedené permanentné močové katétre, sleduje bilanciu tekutín
-	Vykonáva meranie a záznam fyziologických funkcií pacientov
-	Zaznamenáva zrealizované výkony do dokumentácie klienta
-	Plní pokyny svojho nariadeného 
-	Vykonáva manuálne činnosti v súvislosti s transportom zomretého pacienta
-	Dodržiava pracovnú disciplínu, etický kódex sestry, dôvernosť informácií v súvislosti s pracovným výkonom, hájenie prác klienta v rámci zariadenia

jobs.title: Majstri (supervízori) v priemyselnej výrobe
jobs.description:
Hľadáme skúseného a technicky zdatného kolegu na pozíciu výrobný majster – zástupca vedúceho prevádzky, ktorý bude zodpovedný za organizáciu, riadenie a kontrolu výrobných a opravárenských činností v oblasti železničného opravárenstva.

Hľadáme človeka s prirodzenou autoritou, praktickými skúsenosťami zo strojárskej výroby alebo údržby, schopnosťou viesť tím a záujmom o zvyšovanie efektivity, kvality a produktivity práce. Dôležitá je schopnosť prepájať každodenné riadenie výroby s princípmi Lean managementu, 5S a neustáleho zlepšovania procesov.

Náplň práce:

    Organizovanie, koordinácia a kontrola každodenných výrobných a opravárenských činností.

    Riadenie a operatívne vedenie výrobných majstrov, prideľovanie úloh a kontrola ich plnenia.

    Zabezpečenie dodržiavania technologických postupov, pracovných inštrukcií, kvalitatívnych požiadaviek a termínov.

    Dohľad nad efektívnym využívaním pracovníkov, strojov, zariadení, materiálu a výrobných kapacít.

    Spolupráca s vedúcim prevádzky, technológmi, oddelením kvality, údržbou a logistikou.

    Operatívne riešenie výrobných problémov, prestojov, nezhôd a nedostatkov v pracovných postupoch.

    Aktívne zavádzanie a udržiavanie princípov Lean managementu, 5S a štandardizácie práce.

    Identifikácia plytvania, úzkych miest a príležitostí na zlepšenie výrobných procesov.

    Sledovanie produktivity, kvality, plnenia plánov a efektívnosti výroby.

    Dohľad nad dodržiavaním BOZP, požiarnej ochrany, poriadku na pracovisku a bezpečnej práce so strojmi a zariadeniami.

    Spoluúčasť na plánovaní kapacít, optimalizácii pracovných postupov a zlepšovaní organizácie pracovísk.

    Zastupovanie vedúceho prevádzky v čase jeho neprítomnosti a podpora pri riadení prevádzky.Výhody:ubytovanie, - práca v stabilnej spoločnosti s dlhoročnou tradíciou

Pre úspešnú slovenskú módnu návrhárku hľadáme šikovnú a detailne orientovanú krajčírku, ktorá má vášeň pre módu a nebojí sa krajčírskeho remesla na najvyššej úrovni.Ak radi pracujete s kvalitnými materiálmi a chcete vidieť výsledky svojej práce na prehliadkových mólach či exkluzívnych klientoch, poďte pracovať do nášho ateliéru!Náplň práce: v čom budete vynikať?•    Kompletné šitie modelov (od spoločenských šiat až po limitované každodenné kolekcie) podľa návrhov a strihových predlôh.•    Práca s luxusnými a jemnými materiálmi (hodváb, čipka, vlna, satén).•    Úprava a dopasovanie modelov priamo na mieru zákazníčkam počas skúšok.•    Spolupráca s módnou návrhárkou pri realizácii nových nápadov a detailov.•    Ručné práce a precízne finálne úpravy (našívanie aplikácií, gombíkov, začisťovanie). Čo od vás očakávame?•    Vzdelanie alebo prax v odbore (vyučenie v odbore krajčír/ka alebo preukázateľné skúsenosti so šitím).•    Skúsenosť s prácou v módnom ateliéri alebo so zákazkovým šitím (veľkou výhodou).•    Znalosť technológie šitia a ovládanie priemyselných šijacích strojov (overlock,rovnosteh)•    Zmysel pre detail, presnosť a trpezlivosť – každý steh u nás musí byť dokonalý.•    Flexibilita a cit pre estetiku. Čo vám ponúkame?•    Inšpiratívne prostredie moderného a kreatívneho módneho ateliéru.•    Práca na jedinečných projektoch, žiadna stereotypná pásová výroba.•    Prístup k najnovším módnym trendom a exkluzívnym materiálom.•    Flexibilný pracovný čas (podľa dohody).•    Motivujúce finančné ohodnotenie závislé od vašich skúseností a kvality odvedenej práce.•    Zamestnanecká zľava na modely z našej dielne.Miesto výkonu práce: Rimavská SobotaDruh pracovného pomeru: TPP / Skrátený úväzokMzdové podmienky: Dohodou (v závislosti od skúseností)

Notre philosophie est simple : nous gérons les biens de nos clients comme s'il s'agissait de nos propres biens. La House of Sustainability est une initiative de la Chambre de Commerce visant à soutenir et à faciliter la transition durable des entreprises luxembourgeoises. Elle informe, sensibilise et accompagne les entreprises sur les enjeux de durabilité au moyen d'une offre de services dédiée. Celle-ci comprend notamment des événements, des ressources, des formations, des programmes d'accompagnement et des aides financier/ières. Au-delà de sa propre offre, la House of Sustainability constitue également un premier point de contact sur les questions de durabilité et oriente les entreprises vers les initiatives et les acteurs pertinents de l'écosystème. Au sein de la House of Sustainability de la Chambre de Commerce, le Decarbonisation & Energy Transition Advisor accompagne les entreprises ressortissant/antes dans leurs démarches de décarbonation et de transition énergétique, dans le cadre du programme Klimapakt fir Betriber (KPB).En tant que point de contact privilégié, il/elle sensibilise les entreprises aux enjeux et opportunités liés à la décarbonation et la transition énergétique. Le rôle consiste ainsi à convaincre les entreprises ressortissant/antes de la Chambre de Commerce des opportunités offertes par la transition énergétique et la décarbonation, afin de réduire leurs coûts d'exploitation, de renforcer leur compétitivité et leur résilience, tout en diminuant leur dépendance aux énergies fossiles. jobs.title: AML Officer (H/F)
jobs.description: Acteur majeur dans les secteurs télécoms, postaux et financiers, le groupe POST Luxembourg est un pilier incontournable de l'économie luxembourgeoise. L'entreprise propose, à travers son métier POST Finance, des services de paiement via des comptes courants, transferts d'argent et cartes bancaires à une large clientèle de particuliers, d'entreprises et d'associations.  Depuis , POST Finance est la banque de tous et nous voulons le rester. Nous assumons notre rôle spécial d'inclusion sociale dans le paysage financier et nous en sommes fiers. Nous sommes engagés à donner un accès à tous à des services de paiement sûrs et simples à utiliser. Notre engagement est également d'offrir nos services en respectant les principes de responsabilité sociale et environnementale à travers une tarification simple et transparente, et une politique d'investissement plus durable, éthique et sociale. Dans le cadre de notre nouvelle stratégie dont l'objectif est de transformer notre infrastructure sur base des nouvelles technologies disponibles, de créer un nouvel élan commercial et d'améliorer l'expérience client, nous recherchons de nouveaux talents agiles, dynamiques et avec un esprit disruptif. Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons actuellement pour le département Compliance un (e) AML officer (m/f/n) Vos missions Analyser les dossiers clients sous l'angle LBC/FT et de la conformité fiscale (FATCA, CRS, DAC6) en formulant des avis motivés et des recommandations argumentées, structurées et synthétiques Effectuer des contrôles continus et rigoureux des dossiers clients et leur screening (sanctions, PEP et Adverse media) réguliers dans le cadre du plan de contrôles Analyser les structures de sociétés, simples et complexes et analyser leurs flux transactionnels internes, soit dans le cadre des contrôles annuels de la seconde ligne de défense, soit dans le cadre de demandes d'ouverture de compte Confirmer les analyses des transactions financier/ières détectées comme activités inhabituelles, suspectes et incohérentes et remontées par le service en charge du monitoring des transactions Compléter les rapports d'activité et/ou transactions suspectes remontés par la premier/ière ligne de défense et les transmettre endéans les H à la CRF Comprendre et appréhender les textes légaux et réglementaires en matier/ière LBC/FT Analyser les changements de niveau de risque associé aux clients existants Documenter les analyses de dossiers, de fraudes, de suspicion et les actions prises dans leur résolution Votre profil Être titulaire d'un Master à orientation Economique, Financier/ière, Droit, Gestion d'entreprise ou avoir acquis au cours de votre carrier/ière une expérience équivalente au diplôme Disposer de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience 2ème ligne acquises en LBC/FT - FCC dans le secteur financier/retail/PSP Disposer de solides connaissances de l'ensemble des normes règlementaires dites « AML » applicables aux PSF Spécialisés ainsi que du domaine des paiements interbancaires Avoir des bonnes compétences en gestion et administration des affaires est requise Maitriser les logiciels Dow Jones, Finacle et Eastnets est considérée comme un atout Être rigoureux (se), organisé(e) avec un esprit rationnel Être reconnu(e) pour ses excellentes capacités d'analyse, de synthèse et rédactionnelles S'exprimer couramment en français et anglais tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit Intéressé(e) ? Envie de relever un nouveau défi professionnel dans une entreprise multiculturelle et dynamique, qui investit dans le développement et le bien-être de ses collaborateurs ? Rejoignez-nous en cliquant sur Postuler. Une copie conforme de votre diplôme et une copie récente de l'extrait du  vous seront demandées au cours du processus de recrutement. Naša reštaurácia je známa skvelou gastronómiou, rodinnou atmosférou a dychberúcimi výhľadmi na Belianske Tatry. Profesionálna a ústretová obsluha hostí v reštaurácii.

Vašou úlohou bude poradiť im s výberom výstroje, ktorá je pre nich vhodná, a správne ju nastaviť. Aj v požičovni u nás vládne skvelá nálada, pretože práve tá je naším hlavným meradlom pri výbere správnych kolegov na všetky pozície v rezorte. Ak teda radi pomáhate ľuďom, máte zmysel pre precíznosť a spĺňate parameter „vždy dobrá nálada", berieme vás medzi nás.

požičiavanie a servis lyžiarskej výstroje a športových potrieb,

aktívny predaj a komunikácia s klientmi,

kontrola kvality a poškodenia výstroje s následným zabezpečením opravy, servisu, prípadne vyradenia.

Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

Ak vás táto predstava neodstrašuje, ale naopak láka, poznáte odpoveď. Prihláste sa k nám a staňte sa súčasťou tímu, ktorý cez deň učí a večer tancuje.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
jobs.description:
☎️ „Dobrý deň, máme problém.“

„Aký?“

„Technický.“

„A čo presne nefunguje?“

„No... ono.“

Výborne. Máme prvú stopu. 

Ak dokážeš z takéhoto rozhovoru dostať použiteľné informácie, možno máme prácu presne pre teba.

Prijímanie technických incidentov – „Môžete mi to stručne opísať?“ Nasleduje audiokniha.

Kontrola monitorovacích systémov – sleduješ, čo funguje, čo nefunguje a čo sa len veľmi presvedčivo tvári, že funguje.

Riešenie jednoduchších technických problémov – keď problém vyriešiš za minútu, zvyšných 59 nemusíš predstierať, že to bolo náročné.

Posúvanie zložitejších prípadov na vyššiu podporu – keď problém potrebuje väčšieho odborníka, pošleš ho ďalej. Nie však s popisom „nejde to, veľa šťastia“.

Komunikácia so zákazníkmi a technickými tímami – vieš zostať slušná/ý aj pri vete „Ale susedovi to funguje“.

Práca s Excelom a evidencia incidentov – keď ti Excel napíše #HODNOTA!, neodpovieš mu niečím, čo by HR muselo cenzurovať.

Sledovanie otvorených požiadaviek – nenecháš incident ležať v systéme tak dlho, až dostane nárok na dôchodok.

Dokumentovanie vyriešených problémov – aby sa rovnaká chyba nemusela vyšetrovať každý pondelok ako nový kriminálny prípad.

Výhody:Pracovný pomer bez dátumu spotreby – nie sme reality šou. Každý piatok nikoho nevyraďujeme.  Zmluva na dobu neurčitú 

Permanentka na dobrovoľné sebatrýznenie – fitko, bazén, sauna... Vyber si, kde sa budeš potiť a ešte za to poďakuješ.  MultiSport karta 

Decembrové úplatky za celoročné dobré správanie – darčeky dostaneš, aj keď si občas zanadávaš na pondelok.  Vianočné balíčky 

Keď je problém, nehráme schovávačku – kolegovia ti pomôžu. Nikto zázračne neodíde na obed na tri dni.  100 percent podpora zo strany firmy 

Kolektív bez povinného firemného úsmevu – môžeš byť normálny človek, nie nadšený komparzista z reklamy na jogurt.  Rodinná atmosféra 

Žiadna výroba zamestnancov cez kopirák – každý máme svoje muchy. Niektorí rovno celé safari.  Individuálny prístup

jobs.title: Kuchári (okrem šéfkuchárov)
jobs.description:
Hľadáme šikovného a spoľahlivého kuchára/kuchárku s vášňou pre gastronómiu, ktorý/á by chcel/a pôsobiť v úspešnom tíme reštaurácie Medvedí brloh. Reštaurácia sa nachádza priamo pod svahom Ski Centra Strachan v Ždiari, v malebnom prostredí pod hrebeňom Belianskych Tatier, v celodrevenej stavbe s prvkami pôvodnej goralskej architektúry a s terasou s výhľadom na okolité končiare. Cez deň je Medvedí brloh obľúbeným miestom na dobré jedlo, večer sa však mení na miesto veľkej zábavy, pravidelne tu organizujeme akcie so známymi DJmi.

Príprava a výdaj jedál podľa jedálneho lístka, ktorý spája tradičné slovenské špeciality (halušky, pirohy) s modernými jedlami ako domáce burgre či pizza

Príprava sezónnych a regionálnych špecialít z kvalitných surovín

Práca v tíme profesionálnych kuchárov pod vedením skúseného šéfkuchára.

Pracovná doba:

Pracovné zmeny: krátky/dlhý týždeň alebo podľa dohody

Ak vás baví varenie, dobrá atmosféra a chcete byť súčasťou tímu obľúbenej reštaurácie priamo pod svahom, kde sa cez deň varí a večer tancuje, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

The companys business has grown strongly in recent years, and we are now looking for a Customer Service Specialist to support Eflas increasing order volume, international customers and the smooth handling of orders from start to finish.In this role, you will not be working in traditional inbound or outbound customer service. In practice, your work begins once sales has agreed on the order with the customer. After that, you ensure that the order proceeds correctly in the systems, production, delivery and documentation.The role includes a lot of email communication with international customers, as well as internal communication with sales, production and logistics partners. Since the customers are international and the orders can vary significantly, the role requires a strong ability to understand the bigger picture, use common sense and solve situations case by case.- processing and managing customer orders from start to finish- monitoring and coordinating order deliveries- communicating with international customers, mainly by email- cooperating with the sales team, production, logistics and customer service team- preparing export documentation and shipping documents- handling invoicing-related tasks- using the ERP system and other internal systems- resolving questions related to deliveries, schedules and customer cases- solving different customer cases and order-related issuesWe are looking for you who hasWe are looking for a person who is interested in international customer service, order handling and supply chain coordination. You may be a recent graduate or at the beginning of your career, or you may already have previous experience in similar tasks.We hope you have:- fluent English skills, as customer communication is mainly in English- readiness to work mainly from the office in Porvoo- previous work experience in customer service, order handling, sales support, logistics, export, invoicing or supply chain-related tasks- ability to understand broader processes and move things forward in a structured way- a proactive and flexible working style- good problem-solving skills and practical thinking- ability to work in a busy and changing environment- good cooperation and communication skillsConsidered an advantage- Finnish language skills, as communication with production and local stakeholders may also take place in Finnish- experience with ERP systems- studies in business, logistics, international business or another relevant fieldTo succeed in this role, you are- proactive and hands-on- accurate and systematic- flexible and able to handle pressure- cooperative and open- curious and willing to learn- ready to ask questions, investigate and get things done- interested in an international working environmentYou do not need to know everything in advance. What matters more is that you want to learn, are willing to take initiative and can work in situations where all answers cannot be found from ready-made templates.Practical informationLocation: PorvooWorking hours: Full-timeEmployment type: Permanent employment through Academic WorkStart: As soon as possibleRemote work: Limited possibility for remote work after the onboarding period. The role requires a high level of presence at the Porvoo office, especially due to onboarding and close teamwork.We will proceed with suitable applicants as soon as they apply, so please submit your application as soon as possible.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

You are curious, analytical and naturally focused on finding solutions. You enjoy figuring out why something is not working and are not afraid to get involved on the warehouse floor. You communicate easily with different colleagues and like combining a practical approach with an interest in systems and data. For this position, you bring: MBO+ or HBO working and thinking level Good command of the English language, both spoken and written Experience with ERP and or WMS systems is a plus, such as SAP Knowledge of warehouse processes such as inbound, outbound and inventory management A structured and process focused approach Wat bieden wij je? You will work in a modern Tech environment where you have plenty of opportunity to develop your skills and grow your career. Your own office is located directly on the warehouse floor, keeping you close to the operation and your colleagues. A gross monthly salary of €2,607 to €3,349 based on a 40 hour working week, depending on experience Company laptop and phone Attractive pension scheme Travel allowance Discounts on gym membership and bike plan, Team events and activities Training, development and career opportunities For this position, you must have the legal right to work in the Netherlands at the time of applying. Functieomschrijving As a Warehouse Support Specialist, you are the link between the daily warehouse operation, systems and processes. You spend a large part of your day on the warehouse floor, so you know what is happening in the operation and can quickly respond when something goes wrong. A process is not working as expected? An order is stuck? Inventory does not match the system? You investigate what is happening, identify the cause and work with the right colleagues to find a solution. As a Warehouse Support Specialist, you will: Act as a first point of contact foroperational and system related questions and issues Investigate discrepancies in orders, inventory and warehouse processes Use ERP and WMS systems to identify and resolve operational issues Analyse operational data and performance using Excel Monitor data quality and ensure information in operational systems is accurate Support root cause analyses and corrective actions Identify bottlenecks and suggest practical process improvements Work closely with Warehouse Operations, Quality, Planning, Customer Support and other stakeholders Contribute to the successful launch and further development of the new Tech operation in Lelystad The position is carried out in a 2 shift operation. You have your own office directly on the warehouse floor, giving you the space to focus when needed while keeping you closely connected to the daily operation. Because the location is new, you will have the opportunity to help shape processes and ways of working from the start. As you develop your knowledge of the operation and systems, there are opportunities to grow further within the organization. Ready to put your analytical skills, system knowledge and problem solving mindset to work? Apply now for the Warehouse Support Specialist position in Lelystad.

jobs.title: Monteur naar Begeleider in opleiding | Begeleider Gehandicaptenzorg in Opleiding
jobs.description: Niet om storingen op te lossen, maar om rust, duidelijkheid en vertrouwen te brengen. Als monteur ben je gewend om situaties te analyseren, gestructureerd te werken en door te zetten wanneer iets ingewikkeld is. In de gehandicaptenzorg maak je met diezelfde kwaliteiten elke dag verschil voor mensen met een verstandelijke beperking. Via een betaald werk-leertraject bij Ipse de Bruggen groei je stap voor stap uit tot begeleider gehandicaptenzorg. Wie zijn wij Bij Ipse de Bruggen vinden we dat je een nieuw vak goed moet kunnen leren. Daarom krijg je tijdens je eerste maanden de ruimte om te ontdekken, te ontwikkelen en ervaring op te doen. Hierdoor krijg je extra begeleiding en leer je het vak in jouw eigen tempo. Zo ontwikkel je stap voor stap de kennis, vaardigheden en het zelfvertrouwen om zelfstandig als begeleider aan de slag te gaan. Jouw baan als Monteur naar Begeleider in opleiding | Begeleider Gehandicaptenzorg in Opleiding Als monteur ben je gewend om verder te kijken dan wat direct zichtbaar is. Wanneer een machine niet werkt, zoek je naar de oorzaak achter het probleem. Je analyseert situaties, blijft rustig onder druk en zoekt naar oplossingen. In de gehandicaptenzorg doe je iets vergelijkbaars. Achter gedrag schuilt vaak een behoefte, emotie of hulpvraag die niet altijd uitgesproken kan worden. Jij leert signalen herkennen, structuur bieden en cliënten begeleiden in het dagelijks leven. Samen met collega's zorg je voor een veilige en voorspelbare omgeving waarin cliënten zich kunnen ontwikkelen. Geen dag is hetzelfde, maar juist jouw geduld, oplossingsgerichtheid en doorzettingsvermogen maken het verschil. Jouw profiel Je beschikt minimaal over een vmbo-kaderdiploma, een afgerondopleiding op mbo2 of hoger, óf relevante werkervaring in de techniek, bouw, installatiebranche of een andere praktische werkomgeving. Je blijft rustig wanneer situaties anders lopen dan gepland en kunt goed schakelen. Je bent observatief, betrokken en nieuwsgierig naar de mens achter het gedrag. Je wilt werken én leren combineren en jezelf ontwikkelen tot begeleider gehandicaptenzorg. Je bent gemotiveerd om cliënten een veilige en stabiele omgeving te bieden. Wat krijg je van ons Een unieke kans op een nieuwe carrière Een betaalde werk-leerplek binnen de gehandicaptenzorg De eerste 6 maanden boventallig ingewerkt Een erkende MBO-opleiding volledig vergoed Interne trainingen en scholingen Persoonlijke begeleiding en coaching De arbeidsvoorwaarden Een leerarbeidsovereenkomst, contracturen in overleg tussen de 24 en 32 uur. Alle opleidingskosten worden betaald en je krijgt per schooldag 4 uur studieverlof. Een bruto maandsalaris (tot 21 jaar) tussen € 1.983 – € 2.732 op basis van 36 uur, conform CAO gehandicaptenzorg leerling. Een bruto maandsalaris (vanaf 21 jaar) tussen € 2.420 – € 3.708 op basis van 36 uur, conform CAO gehandicaptenzorg. Eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% en 8% vakantiegeld Reiskostenvergoeding en gratis parkeren op het terrein Een introductieprogramma om je goed voorbereid te laten starten Diverse trainings-, cursus- en opleidings- mogelijkheden Jaarlijks € 750,- fiscaal voordeel bij o.a. de aanschaf van een telefoon, laptop, tablet, fiets of het abonnement van jouw sportvereniging De mogelijkheid extra verlofuren fiscaal voordelig te kopen en te verkopen. jobs.description: PhD Position Systematic Derivation of Formal Languages and Their Correctness (Delft, NL, 2628 CD) Delft University of Technology (TU Delft)  Posted on Oct 16, 2026 From Semantics to Syntax - Systematic Derivation of Formal Languages and Their Correctness Job description Formal languages, such as type theories and program logics, let us state and prove precisely what software should do. Today, each new language is designed by hand: experts invent the syntax, then check that it really means what it should. This is slow, and it has to be redone for every new problem. This project explores a different approach: start from the mathematical meaning of a language and derive the language itself from it, together with a proof that the two match. Several recent type theories were built this way, but each one with its own ad hoc techniques. Together, we want to find out whether there is one general recipe behind them. You will develop this theory using tools from category theory and type theory, and check your results in the Agda proof assistant. You will be supervised by Dr. Benedikt Ahrens in the Department of Software Technology at TU Delft. Your responsibilities will include: - conducting this research, both individually and as part of a team; - participating in scientific life at TU Delft and in the Netherlands, for example by attending and organizing seminars; - participating in scientific life more globally, including publishing papers and attending workshops and conferences; - contributing to teaching in computer science, providing the opportunity to gain teaching experience. Job requirements Applications will be evaluated on the following criteria: - Masters degree in mathematics, computer science, or a related field - Experience in both category theory and theoretical computer science (e.g., type theory, logic or programming language semantics), or a strong motivation and ability to learn them. - Experience with a proof assista...
