jobs.description:
Na temelju Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08., 86/09., 92/10., 105/10., 90/11., 16./12., 86/12., 126/12., 94/13., 152/14., 07/17., 68/18., 98/19., 64/20., 151/22., 155./23 i 156/23.), Statuta Gimnazije Karlovac i Pravilnika o postupku zapošljavanja u Gimnaziji Karlovac

GIMNAZIJA KARLOVAC Rakovac 4, Karlovac, raspisuje

N A T J E Č A J

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa za:

Nastavnik glazbene umjetnosti – na određeno, puno radno vrijeme

Uvjeti:

Prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi školi.

U radni odnos ne može biti primljena osoba za čiji prijem postoje zapreke za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi.

Prijavi na natječaj koja mora biti vlastoručno potpisana, kandidati su dužni priložiti:

  1. dokaz o stručnoj spremi
  2. dokaz o državljanstvu
  3. elektronski zapis osiguranja sa HZMO-a
  4. Uvjerenje da nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 106. Zakona s naznakom roka izdavanja – ne starije od 8 dana od dana raspisivanja natječaja,
  5. životopis

Isprave se prilažu u preslikama, a prije izbora kandidat će priložiti izvornike ili ovjerene preslike na uvid.

Kandidati koji ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju na temelju posebnih propisa dužni su se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo prednosti i priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu te imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17., 98/19. i 84/21.), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“ broj 33/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ broj 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ broj 84/21.) dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja i ovisno o kategoriji u koju ulazi sve potrebne dokaze (članak 103. st.1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf

Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju (članak 49. st.1. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.) dužan je, uz navedene dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, dostaviti rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo ostvarivanje spomenutog prava, izjavu da do sada nisu koristili pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju po toj osnovi te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje/obavijest o prestanku radnog odnosa, sporazum i drugo).

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) dužan je, uz gore navedene dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, dostaviti dokaz o utvrđenom invaliditetu, odnosno javnu ispravu o invaliditetu na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje/obavijest o prestanku radnog odnosa, sporazum i drugo).

Na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola, a izrazi koji se koriste u ovom natječaju za osobe u muškom rodu upotrijebljeni su neutralno i odnose se na muške i ženske osobe.

Sukladno odredbama Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka EU 2013/679 i Zakona o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (“Narodne novine” br. 42/18.) svi dokumenti dostavljeni na natječaj poslani su slobodnom voljom kandidata te se smatra da je kandidat dao privolu za obradu svih podataka koji će se obrađivati isključivo u svrhu provođenja natječajnog postupka.

Kandidati koji su pravodobno dostavili potpunu prijavu sa svim osobnim podacima i sa svim prilozima odnosno ispravama kojima dokazuju ispunjavanje uvjeta natječaja biti će pozvani na procjenu prema odredbama Pravilnika o postupku zapošljavanja u Gimnaziji Karlovac koji je dostupan na mrežnim stranicama škole.

Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju.

Nepotpune prijave i prijave koje pristignu izvan roka neće se razmatrati, a osobe koje podnesu takve prijave ne smatraju se kandidatima prijavljenim na natječaj.

Natječaj je otvoren 8 dana od 16.11.2026. godine, a kandidati će biti izviješteni o rezultatima izbora u zakonskom roku.

Prijave dostaviti na e-mail adresu: kontakt@gimnazija-karlovac.hr

Nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati.

Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidat/kinja koji/a je pravodobno dostavio/la potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima odnosno ispravama i ispunjava uvjete natječaja dužan/a je pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika o postupku zapošljavanja te procjeni i vrednovanju kandidata za zapošljavanje Poveznica na mrežnu stranicu Škole: http://www.os-dugopolje.skole.hr/skola/dokumenti Kandidat/kinja prijavom na natječaj daje privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno važećim propisima o zaštiti osobnih podataka. Rok za podnošenje prijave na natječaj je osam dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i mrežnim stranicama škole. Prijave na natječaj dostavljaju se neposredno ili poštom na adresu Osnovna škola Dugopolje, Stepinčeva 4, 21204 Dugopolje s naznakom „za natječaj – učitelj razredne nastave“. Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati. Kandidat/kinja prijavljen/na na natječaj bit će obaviješten/na putem mrežne stranice školske ustanove http://www.os-dugopolje.skole.hr najkasnije u roku od petnaest /15) dana od dana sklapanja ugovora o radu s odabranim/om kandidatom/kinjom. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati/kinje koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, svi će kandidati biti obaviješteni i prema članku 23. stavku 4. Pravilnika.

jobs.title: UČITELJ/UČITELJICA KOJI OBAVLJA POSLOVE UČITELJA MATEMATIKE
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN br. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19 , 64/20 i 151/22, 155/23 i 156/23), članka 8. i članka 10. Pravilnika o postupku zapošljavanja te procjeni i vrednovanju kandidata za zapošljavanje Osnovna škola Ivana Mažuranića, Obrovac Sinjski 242/C, 21241 Obrovac Sinjski, raspisuje N A T J E Č A J za zasnivanje radnog odnosa na radnom mjestu
  1. Učitelj koji obavlja poslove učitelja/ice matematike – 1 izvršitelja/ice na određeno, puno radno vrijeme (40 sati tjedno),
Mjesto rada: u sjedištu Škole, a prema potrebi i izvan sjedišta Škole Uvjeti:
  • Opći uvjet za zasnivanje radnog odnosa i posebni uvjeti propisani Zakonom o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi
  • Uvjeti stručne spreme za radno mjesto učitelja/ice matematike propisani su člankom 15. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN br. 6/19 i 75/20)
Radni odnos u školskoj ustanovi ne može zasnovati osoba za koju postoje zapreke iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi. Prijava na natječaj mora sadržavati:
  • osobno ime
  • adresa stanovanja
  • broj mobitela ili telefona
  • e-mail adresa
  • naziv radnog mjesta na koje se prijavljuje
Uz prijavu na natječaj kandidat je dužan priložiti:
  • životopis
  • diploma, odnosno dokaz o odgovarajućoj vrsti i stupnju obrazovanja,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da podnositelj prijave nije pod istragom i da se protiv podnositelja prijave ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zaprekaza zasnivanje radnog odnosa za neko od kaznenih djela iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od dana od dana raspisivanja natječaja.
Prilozi odnosno isprave koje su kandidati dužni priložiti uz prijavu na natječaj prilažu se u neovjerenoj preslici, a izabrani kandidat je prije sklapanja ugovora o radu dužan predočiti izvornike. Sukladno Zakonu o ravnopravnosti spolova (NN, br. 82/08. i 69/17.) na natječaj se mogu ravnopravno prijaviti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muške i ženske osobe. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja prema članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17., 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (NN br. 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13., 98/19), članku 48. stavku 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN broj 84/21) ili članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo te osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti svu potrebnu dokumentaciju i dokaze propisane zakonom na koji se poziva, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su osim dokaza o ispunjavanju uvjeta natječaja, priložiti dokaze propisane čl. 103. stavkom 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju (čl.49.st.1. Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidat koji je stekao inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju u inozemstvu (izvan Republike Hrvatske) ne može se zaposliti u odgojno-obrazovnoj ustanovi temeljem rješenja o priznavanju inozemne obrazovne kvalifikacije koje izdaje Agencija za znanost i visoko obrazovanje već temeljem rješenja koje izdaje Ministarstva znanosti, obrazovanja i mladih. Kandidat kojemu je rješenjem Ministarstva znanosti, obrazovanja i mladih priznata inozemna stručna kvalifikacija kojom se ostvaruje pravo na pristup i obavljanje regulirane profesije nije dužan ishoditi rješenje Agencije za znanost i visoko obrazovanje za potrebe zapošljavanja u odgojno-obrazovnoj ustanovi (više na poveznici: https://mzo.gov.hr/istaknute-teme/odgoj-i-obrazovanje/priznavanje-inozemnih-strucnih-kvalifikacija-regulirane-profesije/3195 Najkasnije do isteka roka za podnošenje prijave na natječaj, Povjerenstvo će na javno dostupnoj mrežnoj stranici Škole ( https://osim.hr/category/natjecaji/ ) objaviti način procjene, odnosno testiranja kandidata te pravne i druge izvore za pripremu kandidata ako se procjena odnosno testiranje provodi o poznavanju propisa. Sve kandidate koji su pravodobno dostavili potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima, odnosno ispravama i koji ispunjavaju uvjete natječaja, Povjerenstvo će pozvati na procjenu odnosno testiranje najmanje pet dana prije dana određenog za procjenu, odnosno testiranje. U pozivu će biti naveden datum, vrijeme i mjesto procjene odnosno testiranja, te pravni i drugi izvori za pripremu kandidata ako se procjena odnosno testiranje provodi o poznavanju propisa. Poziv će biti objavljen na javno dostupnim mrežnim stranicama Škole (https://osim.hr/category/poziv-kandidata-na-testiranje/ ) te kandidati neće biti posebno pozvani. Kandidat koji je pravodobno dostavio potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima odnosno ispravama i ispunjava uvjete natječaja dužan je pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika o postupku zapošljavanja te procjeni i vrednovanju kandidata za zapošljavanje u Osnovnoj školi Ivana Mažuranića u Obrovcu Sinjskom, a koji je dostupan na mrežnim stranicama Škole na poveznici: (http://osim.hr/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/O%C5%A0IM-Pravilnik-o-postupku-zapo%C5%A1ljavanja-te-procjeni-i-vrednovanju-kandidata-za-zapo%C5%A1ljavanje.docx ). Osobe koje ne ulaze u listu kandidata Škola ne obavještava o razlozima istog. Kandidatu koji je osoba s invaliditetom Škola je obavezna u postupku procjene odnosno testiranja osigurati odgovarajuću razumnu prilagodbu ako je kandidat u prijavi na natječaj naveo potrebu za odgovarajućom prilagodbom. Ako kandidat nije pristupio procjeni odnosno testiranju, smatra se da je odustao od prijave na natječaj i ne smatra se kandidatom. Podnošenjem prijave na natječaj, kandidat daje izričitu privolu Osnovnoj školi Ivana Mažuranića u Obrovcu Sinjskom da može prikupljati i obrađivati osobne podatke kandidata iz natječajne dokumentacije u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno važećim propisima o zaštiti osobnih podataka. Rok za podnošenje prijave na natječaj je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje te mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Škole. Prijave s potrebnom dokumentacijom o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja dostavljaju se neposredno putem protokola Škole ili poštom na adresu Škole: Osnovna škola Ivana Mažuranića, Obrovac Sinjski 242/C, 21241 Obrovac Sinjski s naznakom ,,Za natječaj – učitelj/ica matematike“ Nepravovremene i nepotpune prijave kao i prijave koje nisu dostavljene na propisan način neće se razmatrati. Kandidati prijavljeni na natječaj bit će obaviješteni o rezultatima natječaja putem mrežne stranice Škole (https://osim.hr/category/obavijest-o-rezultatima-izbora/ ) najkasnije u roku od petnaest dana od dana sklapanja ugovora o radu s izabranim kandidatom. U slučaju iz članka 24. stavka 4. Pravilnika o postupku zapošljavanja te procjeni i vrednovanju kandidata za zapošljavanje u Osnovnoj školi Ivana Mažuranića u Obrovcu Sinjskom, kandidati će biti obaviješteni pisanom preporučenom poštanskom pošiljkom s povratnicom. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnim pločama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje, na mrežnim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči Osnovne škole Ivana Mažuranića u Obrovcu Sinjskom, dana 16. studenoga 2026. https://osim.hr/category/natjecaji/

jobs.title: ODGOJITELJ PREDŠKOLSKE DJECE (M/Ž)
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25 i 22/26), članka 42. Statuta Dječjeg vrtića „Maruškica i Odluke Upravnog vijeća raspisuje se

NATJEČAJ

za radno mjesto odgojitelj predškolske djece

  • 1 izvršitelj (m/ž) na određeno, puno radno vrijeme – do povratka djelatnice s rodiljnog/roditeljskog dopusta

Uvjeti: Prema člancima 24. i 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25 i 22/26), te članku 2. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti i razini obrazovanja odgojno – obrazovnih i ostalih radnika u dječjem vrtiću, ustanovama te drugim pravnim i fizičkim osobama koje provode programe ranog i predškolskog odgoja i obrazovanja (Narodne novine 145/24).

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj u kojoj kandidat (m/ž) navodi osobne podatke sa naznakom radnog mjesta za koje se prijavljuje, potrebno je priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju formalnih uvjeta iz natječaja i to kako slijedi:

  1. Životopis
  2. Dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi
  3. Dokaz o državljanstvu
  4. Dokaze o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radog odnosa sukladno članku 25. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju (Narodne novine 10/97, 107/07, 94/13, 98/19, 57/22, 101/23, 145/23, 145/24, 146/25 i 22/26), ne stariji od 6 mjeseci
  • Potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (članak 25. stavak 2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju)
  • Potvrda nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak (članak 25. stavak 4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju)
  • Potvrda nadležnog područnog ureda Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad (članak 25. stavak 10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju
  1. Liječničko uvjerenje o utvrđenoj zdravstvenoj sposobnosti
  2. Elektronički zapis Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje o radno pravnom statusu evidentiranom u bazi podataka HZMO-a, ne starije od mjesec dana

Kandidat koji prema posebnim propisima ostvaruje pravo prednosti, mora se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo, odnosno uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu.

Kandidat koji može ostvariti pravo prednosti:

– sukladno čl. 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21,156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.

Informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalaze se na poveznici:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//NG/12%20Prosinac/Zapo%C5%A1ljavanje//POPIS%20DOKAZA%20ZA%20OSTVARIVANJE%20PRAVA%20PRI%20ZAPO%C5%A0LJAVANJU.pdf

– sukladno čl. 47. – 50. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine br. 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-843/843.

Informacije o dokazima koji su potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju nalaze se na poveznici:

https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf

– sukladno čl. 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu iz koje je vidljivo to pravo te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca;

– sukladno čl. 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom te dokaz o tome na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca.

Sukladno članku 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine 82/08, 69/17) na javni natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u ovom natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod.

Prijave s traženom dokumentacijom, u zatvorenoj omotnici s naznakom “ZA NATJEČAJ – ODGOJITELJ“ potrebno je dostaviti poštom na adresu:

Dječji vrtić „Maruškica“

Put Škara 1

23223 Škabrnja

Nepotpune i/ili nepravovremene prijave neće se razmatrati. Prijave dostaviti poštom u roku 8 dana od dana objave natječaja. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u roku 30 dana od dana isteka roka za podnošenje prijava dostavom odluke o prijemu izabranog kandidata ili dostavom odluke o poništenju natječaja. Odluka o izboru kandidata dostavlja se javnom objavom na mrežnoj stranici www.dv-maruskica.hr.

jobs.title: Field Application Engineer
jobs.description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Field Application Engineer--- Field Application Engineer==========================**Are you ready to shape a brighter future?** Did you know that every second, an aircraft takes off somewhere in the world, and that 90% of them are equipped with a component produced in Fribourg? We are Hannifin, a global leader in motion and control technologies, with more than 58,000 team members across 44 countries. Our Business Unit in Fribourg, Switzerland, part of the Motion, Power, and Sensing division, is a technological and manufacturing center of excellence specializing in the development and production of measurement, control, and protection solutions for the aerospace and energy sectors. With around 400 employees, we design, qualify, and manufacture high\-performance sensors, electronic systems, and software monitoring solutions for critical and extreme environments. We are proud to work with passion, to enable engineering breakthrough and innovation. Joining Fribourg means contributing to high\-value international technology projects, growing in a collaborative and innovative environment, and developing your full professional and personal potential.**Your responsibilities*** Perform on\-site installation, wiring verification, configuration, functional testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting of vibration monitoring systems, sensors, protection racks, and related software; resolve hardware, software, and industrial networking issues at customer sites.* Coordinate with customer site personnel to confirm requirements and site readiness, apply applicable safety standards and site rules, and prepare field service reports, troubleshooting summaries, and root\-cause analysis logs.* Translate rotating machinery and condition monitoring requirements into technical proposals, system architectures, feasibility studies, system sizing, and technical solutions using proprietary sensor and monitoring product lines.* Coordinate technical input between customers, sales teams, distributors, OEMs, and local R\&D/Product Management teams in Fribourg; deliver technical presentations and solution explanations.* Support sales teams, distributors, and OEMs during customer discussions, new projects, and retrofit or modernization opportunities, including management of technical inquiries through the Customer Service Desk or Salesforce in line with defined KPIs.* Support project engineering teams during project execution, technical clarifications, Pre\-FAT, and FAT activities, ensuring customer requirements are understood and implemented.* Deliver advanced technical training and prepare customer\-facing and internal documentation, including commissioning records, intervention reports, and technical summaries.* Support investigation, testing, validation, and internal simulation activities related to customer issues, product behavior, and application performance; provide structured field feedback to R\&D/Product Management.**Who we are looking for*** Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Microengineering, Automation, Systems, Mechatronics, or equivalent.* Minimum 5 years of experience in application engineering, field service, commissioning, troubleshooting, and customer support within an industrial environment.* Experience in the energy sector or other industrial environments is an asset (Aerospace, heavy machinery or equivalent).* Strong technical knowledge of vibration monitoring, condition monitoring, rotating machinery, sensors, protection racks, and related software. understanding of signal processing, vibration analysis, electronics, and industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, Profibus, Profinet, and OPC. Vibration Analyst Category 2 certification is considered a strong asset* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills* Strong customer\-focused approach, curious and hands\-on* Professional fluency in English; French and/or considered as a strong asset* Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time**What we offer*** Solid employer on the market for over 100 years, we manage the full product lifecycle and support leading aerospace and energy companies worldwide* Career growth, opportunities and training: we hire from within!* Collaborative and empowered work environment where team spirit is at the center of our success.* Company values that encourage trust, respect, collaboration and professional growth.* Open environment: we are excited to hear your ideas!* Attractive compensation packages designed to hire and retain the best talents in the industry.* Company restaurant and other benefits **If you don’t find yourself in all points, apply anyways,** because all competencies are valued! **Have we sparked your interest?** We look forward to getting to know you!Please apply with your complete application documents directly online. If you are selected for a first interview, we will arrange a meeting on Teams.Some stages of the recruiting process will include professional situational exercises.Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps in the recruitment process.  *is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on grounds of age, race, religion, ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation or disability in relation to recruitment and employment*. *Hannifin EMEA Sàrl (“PHEMEA”), based in Etoy, Switzerland, is the Principal Operating Company for in the EMEA region. It is supported by a network of Manufacturing Divisions and Company Entities. The Aerospace Group EMEA is a strategic business Group within PHEMEA, and its Motion, Power, and Sensing Division is a key service provider to PHEMEA.*![Meggitt SA]()* Meggitt SA  Route de Moncor 4  1752 \-sur\-Glâne*jidf5c729cjm jit1146jm jiy26jm

jobs.title: Linux System Engineer
jobs.description: EinleitungstextAre you ready to take ownership of world-class Linux infrastructure in a dynamic biological research environment? At the Department of Biosystems Science and Engineering (D-BSSE) of ETH Zurich in Basel, data-driven science meets cutting-edge engineering.As the senior technical anchor for our Linux ecosystem, you will join a focused, close-knit infrastructure group of four. Linux and storage service delivery is shared across three team members (with our fourth colleague focusing on Windows and virtualization). jobs.title: Research Scientist in Scientific AI and Geotechnical Engineering
jobs.description: EinleitungstextThe Chair of Geotechnical Engineering at ETH Zurich, part of the Institute for Geotechnical Engineering (IGT), focuses its teaching and research on foundation engineering, soil mechanics and natural hazards. Our objective is to combine theoretical knowledge with experiments and numerical simulations to develop new methods for understanding and predicting the behaviour of soils, foundations and infrastructure. We are opening a position in our research group at ETH Zurich, focusing on developing and integrating modern Artificial Intelligence (AI) methods into geotechnical engineering research, while maintaining a strong connection to the underlying physics and mechanics. We do not aim to develop a new AI model or replace physics-based engineering with purely data-driven AI. Instead, we want to use AI to transform the way research itself is performed—from numerical model generation and experimental data acquisition to analysis, visualization and communication.For this purpose, we are looking for a Research Scientist in Scientific AI and Geotechnical Engineering, who will work across the research group, collaborating with PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and senior scientists.The role combines scientific research, computational engineering, research automation, data science and the development of reusable AI-enabled tools. A central objective is to identify new opportunities where AI can enable research that would otherwise be difficult or impossible, and to develop capabilities that can be used across the entire group.Aufgaben-/StellenbeschreibungThe job will interconnect several different areas of our activity:Scientific AI and physics-informed modellingDevelop and apply AI and machine-learning approaches to challenging problems in geotechnical engineering and computational mechanics, with particular emphasis on approaches that combine data with physical knowledge, rather than relying exclusively on black-box, data-driven models.Explore topics including physics-informed and physics-guided machine learning, hybrid physics–ML constitutive modelling, surrogate and reduced-order models, inverse problems and parameter identification, uncertainty quantification, and AI-assisted scientific discovery.Apply these methods to problems involving soil behaviour, soil–structure interaction, liquefaction, natural hazards, foundations and infrastructure resilience.AI-enabled numerical modellingDevelop tools for automating and accelerating numerical modelling workflows, including finite element (FE) and potentially discrete element (DEM) and material point method (MPM) simulations.Automate tasks, such as model generation, geometry and mesh creation, assignment of materials and boundary conditions, parameter studies, high-performance computing (HPC) execution, model verification, extraction of results and standardised post-processing.Create robust and reusable tools that enable researchers throughout the group to build and analyse numerical models more efficiently while retaining appropriate engineering control and verification.Automation of experimental researchDevelop AI-enabled methods for the acquisition, processing and interpretation of experimental data from laboratory and centrifuge testing.Automate sensor-data processing, synchronization of different measurement systems, computer-vision analysis of experiments, extraction of deformation and failure mechanisms from images and videos, identification of experimental parameters, and integration of experimental and numerical results.Geotechnical data intelligenceDevelop methods to exploit the growing volume of geotechnical data available within the group and through external repositories.Organize and extract information from historical laboratory and centrifuge experiments and numerical analyses, and exploit large external datasets and research repositories such as DesignSafe and databases containing geotechnical and geological properties.Contribute to the longer-term development of structured, physics-aware geotechnical datasets to support parameter inference, model calibration, uncertainty quantification, identification of model deficiencies and the development of new physics-informed AI approaches.Scientific visualisation and communicationDevelop automated approaches for transforming research results into high-quality visualisations, animations and videos.Develop tools that support scientific publications and presentations while facilitating effective communication of research through websites, teaching materials, professional audiences and social-media platforms.Group-wide AI capabilityHelp establish AI as a broadly accessible research capability within the group.Identify opportunities for AI across ongoing research activities, develop common tools and workflows, provide internal training and documentation, and work directly with researchers to enable them to use modern AI and computational methods effectively and independently.Ihr ProfilWe are looking for an intellectually curious scientist / engineer who combines strong computational skills with an interest in physical systems and engineering research. A background in geotechnical engineering is not mandatory but can represent an advantage.PhD in computational mechanics, computational engineering, scientific machine learning, applied mathematics, computer science, civil or mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline.Excellent programming skills.Strong background in numerical methods, such as FEM, FD, DEM or MPM.Demonstrated experience with machine learning, modern AI methods and AI-assisted software development.Experience with scientific data engineering, databases and the processing of large or heterogeneous datasets.Experience with HPC, parallel computing and/or GPU computing.Experience with automated simulation workflows and APIs.Experience with scientific visualisation and the automated generation of figures, animations or videos.Experience with computer vision and image/video analysis is particularly valuable.Candidates from other fields than geotechnical engineering with strong expertise in computational mechanics and Scientific AI are strongly encouraged to apply. The successful candidate will work closely with experienced geotechnical researchers who will provide the necessary domain expertise.Beyond specific technical qualifications, we are particularly interested in candidates who can bridge disciplines. The successful candidate should be able to understand an engineering or scientific problem, identify where AI or computational methods can provide genuine added value, develop a rigorous solution, and transform that solution into a reusable capability for other researchers.We therefore value scientific creativity, strong software-development practices, independence, collaborative ability and an enthusiasm for learning new areas.The position is particularly suited to someone who is excited by the opportunity to help shape a new research direction at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, mechanics, experimentation and geotechnical engineering.Wir bietenThe opportunity to help shape a new research direction at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence, computational mechanics, experimentation and geotechnical engineering.Considerable freedom to identify research opportunities and contribute to the development of new methods as AI technologies and Scientific AI continue to evolve.The opportunity to work across scientific research, computational engineering, numerical simulations, experimental research and data science.Close collaboration with PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and senior scientists in an interdisciplinary research environment.The opportunity to develop reusable AI-enabled tools and workflows that strengthen research capabilities across the group.Neugierig? jobs.title: Head of Legal
jobs.description:
At Vio, we believe booking accommodation should feel fair and effortless, never overwhelming or unclear.

As one of the world’s fastest-growing accommodation booking platforms, we help millions of users make smarter travel decisions by comparing stays across 100+ booking sites so that they can find the best place, at the best price, anywhere in the world.

Our goal is to help travelers book like an insider. That means cutting through the noise and complexity of hotel booking and surfacing real value with clarity, transparency, and full support. No tricks. No confusion. Just great stays, booked with confidence.

With operations in 100+ markets and growing fast, our mission is to reshape how people discover and book accommodation through technology that travelers can trust.

Who we’re looking for

We are looking for an experienced Founding Legal Counsel to help us build Vio's legal function from the ground up – owning our commercial contracts, managing legal risk across the business and getting us ready for our next stage of growth.

This is Vio's first in-house legal role. You'll be our go-to person for all things legal: a commercial lawyer first and foremost and the owner of our full legal portfolio. You won't need to be an expert in every area, but you'll know when to answer yourself and when to orchestrate external support.

Reporting into our COO, you’ll become a trusted business partner to our leadership team and decision makers across Vio, pragmatically solving any problems and helping us think creatively about how we manage and mitigate our risk.

We do that by harnessing the power of advanced algorithms and an innovative suite of product features.

jobs.title: Reliability Engineer (NL)
jobs.description:
Functie  Reliability engineer

 

Beschrijving functie

 

De reliability engineer is een productie specialist die de totale levensduur van installatie bestudeert en analyseert hoe het bedrijf omgaat met investeringen en onderhoud van assets.  De reliability engineer is de expert in het identificeren van potentiële risico’s en het voorkomen van stilstanden. Daar problemen moeilijk volledig te voorkomen zijn, geeft de reliability engineer adviezen hoe te handelen bij storingen die plaatsvinden. Het doel is te voorkomen dat fouten in productiesystemen optreden.

 

De reliability engineer analyseert tevens de veiligheidsrisico’s geassocieerd met installatie fouten. Ter voorkoming van stilstand maakt de reliability engineer onderhoudsschema’s en analyseert statistische gegevens die helpen te voorspellen wanneer en hoe fouten voor kunnen komen. De reliability engineer ontwikkelt inspectie criteria die gebruikt worden om de asset health te monitoren. 



Om dit te kunnen bereiken maakt de reliability engineer gebruik van een aantal technieken.

 

  • Voorlopige gevaren analyse: Preliminary hazard analysis is de initiële identificatie van potentiële gevaren en fouten in een productie proces of systeem

  • Failure modes and effect analysis ( FMEA): Betreft het opsommen van de manieren dat een proces of systeem kan falen en wat de consequenties hiervan zijn.

  • Criticality analysis: bepaalt hoe ernstig de consequenties zijn van een asset fout voor het productiesysteem van het bedrijf.

  • Onderhoudbaarheid: gedetailleerde informatie hoe efficiënt en betrouwbaar het bedrijf een onderdeel kan repareren.

  • Foutenboom analyse: onderzoek van een systeem fout door naar de kleinere voorafgaande gebeurtenissen te kijken die hebben bijgedragen aan de systeem fout



    • Taken

    1. Trouble shooting

      1. Faciliteren van root cause analyse in geval van complexe, multidisciplinaire afwijkingen/storingen waar de uitvoerende teams niet uitkomen

      2. Daily problem solving

    2. Continue verbeteren

      1. Periodieke analyse op performance killers en cost drivers om van daaruit middels verbetervoorstellen bij te dragen aan een maximale beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid van installaties tegen minimale kosten

      2. Innovatief denken m.b.t. het verlagen van de kosten en verhogen van de betrouwbaarheid

      3. Leiden/faciliteren van verbeterteams c.q. verbeterprojecten

    3. Change Management

      1. Beoordelen van wijzigingen op technische haalbaarheid met het bestaande machinepark. Vanuit procurement komen verzoeken op het gebied van grondstof wijzigingen ( andere leverancier, andere specificaties ed.) 

      2. Begeleiden van proeven vanuit de technische kant op de machines

      3. Installatie nieuwe machines / introductie nieuwe producten 

    4. Technische beschikbaarheid & betrouwbaarheid

      1. Evalueren van preventief onderhoud en voorstellen doen ter verbetering met als doel het verhogen van de beschikbaarheid van het machinepark

      2. Het verlagen van onderhoudskosten door het optimaliseren van onderhoudsconcepten en doorvoeren van technische verbeteringen.

    5. Investeringsprojecten

      1. Participeren in investeringsprojecten om de onderhoudbaarheid te borgen en het inregelen van onderhoud en spare parts.

      2. Inbrengen van technische kennis en ervaringen.

      3. Toezien op naleving van de standaard op gebied van onderdelen en installaties.

    6. Onderhoudsstrategie bepalen

      1. Opstellen van effectieve onderhoudsconcepten zodat onderhoud van de installaties op de meest efficiënte en effectieve manier kan worden gerealiseerd tegen zo laag mogelijke kosten

      2. Borgen van compliance; het inregelen van wettelijke inspecties en keuringen  en toezien op tijdige uitvoering daarvan.

    7. Beheren van de Standard Operating Procedures voor de installaties (SOP)

      1. Schrijven van nieuwe SOP’s, inclusief autonoom onderhoud

      2. Herzien van SOP’s als gevolg van proces verbeteringen en aanpassingen

    8. Bewaken standaarden voor veiligheid en kwaliteit

      1. Uitvoeren van risico assessments

      2. Borgen dat processen voldoen aan veiligheids standaarden en kwaliteits standaarden.

      3. Uitvoeren van optimalisatie testen.

      4. Ontwikkelen van best practice  die de productkwaliteit borgen

jobs.title: Security Architect
jobs.description:
Are you a security specialist in the OT space looking to expand your expertise into cloud solutions? Are you a cloud security champion passionate about bringing your expertise into OT/IoT space? At Priva Product Development Organisation we are looking for the Security Architect who will shape the security of our products.  

  

Security Architect in Priva Product Development – Why this role matters 

At Priva, we develop hardware products and software services for horticulture and building automation. Seeing the importance of our products for our customers, we recognize the need to continuously keep these secure in the ever evolving, fast-paced world. The security requirements in our landscape span four different areas: 

  1. Physical/embedded device security. 

  1. OT (operational technology) network security. 

  1. OT network to Priva-hosted cloud services communications. 

  1. Priva's hybrid on-prem/multi-cloud platform applications security, including applications, infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines.  

What makes this role truly unique is that our products contain long-lived hardware components that our customers run for years. Engineering future-proofed security solutions and maintaining a security posture at existing sites across all these areas having wide range of varying implementations and security needs creates a great challenge and a great fun. 

As part of the architecture team, you will play a key role in shaping the future of Priva's portfolio offered on the global market. You define security standards, security practices and security designs for our products that are used in tens of thousands of buildings and greenhouses. You work across product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure security controls and adhered to, implemented and tested as you have designed these. That’s real impact. 

What you will be doing 

As a Security Architect, you have a very simple mission: you see to it that Priva's hardware products and software (cloud) services are secured against known and emergent threats in lines with the industry standards and practices. You build upon your strong background in securing device/OT networks, cloud applications, and engraining the security practices in the daily work of Agile teams to achieve consistent security posture across all Priva products, designs, and customer deployments. 

 As a security architect, you are trusted counterpart of Priva Security, Quality, and Compliance officer to define, review, and execute controls arising from ISO9001 and ISO27001 standards and internal initiatives. You are responsible for presenting the necessary evidence of Priva’s compliance with these controls to the auditors. 

  • Security standards, policies, and design patterns library 

  • Security architecture review process 

  • Risk register and residual risk acceptance documentation 

  • Periodic product security implementation reviews, including maintaining non-compliance register 

  • Defined requirements, products and work packages for security-focused projects with 3rd party service providers, reviewing and accepting their deliverables, and supervising the implementation of these deliverables in the Priva hardware products and software services. 

  • Regulatory compliance (IEC 62443-4, ISO 27001, ISO 9001 or other standard that may be applicable in specific geographies) 

  • Threat intelligence briefing relevant to OT/IoT threat landscape 

  • Designing, implementing, and reviewing security controls applied at major customer sites. 

Above all, this is a hands-on role – occasionally writing code is included. You connect the industry’s best practices, ISO standards, product vision with the daily work of the product team. As a security architect, you practice what you preach. You explain, coach, and show by example the implementation of security as Secure SDLC in the developer’s daily work.  

To succeed in this role: 

  • You are passionate about OT security; you have great interest in the application of our products in the field. You are curious to grasp how our products truly work for our customers to find the best balance between security, reliability, and cost. You share the opinion that "if I don't secure Priva’s applications, then no one else will". 

  • You identify and eliminate issues in the development cycle that can jeopardize the security posture. You know and can show by example how to "test securely as well as test security" 

  • You are a great collaborator who can be a valuable sparring partner with product managers to understand and refine customer's needs for security so that you define the right security designs for market segments. Engineering managers rely on your ability to steer security implementations within the product teams. 

  • You are comfortable designing products that our customers will be running for years; comfortable providing guidance to LCM activities for existing customers to update hardware and software components to continuously stay secure. 

  • You share the knowledge about security subjects; you explain why security practices exist and what they achieve in the long run. 

  • You can translate security designs into engineering specifications, appraise implementation designs, conduct code reviews. This role with a strong hands-on component, not just a pure governance role. 

  • You understand and can register, document, and communicate clearly risks and trade-offs between differen t project execution scenarios 

  • You have had hands-on experience implementing security designs using modern programming language and frameworks, and you are able to coach product teams to increase their secure coding maturity e.g. by running threat modelling workshops with the engineering team. 

  • You have vast experience with architecture roles with 3-5 years of experience specifically focusing on security. 

In addition, you have the following technical expertise: 

  • Proven track record across at least two of the three domains: OT/IoT/embedded security, network security, cloud security 

  • You are familiar with modern authentication and authorization frameworks (JWT, OpenID, SAML) and (REST) API security and protection approached 

  • ISO 27001 and IEC 62443-4 understanding at a working level 

  • Working knowledge with or excellent ability to apply the PKI and certificate lifecycle management at scale; also, with the vision how to implement this in OT/IoT deployment contexts 

  • Solid network security understanding: firewall policy, micro-segmentation, DMZ design for IT/OT boundaries 

  • Zero trust architecture principles 

  • Secure SDLC and DevSecOps tools and practices (think about OWASP, SANS25, Snyk, Black Duck, etc) 

  


The following competence is desired: 

  • OT/ICS protocols and architectures (such as BACnet Secure Connect, Modbus, DNP3, MQTT, AMQP) 

  • Embedded device security for industrial PCs, systems-on-chip, and microcontrollers: secure boot, hardware security modules (HSMs), TPM, secure enclave concepts, firmware & data signing, encryption 

  • Cloud security on at least one major platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) 

  • Container and Kubernetes security

Your next mission

Anchor our system deliveries. Connect internal teams seamlessly – so our life-saving radars reach the front lines without delay.

As our Order & Delivery Coordinator (C-UAS), you run the administrative engine behind dispatching our IRIS radar systems. You take charge of order flows in Odoo ERP, align documentation, and organise clean internal handovers from Operations to dispatch readiness. Working alongside Project Management, Customer Success, and Operations, you keep our internal gears turning smoothly. Your sharp attention to detail ensures our teams stay focused and our radars deploy on schedule.

What you'll do

  • Order processing and data integrity: Process incoming sales orders in Odoo ERP across the entire lifecycle. Verify system data, hardware configurations, and commercial terms with high accuracy. Maintain order statuses, serial numbers, and delivery confirmations daily.

  • Compliance and export documentation: Compile and verify complete delivery documentation packages before dispatch. Review export control paperwork, QA certificates, shipping manifests, and packing lists. Ensure every system leaves our premises with watertight paperwork.

  • Logistics coordination and internal handovers: Coordinate handovers with the Warehouse and Logistics crew with complete shipping files. Monitor dispatch statuses once Operations releases each radar system. Keep internal handovers structured, clean, and ready for physical freight execution.

  • Cross-functional status tracking: Supply real-time ERP delivery status updates to Project Management and Customer Success. Share accurate tracking data and handover packages across departments. Monitor administrative workflows proactively to eliminate handover bottlenecks and protect dispatch targets.

What you bring

  • Vocational degree (MBO Level 4 / Associate degree) or equivalent practical experience in administration, supply chain, or logistics

  • 3+ years of experience in administrative support, order processing, or logistics coordination, preferably within a high-tech manufacturing or hardware environment

  • Practical experience working with ERP systems and databases (experience with Odoo is a strong advantage)

  • Experience handling compliance or logistics paperwork, such as shipping manifests, export control documentation, or QA certificates

  • Strong command of English (both written and spoken) and working proficiency in Dutch is considered a strong asset

  • High attention to detail with a methodical approach to data accuracy and documentation

  • Strong organisational and coordination skills to handle multiple handovers efficiently

  • Collaborative, supportive mindset suited for cross-functional internal operations

What we offer

  • Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

  • Comprehensive pension plan;

  • Commuting allowance;

  • 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

  • Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

  • High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role

  • An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Robin Radar is a defence technology leader in detecting, tracking and classifying drones and other small airborne objects. Our radars and software protect military sites, borders and critical infrastructure from drone threats, and also help prevent bird strikes in aviation and reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife. Our work shows up at defence and security sites, airports and wind farms around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat.

jobs.title: Senior Data & Analytics Engineer
jobs.description:
Looking for a new adventure? You’ve come to the right place.

We're an Amsterdam-based team of 100 (and counting) with 25+ nationalities amongst us! A varied bunch of “Citizens of The World” with a wide range of skills and hundreds of thousands of kilometers under our travel belts. And we have something important in common (other than our very well-worn passports): We want to change the way people travel.

And that's exactly what we're doing, with the travel app to plan, track, and relive trips in a smart and beautiful way.

Polarsteps has over 23 million users already, but, for us, this is just the beginning. We have big plans for the future, and so we need even more talented and enthusiastic people to help us on our journey.

Want to know more about us? Here you go.

Your expedition at Polarsteps - Senior Data & Analytics Engineer

Over the past 10+ years, Polarsteps has grown massively through word-of-mouth, thanks to our product and tech department building a top-quality user experience for all our travelers.

As our first Senior Data & Analytics Engineer, you'll own the foundation that every data-driven decision at Polarsteps is built on. Product & growth teams run experiments and analyse the data every week, leadership need clear reports for investors, and all of that depends on data that is reliable, modelled and compliant. You'll set the direction for our data platform, bring structure to data governance, and own the data infra that helps our product managers, marketers and data scientists do their job even better. You'll work closely with the Head of Engineering on infrastructure and architecture, and with the Head of Growth and product teams on what the business needs from data.

With 20M+ users and ratings of 4.8 and 4.7 on the app stores and features in multiple Google and Apple showcases, we've got an impressive past. But we're even more excited for the future, and you'll play a crucial role in building the data foundation that gets Polarsteps to 100M+ travelers around the globe.

Your itinerary

What your journey at Polarsteps will look like day-to-day.

  • Own the data platform roadmap: set the strategy for our data infrastructure and warehouse, make the build-vs-buy and tooling calls, and oversee execution together with DevOps.

  • Design, build and maintain scalable ingestion pipelines for both internal (product events, back-end data) and external sources (ad platforms, attribution, app store data).

  • Build and maintain a clean, documented modeling layer (e.g. dbt) that serves as the single source of truth for analysts, data scientists and self-serving PMs.

  • Lead data governance: define and enforce event naming and tracking standards, a schema change process, documentation, and dashboard ownership.

  • Embed privacy in the data stack: make sure personal data is categorized, minimized and pseudonymized before it reaches downstream and third-party tools, in close collaboration with Legal

  • Own the health of the stack: monitoring, alerting, data quality checks and cost management, so issues are caught before they reach stakeholders.

  • Define who owns what across our data tooling (e.g. Mixpanel, our warehouse and BI layer), and help teams get the most out of self-serve analytics.

  • Enable data enrichment to unlock deeper insights for Product and Growth.

  • Explore how we can safely use LLMs (such as Claude) on top of our data for analysis and reporting.

  • Act as the go-to data partner for Product, Engineering and Growth, and help grow the data function as Polarsteps scales.

The equipment in your backpack

What we're hoping you'll bring with you.

✅ 5+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering or a hybrid data role, ideally in a B2C product or mobile app company.

✅ Strong SQL and Python, and hands-on experience modeling large event datasets in a modern warehouse (e.g. ClickHouse, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift).

✅ Experience with dbt and an orchestration tool such as Airflow or Dagster.

✅ Proven track record of bringing structure to data governance: tracking plans, event ownership, documentation and data quality.

✅ Experience with product analytics tools (e.g. Mixpanel, Amplitude) and BI tools (e.g. Metabase, Looker).

✅ Comfortable owning infrastructure decisions: cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), infrastructure-as-code (e.g. Terraform), CI/CD for data.

✅ A pragmatic, ownership-driven mindset: you're happy to set the strategy and get your hands dirty, and you enjoy the hygiene work others tend to avoid.

✅ Excellent communication skills: you can explain trade-offs to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders alike.

Bonus points if you have:

✨ Experience with mobile attribution or marketing data (e.g. AppsFlyer, SKAdNetwork, ad platform APIs).

✨ Experience with reverse ETL or CDPs (e.g. RudderStack, Twilio Segment).

✨ Experience with experimentation data and A/B testing infrastructure.

✨ Knowledge of GDPR and handling personal data responsibly in an analytics stack.

1st class Polarsteps extras

Some cool things to make the journey extra sweet.

  • A yearly free flight or train ride to a random location! Give our Teleporter a spin here.

  • A shiny MacBook to work your magic on.

  • Hybrid working, our way. Work from home and the office, we ask everyone to be in the office 2 days a week. It’s how we stay flexible, focused, and meaningfully connected in person.

  • An extensive home office set-up, everything from noise-canceling headphones to a standing desk.

  • 30 days of vacation (for adventures or sitting on the couch, it's up to you).

  • Two paid Culture Days for days that are important to you but not recognized by the official Dutch calendar.

  • The option to switch up your zoom background by working from another country for up to 8 weeks a year.

  • A personal development budget for that curious mind of yours!

  • A pension plan to help you save for those around-the-world retirement trips.

  • Delicious daily team lunches.

  • Awesome monthly parties, as well as team trips away.

  • A lively office in downtown Amsterdam, with travel costs reimbursed.

  • Free Polarsteps Travel Books to contain all your far-flung adventures.

jobs.title: Afstudeerstage technische bedrijfskunde: energietransitie en energie-armoede
jobs.description:
Meer leren. Meer doen. Meer carrière. Dat is stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer.

Eindelijk kun je de theorie in de praktijk toepassen: jij hebt er zin in, en wij ook! Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam krijg jij de kans om midden in de actie te staan. Geen koffie halen of papierwerk, jij duikt samen met onze projectleider in de praktijk van energietransitie en energie-armoede. Of het nu gaat om het uitvoeren van inspecties of meedenken over interventies: jij maakt impact.

Dit wordt jouw stage 

Wil jij meedenken over een maatschappelijk vraagstuk dat steeds urgenter wordt? Tijdens deze stage duik je in het thema energiearmoede: wat is het precies, waar speelt het en wat betekent dit voor ons als organisatie? Je werkt op het snijvlak van sociaal en technisch en helpt ons om richting te bepalen: hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? Je werkt mee binnen één van onze teams en wordt begeleid door een ervaren collega. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen én om echt impact te maken. Op dit moment hebben wij één afstudeerstageplek rondom het thema energietransitie en energie-armoede 

 

Wat ga je doen? 
Je gaat onderzoeken wat energiearmoede inhoudt en hoe dit zich uit in de praktijk, met name in stedelijke gebieden zoals Amsterdam waar veel (sociale) huurwoningen zijn. 

Je houdt je bezig met: 

  • Het in kaart brengen van wat energiearmoede betekent;  

  • Inzicht krijgen in waar het speelt en welke doelgroepen geraakt worden; 

  • Gesprekken voeren met corporaties en marktpartijen (interviews, ophalen van ervaringen en data); 

  • Onderzoeken welke oplossingen er zijn, zoals passief bouwen, minder installaties of slimme energieoplossingen; 

  • Vertalen van jouw inzichten naar een duidelijke visie: waar moeten wij ons op richten en hoe kunnen wij hierop inspelen? 

 

Het gaat hierbij niet om de techniek alleen, maar juist om de combinatie van sociale impact, marktontwikkelingen en strategie. 

Dit is jouw team

Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam is een ontwikkelende bouwer met zo'n 220 enthousiaste collega’s. Wij zijn onderdeel van de Divisie Bouw en Vastgoed en herkenbaar in groen en geel. Onze ambitie is groot en met veel enthousiasme ontwikkelen en bouwen we gezonde en fijne leefomgevingen, waar mensen zich thuis voelen. Benieuwd waar wij ons mee bezig houden? Bekijk hier een paar van onze huidige projecten: Projecten Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Amsterdam


Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week;

  • Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven;

  • Tijd voor je schoolopdrachten/examens;

  • De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer;

  • Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan!

 

Dit breng je mee 

  • Je doet een hbo- of wo-studie in de richting van bouwkunde, built environment, duurzaamheid, technische bedrijfskunde of een vergelijkbare studie; 

  • Nieuwsgierigheid naar veiligheid in de praktijk, vooral in de bouwsector;

  • Niet bang om je handen uit de mouwen te steken;

  • Proactief, sociaal en je werkt graag samen, maar weet ook zelfstandig je weg te vinden;

  • Beschikbaar vanaf februari 2027 voor minimaal 4 dagen per week.

 

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijnvisie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Meer weten? Neem contact op met onze Campus recruiter!

Heb je nog overige vragen? Schroom niet om contact op te nemen met Sanne Jonk via 06 34955966 of  

Hopelijk spreken we elkaar snel!

Stagecoördinator – Passenger Services
jobs.description:
Over dnata

dnata is more than a global air and travel services provider. We connect people with possibilities and opportunities across 130+ airports in 34 countries through ground handling, cargo, travel, and catering & retail services. Our purpose is clear: to deliver on the promises our customers make. We are powered by a bold vision to be the world’s most admired air and travel services provider, which guides our strategy, culture, and every role across our teams. Our core values fuel everything we do: we are safe, we play to win, we respect everyone and work together as a team, and we are future thinking. At dnata, we foster diversity, nurture ambition, and celebrate achievement. If you're inspired by purpose and motivated to be part of a global team shaping the future of aviation and travel, we’d love to have you onboard.

Over de rol

Een goede stage kan het begin zijn van een mooie carrière. Als Stagecoördinator bij dnata Passenger Services speel jij een belangrijke rol in het creëren van een leerzame, veilige en succesvolle stageperiode. Je vormt de verbindende schakel tussen stagiairs, onderwijsinstellingen, recruitment en de operationele leidinggevenden. Daarbij kijk je verder dan alleen de stageperiode: je signaleert talent en helpt geschikte stagiairs hun weg te vinden naar een mogelijke functie binnen dnata. Zo draag je niet alleen bij aan de ontwikkeling van jonge professionals, maar ook aan de toekomstige personeelsbezetting en talentontwikkeling van Passenger Services!

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Instroom en introductie: Je brengt de behoefte aan stagiairs en de beschikbare begeleidingscapaciteit in kaart. Je voert sollicitatiegesprekken, stemt de selectie en plaatsing af met Recruitment en leidinggevenden en coördineert de introductie, trainingen en stageafspraken.

  • Begeleiding en ontwikkeling: Je stelt samen met stagiairs en onderwijsinstellingen leerdoelen op, voert regelmatig voortgangsgesprekken en coacht stagiairs tijdens hun stage. Ook organiseer je tussentijdse evaluaties en eindevaluaties en beoordeel je stageopdrachten en eindverslagen.

  • Relatiebeheer en samenwerking: Je onderhoudt contacten met onderwijsinstellingen, bespreekt stagevoorwaarden en evaluatiemomenten en onderzoekt mogelijkheden om het netwerk van dnata uit te breiden. Daarnaast vertegenwoordig je dnata op stagebeurzen en open dagen.

  • Talentontwikkeling en doorstroom: Je volgt de stage-ervaring en toekomstwensen van stagiairs, signaleert mogelijke uitval en onderzoekt de redenen voor voortijdig vertrek. Je adviseert Duty Managers en Recruitment over geschikte kandidaten voor een dienstverband en coördineert de overdracht na afloop van de stage.

  • Monitoring en verbetering: Je houdt gegevens bij over instroom, lopende stages, afronding, uitval en doorstroom. Je rapporteert over de voortgang en begeleidingscapaciteit, signaleert knelpunten en doet voorstellen om het stageproces continu te verbeteren.


Wat breng je mee?

Vereisten:

  • Mbo 4 werk- en denkniveau.

  • Een relevante opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in luchtvaartdienstverlening, personeelsmanagement of begeleiding en coaching.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden en coachen van stagiairs of medewerkers binnen Aviation.

  • Ervaring met het voeren van sollicitatie-, voortgangs- en beoordelingsgesprekken.

  • Je beschikt over goede coachingsvaardigheden en weet anderen te motiveren in hun ontwikkeling.

  • Kennis van stageprocessen, leerdoelen en de samenwerking met onderwijsinstellingen.

  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en weet op een consequente en rechtvaardige manier richting te geven.

  • Goede mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van zowel het Nederlands als het Engels.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een marktconform salaris, passend bij jouw ervaring en conform de CAO WPBL.

  • Eventuele onregelmatigheidstoeslagen volgens de CAO WPBL.

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding conform de CAO WLVA, gratis busvervoer en parkeermogelijkheden.

  • Een goede pensioenregeling, waarbij dnata bijdraagt aan jouw pensioenopbouw.

  • Opleidings- en doorgroeimogelijkheden via de dnata Training Academy.

Klaar om het verschil te maken? Solliciteer vandaag nog en word onderdeel van dnata Nederland!

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Security Engineer - Maatwerk Software met Impact

Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij.

Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details.

Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Security Engineer. Iemand die veel energie krijgt van het opbouwen van een nieuw technisch securitydomein. Een gedreven specialist die graag zelf de regie neemt over de inrichting van moderne tooling en veilige architectuur.

Jouw rol

Als Security Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor de technische beveiliging van onze infrastructuur, interne werkplekken en cloudomgevingen. Je bouwt het securitydomein verder uit en selecteert de juiste tooling voor Dawn. Je beheert de gekozen systemen en richt deze tot in de puntjes in. Daarbij vertaal je complexe techniek naar een gedegen en onderbouwd advies voor verschillende afdelingen. Je vormt hiermee de verbindende brug tussen tech leads, hostingteams en Interne IT. Beleid en compliance pakt het ISO-team op, zo kun jij je volledig op de techniek focussen.

Wat je zal gaan doen:

  • Je werkt mee aan en verbetert centrale security-tooling zoals EDR en SIEM.

  • Je werkt hands-on aan kwetsbaarhedenbeheer, actieve detectie, monitoring en het ontwerpen van hardening-standaarden.

  • Je adviseert tech leads en hostingteams over veilige architectuur en helpt hen bij security-initiatieven.

  • Je fungeert als het vaste technische aanspreekpunt voor het SOC en beoordeelt samen escalaties.

  • Je draait mee in de technische analyse bij incidenten en bewaart de rust binnen het crisisteam.


Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een hbo-denkniveau en bij voorkeur een achtergrond in Cyber Security of Informatica. Je brengt een stevige basis mee in security engineering of infrastructuurbeveiliging. Je bezit hands-on ervaring met moderne security controls, IAM, secure configuration en kwetsbaarhedenmanagement. Kennis van cloudomgevingen zoals AWS en affiniteit met netwerkarchitectuur is een grote pré.

Je bent zeer leergierig naar nieuwe technieken en toetst gemaakte keuzes altijd scherp en kritisch. Je zoekt actief de verbinding met collega's om samen de beveiliging naar een hoger niveau te brengen. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels en bent bereid om (hybride) te werken op onze kantoren in Geldermalsen en Hilversum.

Wat bieden wij jou?

  • De Organisatie: Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software.

  • Autonomie: Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie.

  • Maatschappelijke Impact: Je beveiligt cruciale systemen voor Dawn Technology en haar klanten.

  • Salaris: Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4.500,- en €6.000,- passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Vakantiedagen: 25 vakantiedagen om volop te ontspannen.

  • Werkplek & Sfeer: Gezellige werksfeer, flexibele werktijden, hybride werken en verzorgde lunch op kantoor (verschillende locaties maar je bent voornamelijk te vinden in Geldermalsen en Hilversum).

  • Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken: Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding en een fiscaal fietsplan.

  • Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen.

  • Ontwikkeling & Extra's: Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen.

  • Events & Fun: Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events.

Over Dawn Technology

We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen, van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend.

Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast.

Solliciteren

Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit op deze rol, nodigen we je juist uit om te solliciteren. We denken namelijk graag met je mee! Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360.

Have a great day. Dawn Technology.

We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment om de match met de rol objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.
