jobs.title: Content Creator - YouTube
jobs.description:
Important: Applications without an intro video will not be considered.


Job Overview

Create engaging YouTube tutorials about software, digital marketing, and AI tools that reach millions of people around the world every month through our YouTube channel, Metics Media.


About us

Metics Media is a small, fully remote team creating high-quality YouTube videos about software, digital marketing, and AI tools for an audience of over 700,000 subscribers. Our mission is simple: to make technology easy to understand and help people get the most out of the tools available to them.

We partner with leading platforms like Shopify, Hostinger, and Squarespace, allowing us to keep our content free and accessible to everyone.

We're now looking for talented, motivated content creators to join our growing team, help us produce even more high-quality videos, and reach millions more people around the world.


What you'll do
  • Research each video's topic and tools in depth, and figure out what to cover and how to present it in a clear, engaging way.
  • Write video scripts and outlines.
  • Record videos, including talking-head and screen recordings. Your face will be visible in your videos.
  • Perform basic video editing tasks and prepare footage for our in-house editor.


What we're looking for
  • Native-level written and spoken English
  • Strong on-camera presentation skills and the ability to communicate clearly and confidently
  • Ability to quickly understand complex topics and explain them clearly to beginners
  • Strong research skills and the ability to verify information before presenting it
  • AI-native and highly proficient with modern AI tools, using them effectively to work faster, improve quality, and maximize productivity
  • High attention to detail and a strong commitment to producing high-quality work
  • Ability to take feedback and continuously improve
  • Reliable, organized, and able to work independently and take ownership of your projects
  • Genuine interest in YouTube, online tools, software, and learning new topics
  • A quiet, dedicated workspace where you can work without interruptions, with room to set up a small studio for recording talking-head videos with minimal background noise
  • Fast internet connection with at least 50 Mbps download and 25 Mbps upload
  • Legal authorization to work in the US or Canada


Nice to have
  • Previous experience creating educational video content
  • Knowledge of topics such as website creation, AI tools, ecommerce, or other areas we regularly create videos about
  • Equipment needed to produce high-quality videos


Working at Metics Media

At Metics Media, you'll have a lot of freedom in how you work. You'll be trusted to structure your own day, manage your projects independently, and take ownership of your work. We're a small, ambitious team with high standards, and we're always looking for ways to improve what we create and how we work.

At the same time, you'll get hands-on support, feedback, and training from people with over 8 years of experience making YouTube videos.


Compensation
  • Base salary: $70,000 USD per year (US) / CA$80,000 per year (Canada)
  • Profit sharing: Earn a percentage of the profit generated by every video you create, paid out quarterly
  • For reference, our current creators have earned an average total compensation (base salary + profit-sharing bonuses) of $85,000 USD in their first year and $155,000 USD in their second year. These figures are based on the past performance of our current creator team and are not guaranteed.


Benefits
  • 15 days of paid vacation per year, plus public holidays
  • 10 paid sick days per year
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • A 401(k) with employer contributions (US)


How to apply

Applications require a short intro video (max. 5 minutes) and your CV. Click "Apply" for all details.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Forward Deployed Architect on Notion’s Services team, you will help customers turn AI ambition into operational reality and unlock the full potential of our platform. You will partner directly with customers to design, build, and launch AI-native workflows that drive adoption, usage, and measurable business outcomes.

This role sits at the center of Notion’s workflow-led GTM motion. You will partner directly with customers to understand their business goals, operating processes, technical environment, governance needs, and adoption barriers, then translate that context into scalable Notion architectures that drive measurable value.

You will be hands-on across discovery, solution design, workspace architecture, workflow build, AI implementation, launch planning, adoption and handoff. You will work deeply with customers to define what Notion should own, where it should integrate with existing systems, and how Notion can become a durable operating layer for their teams.

The best candidates combine strong consultative discovery, systems thinking, technical fluency, AI-native workflow design, implementation judgment and exceptional customer presence. You should be comfortable reasoning through technical tradeoffs, designing scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Forward Deployed Engineering when deeper engineering support is required. 

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Partner with customers on forward deployed engagements from discovery through launch, translating business goals and workflow requirements into scalable clear solution design and Notion solutions that drive durable adoption.

 - Design scalable Notion architectures that translate customer workflows, permission and governance needs, integrations and AI use cases into optimal workspaces that are easy to adopt, manage and scale.

 - Design and deploy AI-native workflows using Notion AI, custom agents, automations, Workers, Developer Platform capabilities and adjacent AI tools, partnering with Forward Deployed Engineering when advanced technical depth is needed for migrations, API constraints, security architecture or frontier implementation.

 - Help customers navigate change by designing adoption plans, enablement materials and launch approaches that drive sustained usage and measurable business value.

 - Identify repeatable patterns across customer engagements and convert them into packaged solutions, templates, reference architectures, run books, enablement assets and product feedback.

 - Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, simplifying complex technical requirements, making practical tradeoff recommendations and helping stakeholders align around a clear implementation path.

 - Partner cross-functionally with GTM, Product, Engineering, PMM, Services leadership and the partner ecosystem to scale what works beyond individual customer engagements.

 - Create clear implementation plans, handoff materials and success measures that align customers and internal teams on the path to value.

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of experience in tech services/consulting, solutions architecture, implementation, customer engineering, or a similar customer-facing role.

 - Proven ability to translate ambiguous customer goals into clear workflows, implementation plans, solution architectures, and measurable success criteria.

 - Strong consultative discovery skills, including the ability to map current-state workflows, identify customer pain, understand operating models, surface technical constraints, and define practical future-state solutions.

 - Hands-on AI builder mindset, with experience using AI tools to design, prototype, automate, or improve real business workflows.

 - Technical fluency with APIs, integrations, data models, automation, enterprise systems, developer workflows and implementation tradeoffs. You do not need to write production code but you should be able to reason through technical constraints and troubleshoot effectively.

 - Strong experience delivering implementations that drive adoption, change management and long-term customer value.

 - Strong project and engagement management skills, including ownership of scope, timeline, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, risks, decisions, dependencies and launch readiness.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for business, technical, and executive audiences.

 - Strong executive presence and customer judgment, with the ability to build trust, frame tradeoffs clearly, and move ambiguous decisions forward.

 - Bias toward action, high learning velocity, and comfort building in fast-changing AI-native product environments.

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience designing or deploying Agents, automations or AI-powered workflows with Customers.

 - Experience with Notion, APIs, MCPs, Workers, coding agents or developer platform workflows.

 - Experience developing discovery methodologies, reusable delivery assets, internal tooling, packaged services or reference architectures from the ground up.

 - Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to turn field learnings into roadmap signal, reusable architecture patterns or scalable product improvements.

 - Previous experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology environment.

 

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21

 

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Construction - Engineering Summer Placement
jobs.description: Role Purpose Applications are open for voluntary Engineering Summer Placements with Glanua in Ireland and the United Kingdom. The placement is intended for students who want practical engineering experience during their semester break and are available from the start of June to the end of August. The opportunity is open to students across all engineering subjects, including civil, mechanical, electrical, chemical, environmental, process, structural, energy, automation and related disciplines. Students will join a suitable office, design, project or site team according to their course, interests, location and available business needs. Summer Placement Experience You will work alongside experienced engineers and project colleagues on live water, wastewater, bioresources or supporting infrastructure activities. Your work will be supervised and matched to your stage of study, giving you an introduction to professional engineering practice, project delivery, safety and teamwork. This is a general summer placement advert rather than a rotational programme. Placements will normally remain with one host team and location, although occasional visits to another office, project or site may be required. Specific responsibilities will vary by discipline and project needs. Key Responsibilities Engineering and Project Support Support engineers with drawings, calculations, specifications, schedules, technical records or other project information under supervision. Help collect, organise and review project data, site information, supplier details or asset records for use by the host team. Prepare clear notes, trackers, presentations and document updates using approved templates and project systems. Take part in design reviews, planning meetings or coordination activities appropriate to your discipline and stage of study. Design Delivery and Site Exposure Learn how engineering designs are developed, checked and translated into safe, practical solutions for water and wastewater projects. Assist with supervised site visits, surveys, inspections, commissioning preparation or progress records where relevant to the placement. Support quality, environmental and health and safety requirements by following instructions, completing records and raising questions promptly. Work with colleagues from different engineering and project disciplines and observe how teams coordinate clients, suppliers and construction activities. Learning Safety and Team Contribution Complete the induction, mandatory safety training and any role-specific learning required before carrying out placement activities. Attend team briefings, ask questions and use feedback from engineers, supervisors and project colleagues to improve your work. Contribute to a practical improvement, research task, technical summary or project deliverable agreed with the host team. Keep an accurate record of learning and experience that may support academic reflection, a placement report or future career planning. Our Values At Glanua, our values shape how we work together and how we serve our clients. We act with Respect towards our colleagues, clients and communities, and believe in the power of Collaboration to deliver the best outcomes for our teams and projects. We hold ourselves to a high standard of Accountability, taking ownership of our commitments, and act with Integrity in every decision we make. We pursue Excellence in everything we do, continuously improving how we design, build and operate, and we place Safety at the centre of our culture, ensuring the wellbeing of our people is never compromised. As an Engineering Summer Placement student, you will be expected to demonstrate these values in your day-to-day work and learning. Essential Criteria Currently enrolled in an engineering degree, diploma or equivalent programme at a recognised university, college or institute of technology. Seeking a voluntary summer placement during semester break and available from the start of June to the end of August. An interest in applying engineering knowledge to water, wastewater, environmental or related infrastructure projects. A basic understanding of engineering principles relevant to your course and a willingness to learn from other disciplines. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with good organisation and attention to detail. A responsible approach to health, safety, quality, the environment and confidential project information. Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint, with confidence learning project or engineering systems. Ability to meet the right-to-work requirements for Ireland or the United Kingdom, as applicable, and to travel to the assigned office or project location. Desirable Criteria Academic project, laboratory, workshop, site, volunteering or previous work experience relevant to engineering. Familiarity with computer-aided design, modelling, data analysis, programming or other technical tools used in your discipline. An interest in sustainable infrastructure, resource recovery and the water sector. Personal Attributes Proactive, curious and eager to learn from experienced colleagues. Collaborative and respectful, with a positive approach to teamwork. Safety-conscious and willing to speak up when something does not look right. Adaptable and practical when working across different tasks, projects and environments. Organised and attentive to detail, with the confidence to ask questions and apply feedback. Diversity, Equity & Inclusion At Glanua, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and has an equal opportunity to succeed. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and value the different perspectives and experiences they bring. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let our recruitment team know.

jobs.title: AP/AR Specialist till Nordaq
jobs.description: Vill du utvecklas inom redovisning i ett svenskt bolag med internationell expansion och ett tydligt fokus på kvalitet och hållbarhet?Nu söker vi en AP/AR Specialist till Nordaq - ett innovativt företag som producerar vattenfiltreringslösningar i världsklass och befinner sig på en spännande tillväxtresa internationellt.Om rollenI den här rollen får du en varierad och utvecklande vardag där du arbetar med löpande redovisning med tyngdpunkt på kund- och leverantörsreskontra och samtidigt får möjlighet att bredda din kompetens genom att stötta inköps- och logistikteamet. Du blir en viktig del av ekonomifunktionen och får arbeta nära verksamheten i ett bolag där samarbete och kvalitet genomsyrar allt de gör.De har nyligen implementerat ett nytt ekonomisystem Rootstock, vilket innebär att du får möjlighet att vara med och påverka arbetssätt, rutiner och processer- och bidra till att skapa effektiva flöden som underlättar det dagliga arbetet.Du kommer framför allt att arbeta nära Redovisningsansvarig samt Head of Accounting och ha kontakt med kollegor både i Sverige och internationellt. Har du kunskaper i franska, är det en stor merit, då du kommer att ha mycket utbyte med det franska finansteamet.Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter kommer att vara: •    Kund- och leverantörsreskontra•    Löpande bokföring och kontoavstämningar•    Medverkan i bokslutsarbete•    Administrativt stöd till logistik och försäljning, exempelvis genom att skapa och hantera säljordrar i Salesforce•    Logistikhantering, dvs. kontakt med Nordaqs:s hubbar vid packning och skeppning av ordrarVem är du 💜För att trivas hos Nordaq tror vi att du är en person som vill utvecklas, tar ansvar och gillar att arbete med siffror och i nära samarbete och kontakt med kollegor. Du är strukturerad och noggrann, men också nyfiken och prestigelös.Vi ser gärna att du:Du har en grundläggande utbildning inom ekonomi och minst 1–2 års erfarenhet av arbete inom redovisning eller ekonomi. Som person är du analytisk, strukturerad och självgående, samtidigt som du är serviceinriktad och trivs med att samarbeta med andra. Du är kommunikativ och social, och bidrar naturligt till en positiv teamkänsla genom ditt sätt att arbeta och möta kollegor och samarbetspartners.Kvalifikationer•    Högskoleutbildning eller motsvarande inom ekonomi•    Minst 1–2 års yrkeserfarenhet av AP/AR•    Erfarenhet av arbete i ekonomisystem•    Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska Meriterande: •    Erfarenhet av CRM Salesforce och ERP Rootstock•    Erfarenhet av ekonomi i bolag med lagerverksamhet•    Kunskaper i franskaVad erbjuder Nordaq dig? ✨•    Ett glatt, engagerat och ambitiöst team med stark gemenskap•    Ett modernt och ljust kontor i centrala Stockholm•    Roliga aktiviteter och AW:s•    Möjlighet till distansarbete en dag per vecka•    Självklart: riktigt gott premium-vatten 💧Låter det som något för dig? Skicka in din ansökan idag! Vi ser fram emot din ansökan och att få berätta mer om hur det är att arbeta på Nordaq!Omfattning och placeringDetta är en direktrekrytering med 6 månaders provanställning. Du utgår från huvudkontoret på Kungsgatan 8 i centrala Stockholm, med möjlighet att arbeta 1 dag/v på distans. Arbetstider: mån-fre 8-17 med flex. Önskad start: omgående eller så snart som möjligt.Om NordaqMeet NORDAQ. Described as the 'purest tasting water' by the best chefs and sommeliers around the world. We offer a more profitable, sustainable and tasteful alternative to ordinary bottled water for all businesses where both taste experience and environmental responsibility are at the core. We are still and sparkling water, tapped and capped on site. Water as Nature intended.Founded in Stockholm in 2005, Nordaq harnesses patented technology to provide premium, sustainable end-to-end water solutions. Operating in 67 countries, with around 60 employees worldwide, of which 12 are at the HQ in Stockholm. The Place – Sveriges enda Worklife Partner För dig som söker nytt jobb är The Place din trygga punkt. I just denna rekrytering sköter våra kompetenta rekryteringskonsulter processen, från intervju till anställningserbjudande. Sedan blir du anställd av kundföretaget. Vi är stolta över våra fina samarbeten med en stor mängd intressanta och spännande företag – och det innebär ju många karriärmöjligheter för dig!

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Hämeenlinnaan
jobs.description: Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Hämeenlinnaan.Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.**Tarjoamme sinulle**- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G16A - Joustavan työajan - Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan - Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan - Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen - Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin **Toivomme sinulta**- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan - Positiivista ja iloista asennetta - Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi - Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain **48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa** sekä **55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä**. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteensosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti! Lisätietoja tehtävästä kaivatessasi voit olla yhteydessä meihin sähköpostitse hkapuhr@validia.fi**Rekrytoinnin eteneminen**Panostamme siihen, että rekrytointi on reilua ja että juuri sinun osaamisesi pääsee esiin. Tässä rekrytoinnissa hyödynnämme **Hubert.ai -tekoälyhaastattelua.**Hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen sinut kutsutaan chat-pohjaiseen haastatteluun virtuaalisen rekrytointiassistenttimme Hubertin kanssa. Haastattelu kestää noin 15-20 minuuttia, ja voit tehdä sen sinulle sopivana aikana. Suosittelemme kuitenkin aloittamaan sen pian, jotta rekrytointi etenee sujuvasti. Tekoälypohjainen haastattelu toimii vain tukityökaluna, kaikki lopulliset arviot ja päätökset tekee ihminen.

jobs.title: Talent Partner
Head of Accounting till Nordaq
jobs.description: Vill du ta ett övergripande ansvar för redovisning och finansiell rapportering i en internationell koncern?Vi söker dig som trivs i en bred och operativ roll där du får kombinera kvalificerat redovisningsarbete med samordning och utveckling av processer. Du får en central roll med stort eget ansvar, personalansvar för två medarbetare och rapporterar direkt till bolagets CEO.Önskad start: Omgående / december 2026Om rollen 💜Som Head of Accounting ansvarar du för att samordna och kvalitetssäkra den finansiella rapporteringen från koncernens utländska dotterbolag. Du är huvudkontakt gentemot lokala redovisningsbyråer och revisorer och säkerställer att rapporteringen håller hög kvalitet och sker enligt uppsatta deadlines.Du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt, med ett stort eget ansvar för att redovisningen fungerar som den ska. Det är en roll för dig som tycker om att ha överblick, men som också är prestigelös och gärna går in och stöttar där det behövs.I rollen kommer du bland annat att:• Samordna och kvalitetssäkra den finansiella rapporteringen från koncernens utländska dotterbolag.• Vara huvudsaklig kontaktperson för lokala redovisningsbyråer och följa upp att rapporteringen sker enligt fastställda deadlines.• Granska månads- och kvartalsrapporter samt identifiera och följa upp eventuella avvikelser.• Säkerställa korrekta avstämningar av koncerninterna transaktioner och mellanhavanden.• Verka för att gemensamma redovisningsprinciper och rapporteringsrutiner tillämpas inom koncernen.• Förbereda och kvalitetssäkra underlag för koncernkonsolidering i samarbete med extern partner.• Stötta lokala bolag och redovisningsbyråer i redovisningsrelaterade frågor.• Vara huvudkontakt gentemot revisorer.• Ansvara för och stötta två medarbetare samt bidra till utveckling av redovisningsfunktionens arbetssätt och processer.Utöver redovisningsansvaret ingår även vissa personaladministrativa uppgifter, exempelvis hantering av anställningsavtal och kontakt med extern lönebyrå.Vem vi söker 💜Vi söker dig som har en gedigen grund inom redovisning och som känner dig trygg i att självständigt hantera och kvalitetssäkra redovisningsprocesser. Du har sannolikt arbetat i minst 5–7 år med kvalificerad redovisning och har erfarenhet av såväl bokslutsarbete som årsredovisning.Du är van vid att arbeta med flera kontaktytor och har förmågan att skapa struktur, driva uppföljning och säkerställa att rapportering levereras med hög kvalitet och i rätt tid. Eftersom koncernen har internationella dotterbolag är det viktigt att du trivs med att samarbeta över landsgränser och kommunicera obehindrat på både svenska och engelska.Vi tror också att du är en prestigelös och lösningsorienterad person som trivs i en roll med stor bredd. Du tycker om att ta ansvar och driva ditt arbete framåt, men har samtidigt inga problem med att kavla upp ärmarna och hjälpa till där det behövs, vare sig det gäller HR-frågor, logistik eller lagerhantering.Vi ser gärna att du har:Skallkrav• Minst 5–7 års erfarenhet av kvalificerat redovisningsarbete.• Självständig erfarenhet av bokslut och årsredovisning.• Goda kunskaper inom K3 och svensk redovisning.• Erfarenhet av koncernrapportering, konsolidering och avstämningar av koncerninterna transaktioner (intercompany).• Erfarenhet av att koordinera och samarbeta med externa redovisningspartners.• Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel och erfarenhet av ERP-system.• Flytande svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.Meriterande• Erfarenhet från internationella koncerner.• Erfarenhet av ERP-systemet Rootstock.• Erfarenhet av lagerredovisning och redovisning av anläggningstillgångar.• Erfarenhet av personalledning och processutveckling.• Erfarenhet av HR- och personaladministration, exempelvis hantering av anställningsavtal och kontakt med extern lönebyrå.• Språkkunskaper i Franska.Om NordaqMeet NORDAQ. jobs.title: SAP Solution Architect
jobs.description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:Is the feeling of having a meaningful job something you like? Would you like to share your thoughts and knowledge to enable growth and profitability? Do you want tho work with ERP services globally? Then this just might be the right challenge for you as we are looking for new team members to our SAP SAP team. We have a multi ERP strategy within Epiroc and one of our global managed ERP applications is SAP. Our current SAP installation consist of 4 different SAP ERP solutions that is used by 20 customer centers and 2 productions centers. We have started the cloud journey of upgrade one of our installations for the customer center to the SAP S4HANA. The upgrade will let our business to be able to utilise the latest functionality provided from the SAP application. We are therefore looking for strengthening the team with SAP Solution Architect. We work in an open and friendly way, where we support each other to ensure we provide the best possible solutions for our users. We complement each other with a broad knowledge, and we make sure to have fun at work. Within Epiroc IT so have we started the transformation to an agile working model.   Your Mission As SAP Solution Architect, you will design and govern SAP solutions that align with business strategy while ensuring scalable, future-proof architecture. You will translate business requirements into SAP functional and technical designs. Ensure integration across SAP modules and surrounding systems. Standardization and template based delivery is important factors for the SAP environment. You should be updated on new technology and functionality that can improve the solution.Profile description:Your profileYou have an experience within SAP ERP Solutions. You have a University Degree or similar knowledge gained through work experience. Experience with leading teams is beneficial.   You have more than 4 years of experience within an IT area in an international company. As for your personal skills we are looking for someone who is goal orientated, fast learner and eager to learn along the way. You are able to adopt new technologies and tools when needed, open-minded to enjoy intellectual sparring and knowledge sharing. The job requires a lot of collaboration both internally and externally so good interpersonal and communications skills are a prerequisite to be successful in the role. We also expect you to have good analytical and administration skills. Location and travel The location is preferable at one of our Epiroc IT hubs, located in Örebro or Stockholm, (Sweden), Prague, (Czech Republic).   International travel will be part of the role. jobs.title: Head of Commercial Products
jobs.employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
jobs.description:
As Head of Commercial Products at Impact Fund Denmark, you will turn investment ideas and investor requirements into commercially viable funds and other investment products. You will build the financial models and fund structures that enable Impact Fund Denmark to attract additional private capital for investments in developing and emerging markets.

You will take responsibility for financial structuring and product development, combining hands-on modelling with a visible role in investor discussions. Working closely with the Head of Investor Relations, you will explain product economics, support fundraising and contribute technical expertise to the ongoing investor dialogue for existing funds.

The role is part of Legal, Compliance and Commercial (LCC), led by Frederik Bjørn, General Counsel & Chief Commercial Officer. LCC brings together Legal Corporate, Legal Transactions, Compliance (Non-Financial Risk), and Sales and Investor Relations and consists of around 15 colleagues across Copenhagen and IFDK’s international locations.

You will work in a highly collaborative environment, with close interaction across Investor Relations, Legal, Risk and the wider investment organisation. The team values openness, constructive challenge and strong professional collaboration. You will have considerable ownership of your area while drawing on specialist expertise from colleagues across LCC, Investment, Finance, Risk, Valuation and Strategy & Business Development.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Design and structure investment products, including tranches with different risk and return profiles, risk-sharing arrangements and guarantees.

  • Build and challenge financial models using cash-flow analysis, scenarios and simulations, including Monte Carlo methods, to assess outcomes for investors and IFDK.

  • Assess how funds and products work together, including risk allocation and the implications of different investment and guarantee structures.

  • Develop fee and pricing models that reflect the economics of each product and the resources required to manage it.

  • Develop investor and sales materials and present products alongside the Head of Investor Relations, explaining structures, risks and returns and answering product-specific questions in investor due diligence.

  • Contribute financial analysis to information memoranda and ongoing investor reporting, and participate in Limited Partner Advisory Committee (LPAC) meetings and other investor fora for existing funds.

  • Work with Investment, Finance, Legal, Risk and Valuation colleagues to translate investor and guarantee requirements into clear responsibilities and processes throughout fund and product lifecycles.

YOUR FIRST YEAR

  • A consistent approach to financial modelling and clear investor materials supports product design, fundraising and ongoing investor dialogue.

  • Structuring and pricing options for priority products have been assessed, with clear recommendations on risk allocation and economics.

  • Responsibilities and handovers for key investor and guarantee requirements are agreed with the relevant teams.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

You bring substantial experience in financial structuring and investment products, with the commercial judgement and credibility to take ownership and engage directly with institutional and other private investors. You have:

  • A relevant master’s degree in finance, economics or a related discipline with a strong quantitative foundation.

  • Experience personally building financial models and developing or structuring investment products.

  • A strong understanding of risk, return, cash flows and how financial structures allocate outcomes between different investors.

  • Experience working with institutional investors, supporting institutional clients or working on the investment side of a pension company.

  • Experience presenting complex financial topics to investors or institutional clients, with the ability to turn analysis into clear recommendations and respond confidently to technical questions.

  • Strong written and spoken Danish and English.

You combine technical depth with commercial judgement, take ownership of detailed work and collaborate effectively across specialist functions. Experience with illiquid assets or private-market fund structures would be an advantage.

WHERE THE ROLE SITS

Based in Copenhagen, you will report directly to Frederik Bjørn, General Counsel & Chief Commercial Officer, and work closely with the Head of Investor Relations. You will have analytical support from Strategy & Business Development for product development and investor-related work.

WHY JOIN US

You will shape how IFDK combines institutional investor requirements, financial returns and impact. The role offers ownership of product development, direct exposure to investors and broad collaboration across IFDK, with the opportunity to see your work through from financial design to fundraising and ongoing investor reporting.

PRACTICAL DETAILS

Location: Copenhagen | Position: Full-time | Start date: By agreement

Please apply through IFDK’s recruitment platform with your CV and a short application explaining your interest in the role and relevant experience.

jobs.title: Terminalmedarbejder til aftenhold i Hvidovre - try and hire
jobs.description:
På vegne af vores samarbejdspartner søger vi en engageret, kvalitetsbevidst og initiativrig terminalen i Hvidovre. Der er tale om et 3-måneders fuldtidsvikariat med henblik på fastansættelse for den rette kandidat.

Du bliver en del af et try-and-hire-forløb, hvor de første 3 måneder giver både dig og virksomheden mulighed for at se hinanden an med henblik på en permanent ansættelse.

Du bliver en del af en af Skandinaviens største globale transport- og logistikvirksomheder, hvor du indgår i et dynamisk team med 10-15 gode kollegaer. Her er der fokus på kvalitet, samarbejde og et godt socialt arbejdsmiljø.

Vi søger ikke bare en kollega, men også en person, der har lyst til at tage ansvar, byde ind og være en aktiv del af hverdagen. Du må gerne være lidt fremme i skoene, have en udadvendt personlighed og trives med at tage initiativ – både når det gælder arbejdsopgaverne og det sociale fællesskab.

Du får en alsidig hverdag, hvor du sammen med teamet skal være med til at sikre, at driften på terminalen fungerer optimalt. 

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet omfatte:

  • Aflæsning og læsning af gods

  • Varemodtagelse og klargøring af varer til forsendelse

  • Brug af kørende udstyr

  • Dokumenthåndtering

  • Registrering og håndtering af varer i lagerstyringssystemet

  • Diverse manuelle lageropgaver

Det er vigtigt, at du er indstillet på, at jobbet ikke udelukkende foregår på truck. En del af arbejdsdagen vil også bestå af manuelle og fysisk krævende opgaver, herunder løft og håndtering af gods.

Vi forestiller os, at du er en udadvendt og engageret person, der både fagligt og socialt har lyst til at være en del af et team.

Vi søger dig, som:

  • Har et gyldigt truckcertifikat

  • Er indstillet på både truckkørsel og fysisk krævende, manuelle lageropgaver

  • Trives i et travlt og internationalt miljø

  • Er initiativrig og ikke bange for at tage ansvar

  • Er udadvendt og bidrager aktivt til et godt socialt arbejdsmiljø

  • Har en proaktiv tilgang til arbejdet og gerne byder ind med idéer og løsninger

  • Arbejder struktureret og systematisk og har øje for kvalitet og detaljer

  • Har flair for IT

Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at tage ejerskab for dine opgaver, bidrage til fællesskabet og være med til at få hverdagen til at fungere – også når der er travlt.

Praktisk information

  • Arbejdstid: Mandag til fredag kl. 12:00-20:00

  • Arbejdstid pr. uge: 37 timer

  • Arbejdssted: Hvidovre

  • Ansættelse: 3 måneders fuldtidsvikariat gennem StudentConsulting med henblik på fastansættelse hos kunden

  • Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

  • Løn: 189 kr./timen

Da du skal arbejde med sikkerhedsgodkendte områder og luftfragtgods, skal du kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes af myndighederne. Det er derfor vigtigt, at du kan redegøre for din beskæftigelse og/eller aktiviteter i de seneste 6 måneder i dit CV.

Kan du se dig selv i rollen?

Ønsker du at være en del af et energisk arbejdsmiljø, der samtidig har personligheden og engagementet til at tage ansvar, tage initiativ og bidrage positivt til et team, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Send dit CV og din ansøgning hurtigst muligt. Vi lukker rekrutteringen, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: Ledelseskonsulent tæt på topledelsen
jobs.description:
Har du blik for den strategiske retning, den gode proces og de konkrete opgaver, der får hverdagen til at hænge sammen? Og motiveres du af at arbejde tæt på en direktion med høje ambitioner for både studerende, medarbejdere og samfundet? Så er du måske vores nye ledelseskonsulent. Hos os får du mulighed for at arbejde helt tæt på de beslutninger, der er med til at styrke uddannelser med stor samfundsmæssig betydning. Absalon står midt i en historisk reform af professionsuddannelserne og arbejder samtidig med en ambitiøs strategi frem mod 2030, som skal sikre dygtige professionelle til de professioner, vi uddanner til. Som ledelseskonsulent for de to direktører, der har ansvaret for Absalons uddannelser, efter- og videreuddannelser samt forskning, sikrer du sammen med direktionens øvrige ledelseskonsulenter sammenhæng, fremdrift og professionel ledelsesunderstøttelse på tværs af direktionens opgaver og ansvarsområder. Din profil

Du er en erfaren og struktureret generalist, der kan bevæge dig sikkert mellem strategisk udvikling, procesledelse og praktisk koordinering - og kan genkende dig selv i følgende: God organisationsforståelse og stærke samarbejdsevner. Du har erfaring med at agere i en kompleks organisation og er dygtig til at skabe og udvikle relationer. Dine samarbejdskompetencer er veludviklede, og du trives i samarbejdet med både topledelse, øvrig ledelse, medarbejdere i alle funktioner, studerende og eksterne samarbejdspartnere. Erfaring med ledelsesunderstøttelse og beslutningsgange. Du har erfaring med at understøtte en topledelse og et sikkert blik for, hvad der skaber værdi i en travl hverdag. Alternativt har du erfaring fra en politisk styret organisation og ved, hvad der skal til for at få sager sikkert gennem de relevante processer frem mod en beslutning. Du tager initiativ, når opgaver skal prioriteres, struktureres eller følges til dørs, og du skriver kort, klart og præcist. Erfaring med procesledelse. Du kan skabe fremdrift og håndtere interessenter med forskellige og til tider modsatrettede ønsker og behov. Du planlægger og driver professionelle processer med den rette balance mellem involvering, kvalitet og tempo. Selvstændig og handlekraftig. Du tager ansvar for dine opgaver, skaber selv overblik og fremdrift og følger op uden at skulle sættes i gang. Samtidig er du god til at afstemme retning og involvere andre, når der er behov for det. Nysgerrig på AI. Du ser AI som et værktøj og en sparringspartner i udviklingen af opgaver. Du tør eksperimentere med nye løsninger, deler erfaringer med kolleger og bidrager til at modne vores fælles brug af teknologien, hvor den skaber værdi. Trives med alsidighed. Du trives med at skifte mellem udviklingsopgaver, korte leverancer og de konkrete koordinerende opgaver. Vi forventer, at du har en relevant kandidatuddannelse samt erfaring fra en lignende stilling. Stillingen indplaceres som special- eller chefkonsulent afhængigt af din erfaring og kompetencer. Dine arbejdsopgaver

Dine opgaver afspejler det, der fylder på de to direktørers bord. Nogle opgaver ligger allerede fast, mens andre vil blive formet med afsæt i din profil og det, du bringer med dig. Ledelsesunderstøttelse og beslutningsgrundlag. Du udarbejder oplæg og beslutningsgrundlag til blandt andet direktion og bestyrelse. Du understøtter de to direktører med procesplaner, præsentationer, mødeforberedelse, sparring, planlægning og koordinering, og du er med til at sikre, at relevante processer igangsættes og følges op. Nogle opgaver opstår med kort varsel og kræver, at du hurtigt kan gribe dem og levere. Andre kræver, at du holder fast over tid, skaber fremdrift og følger processen helt til dørs. Et stærkt og samarbejdende chefteam. Du understøtter og deltager i de faste møder i de to direktørers fælles centerchefteam, som består af seks chefer og de to direktører. Du planlægger, forbereder og følger op på møderne og bidrager både med struktur, koordinering og udvikling af chefteamets samarbejde og arbejdsform. Sektorsamarbejde. Begge direktører er involveret i sektorsamarbejde på tværs af de seks professionshøjskoler inden for deres ansvarsområde, fx inden for forsknings- eller sundhedsområdet. Du bidrager til at forberede og følge op på møder og konferencer i tæt samarbejde med direktøren og kolleger på de øvrige professionshøjskoler. Tværgående opgaver. Du får enkelte tværgående opgaver på tværs af hele organisationen. Det kan fx være de halvårlige seminarer for alle Absalons ledere, der planlægges i tæt samarbejde med kolleger og den ansvarlige direktør. Dine kolleger

Du bliver ansat i Kommunikation og Ledelsessekretariat, hvor vi arbejder for at skabe de bedste forudsætninger for, at Absalon lykkes med strategien om at uddanne dygtige professionelle og realiserer ambitionerne i uddannelsesreformen. Vi er ca. 30 kolleger fordelt på tre teams. Du bliver en del af Team Ledelsesunderstøttelse, som understøtter direktionen og Absalons fem centerchefer. Vi har hver især et tæt samarbejde med den eller de ledere, vi understøtter i hverdagen, samtidig med at vi som team løbende koordinerer og sparrer om fælles opgaver og indsatser. Vi bliver sammen opdateret på strategiske initiativer, nye processer og øvrige udviklinger, der har betydning for vores arbejde, så vi kan sikre sammenhæng og understøtte organisationen bedst muligt. Hos os møder du en organisation, der både er ambitiøs og uhøjtidelig. Vi lægger vægt på fleksibilitet og gode rammer for balance mellem arbejds- og privatliv. Dit primære ansættelsessted vil være enten på vores campus i Roskilde eller i Slagelse. Hver fredag samles afdelingen på Campus Slagelse, hvor vi har afdelingsmøder, teammøder mv. Der er mulighed for hjemmearbejde 1-2 dage om ugen. Sådan ansøger du

  • Ansættelse sker efter gældende overenskomst på statens område.
  • Stillingen er på fuld tid og med ansættelses hurtigst muligt og senest den 1. februar 2027.
  • Stillingen indplaceres som special - eller chefkonsulent med en forventet løn på mellem 56.486 kr. og 60.800 kr. pr. måned inkl. pension.
  • Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at kontakte sekretariatschef, Nanna Ferslev, på telefon 7248 1260 eller naf@pha.dk
  • Ansøgning og relevante bilag sendes via vores rekrutteringssystem ved at klikke på 'Søg stillingen' til højre på denne side senest den 6. december 2026.
  • Vi forventer at holde 1. samtaler den 11. december og 2. samtaler den 16. december 2026.
Vi ønsker, at medarbejderstaben afspejler det omgivende samfund, og vi opfordrer derfor alle interesserede uanset køn, kulturel og etnisk baggrund til at søge stillingen. Om Absalon

Professionshøjskolen Absalon er Region Sjællands største uddannelsesinstitution, hvor vi med vores 14 uddannelser uddanner mennesker, der med høj faglighed og professionalisme skaber værdi i det samfund, de er en del af. Vores uddannelser går tæt på den enkelte studerendes drømme og potentialer, tæt på den praksis de skal virke i og på de mennesker og fællesskaber, de skal gøre en mærkbar forskel for. I en ny sjællandsk storregion er det afgørende at have blik for både de store linjer, det lokale og det nære. De mennesker, der uddanner sig på Absalon, løfter andre mennesker og skaber muligheder og udvikling dér, hvor de bor og arbejder. Det er vores ambition at skabe praksisnære uddannelser af høj kvalitet og give de studerende de bedste forudsætninger for at udvikle sig til kompetente professionelle. Og vi vil styrke mulighederne for, at de kan skabe en karriere, der til enhver tid matcher deres faglige interesser og ambitioner - og det ansvar de tager i vores samfund. Vi er 850 medarbejdere, vi har 8.000 studerende på vores grunduddannelser og vi efter- og videreuddanner 3.500 kursister hvert år.

jobs.title: Renewals Manager - Italy/ Spain
Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Economics
jobs.description:
Job description

The Department of Economics invites applicants for a position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (SKO1352) in one of the following fields: Macroeconomics, Household Finance, or Family and Demographic Economics.

This is a full-time, four-year position, with 25% of working time devoted to teaching. The anticipated start date is between August 1 and October 1, 2027.

About the position 

The Department of Economics seeks a new colleague with the potential for outstanding research and high-quality teaching.

Candidates must provide evidence of excellence in research of the highest international caliber in macroeconomics, household finance, or family and demographic economics. This can be demonstrated by an innovative job market paper with a significant contribution to the literature, high-quality working papers, (forthcoming) publications in top-ranked and field-relevant journals, strong recommendations by referees who themselves have a record of excellence in research of the highest international caliber, the submitted research statement, presentations at significant conferences, and awards and accolades.

It is expected that the successful candidate contributes to a high standard of collegiality and the department’s working environment.

A postdoctoral position is intended for the employee to develop a research profile and competence that qualifies them to apply for an Associate Professor position. The position may also provide other competencies relevant to the postdoctoral fellow's future career.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

About the project

The postdoctoral position is financed by the research project HOWFER (Housing, Wealth, and Fertility in High-income Societies), led by Associate Professor Martin Blomhoff Holm. The project combines macroeconomics, household finance, and family economics to analyze how rising house prices and wealth concentration have contributed to falling fertility in high-income countries. Using Norwegian administrative data linking wealth, housing, and family formation for the entire population, the work will estimate the causal effect of house prices on fertility and build structural models to evaluate which policies most effectively affect fertility. The postdoctoral researcher will contribute both to the empirical and theoretical parts of the project, in collaboration with the core research team.

Candidates should articulate how they can contribute to and strengthen the project.

Requirements
  • A PhD degree in Economics by the time of appointment, or shortly thereafter, and no later than September 30, 2027.
  • A strong research profile in Macroeconomics, Household Finance, or Family and Demographic Economics that complements that of the department and the research project.
  • Qualifications that are compatible with the department’s teaching obligations and study programmes.
  • Candidates must have fluent written and oral communication skills in English.
  • Residence in or close to Oslo is required, and presence on campus is expected.
We offer 
  • Salary NOK 750 000 - 800 000 per annum, depending on qualifications, in position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (position code 1352).  From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
  • A stimulating and international research environment with multiple research groups and seminar series.
  • A friendly and inclusive workplace allowing for a good work-life balance.
  • Access to Norway’s excellent public services and welfare schemes, including generous parental leave provisions and affordable and accessible childcare (including the university’s kindergartens).
  • Norway’s capital, with its rich cultural life and easy access to beautiful nature.
  • Practical support for international staff moving to Norway (international staff may also benefit from tax cuts in their first years).
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
Application

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interests, and how the candidate can contribute to and strengthen the HOWFER project).
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity).
  • Job market paper (clearly labeled).
  • Other working papers or publications.
  • Copies of PhD Diploma and educational certificates (academic transcripts only).
  • Letters of Recommendation (optional).
  • List of reference persons: 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number). 

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge’s CV form and cannot be submitted only as an attachment. This requirement is intended to ensure correct documentation and record-keeping in accordance with the Public Administration Act, Section 15.Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.

An interview will be part of the hiring process.

Contact information
  • Project leader: Associate Professor Martin Blomhoff Holm: m.b.holm@econ.uio.no 
  • Head of Administration (Office manager): Brita Langeid: brita.langeid@econ.uio.no 
We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. 

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

We especially encourage women to apply.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of Economics is the highest ranked institute for economic research in Norway and in the top group in the Nordic countries. The Department offers Bachelor's and Master's programmes, as well as a doctoral programme with approximately 20 students. The department has attracted a number of ERC grants, and it hosts both a center for public economics, Norwegian Fiscal Studies (NFS) and a center for international economics, the Norwegian Centre for International Economics, which will be established in the spring of 2026.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: Join Beneq as an Electrical Engineer – Shape the Future of ALD Research Tools!Many breakthroughs in materials science, energy and microelectronics begin in a research lab, on an Atomic Layer Deposition (ALD) tool. Those tools have to be flexible, safe and electrically reliable. At Beneq, we build them.Were looking for an Electrical Engineer to join the Spatial product team in our Advanced ALD Business Unit. Youll design the electrical systems behind our Spatial ALD equipment, used by leading semiconductor and optics manufacturers, world-class technology companies, universities, and research institutes around the globe.This is a hands-on engineering role. Youll take designs from schematics and customer-specific modifications all the way to certified, fully documented deliveries, working closely with mechanical and automation engineers along the way.As a global leader in ALD solutions, Beneq offers the opportunity to work on technology that enables the next generation of thin film innovation. Many of our deliveries include customer-specific configurations, so youll regularly solve new design challenges. Youll also see the direct impact of your work on equipment used at the forefront of science.If youre an Electrical Engineer who enjoys variety, thrives in cross-disciplinary collaboration and is always looking for ways to make things work better, wed love to hear from you.Your Key Responsibilities * Design, develop and maintain electrical structures, schematics and related documents for Beneqs Spatial ALD equipment. * Prepare product purchase structures for customer deliveries and design customer-specific modifications. * Ensure compliance with industry regulations, safety standards (CE, UL) and related requirements. * Support certification processes and maintain the technical documentation needed for regulatory compliance. * Work with software/automation and mechanical engineers to ensure seamless system integration. * Support internal teams on electrical performance questions, both in Spatial and across other Advanced ALD product teams. * Identify opportunities for efficiency improvements and new technology adoption, and contribute to new product development.What Were Looking For * 3+ years in electrical system design, including low-voltage and high-power systems. Close-but-not-exact experience is worth a conversation. * A Bachelors or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field. * Proficiency in EPLAN and AutoCAD or a similar electrical design tool. * Working knowledge of electrical safety and CE, UL, EMI/EMC and IEC certification requirements. * Familiarity with PLC systems, especially Siemens S7. * Understanding of functional safety systems in relation to electrical design. * A detail-oriented, quality-focused approach, plus strong problem-solving, collaboration and communication skills.Bonus Skills That Set You Apart * Qualification for conducting electrical installations. * Ability to design electrical systems and connections for vacuum equipment, covering both vacuum-side and atmospheric-side applications. * Experience in thin film processing equipment (ALD, PVD, CVD or PECVD). * Knowledge of ERP and PDM systems such as SAP and Aton.Why Join Beneq?Youll work with one of the worlds top ALD teams at the forefront of thin film innovation. Our environment is collaborative and supportive, and the hierarchy is flat enough that your work is visible. We offer a competitive salary, strong work-life balance, and opportunities for professional growth and continuous learning in a high-tech, international company.How to ApplyAre you ready to take the next step in your career? Submit your application and CV by 13.12.2026. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible, as we may start the interview process during the application period.For more information, feel free to contact Johannes Wesslin, Engineering Manager at johannes.wesslin@beneq.com [johannes.wesslin@beneq.com] or by phone +358404142431 on 20.11. or 27.11. 13.00-14.00 (UTC+2).Beneq is the home of atomic layer deposition. Our mission is to be dedicated to the success of the More-than-Moore device makers by delivering best in class, innovative, and flexible ALD equipment and service solutions. In 1984, we established the worlds first industrial production using ALD. Today, we lead the market with products for semiconductor device fabrication, R&D, and varied ALD solutions. We operate globally and employ 170+ people on three continents. We are a unique employer that combines the hands-on, dynamic mindset of a fast-growth startup with the solid funding and resources of a larger enterprise. Beneqs team of engineers and experts are committed to delivering world class ALD solutions and enabling technology mega trends through advanced solutions. Beneq is headquartered in Finland with legal entities in the USA and Japan.

jobs.title: Service/rengøringsmedarbejder søges til 10-12 timer om ugen med mulighed for mere
jobs.description:
Rengørings- og servicemedarbejder søges til KMF Properties i Hillerød området

Har du sans for rengøring, orden og detaljer – og er du samtidig en person, vi kan regne med, når der opstår noget med vores boliger? Så er det måske dig, vi søger.

KMF Properties er i vækst, og vi er i gang med at udvide vores boligportefølje i Kalundborg. Derfor søger vi en stabil og ansvarsbevidst rengørings- og servicemedarbejder, som primært skal stå for rengøring og klargøring af vores boliger.

Stillingen er på 10-12 timer om ugen til at starte med, men med gode muligheder for hurtigt at få flere timer, da vi løbende får flere boliger i området.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

Den største del af jobbet vil bestå af:

  • Rengøring af vores huse og boliger på alle fælles arealer, 1 gang om ugen

  • Klargøring af boliger til nye beboere

  • Rengøring ved fraflytning, inden nye beboer

  • Sørge for, at boligerne altid fremstår rene, pæne og indbydende

  • Opfyldning af forbrugsvarer

  • Tjek af boligerne og indberetning, hvis der er noget, der skal ordnes

Derudover søger vi en person, vi kan regne med

Som en del af jobbet vil du også være vores lokale kontaktperson i Kalundborg, når der opstår praktiske ting i vores boliger.

Det kan eksempelvis være, at vi har brug for dig til:

  • At køre forbi en bolig og tjekke noget

  • At hjælpe, hvis der pludselig opstår et mindre problem

  • At tage imod en håndværker eller lukke nogen ind, kun hvis der opstår et problem. Ellers burde de selv være i stand til at lukke sig ind.

  • At tjekke en bolig efter en beboer har meldt et problem

  • At hjælpe med mindre praktiske opgaver

  • At give os besked, hvis du opdager noget, der bør ordnes

Du behøver ikke være uddannet rengøringsassistent eller lign. Det vigtigste er, at du er praktisk anlagt, løsningsorienteret og ikke er bange for at tage fat.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Er grundig og har øje for detaljer

  • Er stabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • Er fleksibel og kan træde til, når der opstår behov

  • Er serviceminded og imødekommende

  • Har en god ordenssans

  • Kan se, hvad der skal gøres, uden at vi behøver fortælle dig det hele

  • Er praktisk anlagt og løsningsorienteret

  • Har kørekort B og egen bil

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk eller engelsk

  • Har erfaring med rengøring, service eller lignende – det er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Vi lægger først og fremmest vægt på, at du er en person, vi kan stole på, og som tager ansvar for dine opgaver.

Vi tilbyder

  • 10-12 timer om ugen til at starte med

  • Gode muligheder for hurtigt at få flere timer, efterhånden som vores boligportefølje vokser

  • En selvstændig og varieret hverdag

  • Fleksibilitet i tilrettelæggelsen af arbejdet

  • En vigtig rolle i en virksomhed i vækst

  • Mulighed for at få mere ansvar over tid

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med kort fra idé til handling

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer og erfaring

Arbejdssted

Arbejdet vil primært foregå i Hillerød og nærliggende områder.

Da KMF Properties er i gang med at udvide vores boligportefølje i området, forventer vi, at der hurtigt vil blive mulighed for flere arbejdstimer.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send din ansøgning og CV, hvor du kort fortæller om dig selv, din erfaring og hvorfor jobbet passer til dig.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette person.

KMF Properties

jobs.title: Kirketjener søges til Treenighedskirken i Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Har du hænderne skruet godt på og hjertet på rette sted? Kan du lide at møde mennesker, skabe gode rammer og få praktiske ting til at fungere? Så er det måske dig, vi søger som vores nye kirketjener i Treenighedskirken. Vi søger en engageret, ansvarsbevidst og imødekommende kollega, som har lyst til at blive en vigtig del af vores kirke og fællesskab. Vi er et engageret team bestående af tre præster, to organister, en kirkesanger, en kordegn/daglig leder og en kirketjener/kirke- og kulturmedarbejder, som du vil få et tæt samarbejde med om fordelingen af vagter og praktiske opgaver. Treenighedskirken er en levende kirke med mange forskellige aktiviteter. Her mødes mennesker i alle aldre til gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger, koncerter, foredrag og sociale arrangementer. Som kirketjener er du en af de første, vores kirkegængere og besøgende møder. Derfor lægger vi stor vægt på, at du er et varmt og rummeligt menneske, der møder andre med venlighed, nærvær og respekt. Du skal kunne skabe en tryg og imødekommende atmosfære, uanset om du tager imod gæster til en festlig begivenhed eller møder mennesker i en svær livssituation. Hvem er du? Vi forestiller os, at du:
  • Er venlig, omsorgsfuld og god til at møde mennesker i alle livets situationer.
  • Har et naturligt værtskab og sætter en ære i at give kirkens besøgende en god oplevelse.
  • Er selvstændig, ansvarsbevidst og god til at planlægge din arbejdsdag.
  • Har praktisk sans, ordenssans og gerne hænderne skruet godt på.
  • Trives med både faste rutiner og dage, hvor planerne ændrer sig.
  • Er fleksibel, hjælpsom og god til at samarbejde med kolleger, præster, menighedsråd og frivillige.
  • Har øje for detaljerne og tager ansvar for, at kirken og dens omgivelser fremstår pæne og indbydende.
Du behøver ikke at være uddannet kirketjener på forhånd. Hvis du ikke har gennemført den obligatoriske femugers kirketjeneruddannelse, skal den gennemføres inden for de første to år af ansættelsen. Stillingen er primært en kirketjenerstilling, som udgør 80 % af arbejdstiden, mens de resterende 20 % er afsat til opgaver som kirke- og kulturmedarbejder. Dine arbejdsopgaver Som kirketjener er du med til at skabe gode rammer om kirkens liv og aktiviteter. Arbejdsdagene er alsidige og byder på både praktiske opgaver og kontakt med mange forskellige mennesker. Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:
  • Klargøring af kirken til gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger og arrangementer.
  • At tage godt imod kirkegængere og besøgende og være en imødekommende vært.
  • Praktisk medvirken ved gudstjenester, dåb, vielser, bisættelser og begravelser.
  • At deltage i udvalgsarbejde.
  • Rengøring og vedligeholdelse af kirken og dens øvrige lokaler.
  • Indkøb og andre praktiske opgaver i forbindelse med kirkens daglige drift, herunder lettere køkkenarbejde.
  • Vedligeholdelse af kirkens udendørsarealer.
  • Snerydning foran kirkens indgange samt saltning og glatførebekæmpelse efter behov.
  • Rekvirering og koordinering af håndværkere i samarbejde med kirkeværgen.
Du bliver en vigtig del af det daglige samarbejde, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og sammen sørger for, at kirken er et rart sted at komme – både for menigheden, besøgende og medarbejdere. Et job med variation og fællesskab Arbejdet følger kirkens rytme, og ingen uger er helt ens. Nogle dage er præget af praktiske opgaver og forberedelser, mens andre byder på gudstjenester, kirkelige handlinger og arrangementer med mange mennesker. Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen med fast fridag om mandagen og fri hver anden weekend. Arbejdstiden omfatter både dag- og aftentimer samt arbejde på helligdage. De to kirketjenere afløser hinanden ved ferie og andet fravær. Vi lægger vægt på et godt kollegialt samarbejde, hvor vi hjælper hinanden, udviser fleksibilitet og tager fælles ansvar for kirkens daglige liv. Vi tilbyder
  • En alsidig og meningsfuld arbejdsdag med mange forskellige opgaver.
  • Et arbejde med stor menneskelig kontakt, hvor du gør en forskel for andre.
  • Et godt arbejdsfællesskab med engagerede kolleger.
  • Mulighed for selvstændigt ansvar og indflydelse på tilrettelæggelsen af dine opgaver.
  • En arbejdsplads, hvor både menneskelige og praktiske kompetencer bliver værdsat.
Løn og ansættelsesvilkår Er du nysgerrig på løn- og ansættelsesvilkår – så klik her. Har du lyst til at blive vores nye kollega? Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. You will work as a trusted advisor to the managers, supporting leaders and teams across the district in day-to-day HR matters like labour law, occupational health care, leadership, staffing and recruitment.This position is located in Finland, with the office in Espoo, Tapiola. jobs.title: Senior Technical Safety Asset Discipline Engineer
jobs.description:
Erithy, previously known as Be Better Contractors, specializes in the design and construction of sustainable subsea infrastructure globally.

We deliver consultancy services within the oil and gas industry, high voltage cables, biogas and hydrogen, as well as civil engineering services and project administration.

Created in 2017, Erithy has grown into a consultancy team made up of various profiles from Europe, South America and the Middle East, working on projects across Norway.

We are always on the lookout for new talented individuals to join our team, and we hope that you will be our new member!

We are now looking for a Senior Technical Safety Asset Discipline Engineer for one of our customers based in Stavanger.

Duration: 12 months, with the possibility of extension. Start ASAP

Deadline for applications: 19.11.2026

Responsibilities:

We are seeking an experienced Senior Technical Safety Asset Discipline Engineer for a consultancy assignment of one year, with the possibility of adjustment, in the Asset Integrity & Maintenance Team for one of our operated offshore assets. In our operating model, the asset team is end-to-end accountable for technical and operational integrity, including barrier management, across all time horizons and in compliance with regulations and our management system. The discipline engineers in the team are multi-skilled, have close-to-full-time allocation to the asset, and are supported by the Portfolio Engineering team and subject matter experts for specialist and complex tasks. This is a senior role: the consultant will be expected to take full ownership of technical safety on the asset from day one, with minimal onboarding.

As Senior Technical Safety Asset Discipline Engineer you will be the asset's day-to-day point of contact for technical safety. You are responsible for the technical safety equipment on the asset and the associated performance standards, and for ensuring that barriers are maintained, monitored and followed up in line with the risk picture. You will be followed up by the Technical Safety & Barrier Management department, which provides peer support and quality assurance.

  • Provide day-to-day technical safety support to the asset team and the offshore organisation.

  • Own and follow up technical safety equipment and associated performance standards (e.g. fire and gas detection, emergency shutdown, firewater and deluge, passive fire protection, ignition source control, escape, evacuation and lifesaving equipment).

  • Monitor barrier status, follow up degraded barriers and define robust compensating measures to maintain the safety level.

  • Assess risk related to deviations, dispensations, temporary changes and reduced functionality of equipment, and handle cases in the relevant tools (e.g. Synergi).

  • Follow up test and maintenance results for safety-critical equipment, including offshore participation in firewater and deluge tests, and contribute to performance standard compliance verification.

  • Provide technical safety input to management of change, modifications and work orders, and participate in or facilitate HAZID, HAZOP and design reviews.

  • Contribute to updates of risk analyses (TRA/QRA) and emergency preparedness analyses, and follow up resulting actions and assumptions in operation.

  • Interface with Portfolio Engineering, technical safety SMEs, barrier management advisors and other disciplines, and support audits and supervisory activities from the authorities.

Requirements:

  • MSc or BSc in engineering (e.g. safety, process, mechanical or similar).

  • Minimum 10 years of experience within technical safety, of which at least 5 years from technical safety in operations of offshore installations, preferably on the Norwegian continental shelf.

  • Good knowledge of the Norwegian regulations (Havtil) and relevant standards, e.g. NORSOK S-001, ISO 13702, IEC 61508/61511 and Offshore Norge Guideline 070.

  • Proven experience with barrier management in operation, including ownership of performance standards, follow-up of degraded barriers and definition of compensating measures.

  • Fluent in Norwegian and English, written and spoken.

  • Documented ability to work independently and take full ownership of technical safety for an operating asset from day one, without an extended onboarding period.

  • Valid offshore safety course and health certificate, or willingness to obtain them, and willingness to travel offshore.

Desirable experience:

  • Experience with risk-based deviation handling and management of change in an operator organisation.

  • Knowledge of NORSOK Z-013 and use of risk analysis results in decision-making.

  • Familiarity with SAP, Synergi and digital barrier status tools.

  • Experience from FPSO or production installations on the Norwegian continental shelf.

  • Experience as discipline engineer or technical safety responsible in an operator's asset or operations organisation.

Personal qualities:

  • Experienced and confident, with the credibility to make and justify technical safety decisions independently in a busy operational environment.

  • Communicates clearly with offshore personnel, discipline engineers and management alike.

  • Proactive and collaborative, with a genuine interest in safety and continuous improvement

To work with Erithy means:

  • Working on exciting Norwegian energy projects.

  • Fast-track your career as a consultant for one of our customers.

  • We offer opportunities for permanent employment, where stability and personal development are the main focus.

  • Access our network of consultants and customers, and expand your opportunities.

  • In Erithy, we care and know our consultants on a personal level, and follow-up their progression.

Join Erithy now!
