jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:



Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

 - Fluency in German.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.

jobs.title: Rengøringsassistent til Middelfart // Cleaning staff
jobs.description:
Er du vores nye kollega hos Max Service?

Vi søger en stabil og ansvarsbevidst medarbejder til klinikrengøring hos en kunde i Middelfart.

Arbejdssted: Middelfart

Arbejdstid – Klinik 1:

  • Mandag til torsdag: Efter kl. 18.00

  • Fredag: Efter kl. 15.00 og inden mandag morgen

  • 1,25 timer pr. gang – 6,25 timer om ugen

Mulighed for ekstra timer – Klinik 2

Vi har også mulighed for at tilbyde rengøring på en anden klinik, som ligger kun 3 minutters kørsel fra den første.

  • Mandag til fredag

  • 2 timer pr. gang – 10 timer om ugen

  • Her kan arbejdet påbegyndes 2 timer tidligere, så opgaverne kan udføres i forlængelse af hinanden.

Samlet arbejdstid: Op til 16,25 timer om ugen.

Hvem er du?

Vi søger dig, som:

  • Bor i Middelfart, Fredericia eller omegn.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar.

  • Er mødestabil, loyal og pligtopfyldende.

  • Har sans for orden og øje for detaljerne.

  • Er serviceminded og har en positiv indstilling.

  • Taler dansk eller som minimum godt engelsk.

Erfaring med rengøring er ikke et krav – vi sørger for, at du får en grundig oplæring.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn.

  • Grundig oplæring og støtte.

  • Gode kolleger og et stærkt sammenhold.

  • Mulighed for flere arbejdstimer.

  • Hurtig opstart efter aftale.

  • Bliv en del af Max Service.

Hos Max Service er kvalitet, ansvarlighed og godt samarbejde en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Vi tror på, at glade medarbejdere skaber tilfredse kunder, og vi værdsætter kolleger, der tager ansvar og sætter en ære i et godt stykke arbejde.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Send os lidt information om dig selv og din erfaring.

Would You Like to Join Our Team at Max Service?

We are looking for a reliable and responsible employee to carry out cleaning at a clinic in Middelfart.

Work location: Middelfart

Working Hours – Clinic 1:

  • Monday to Thursday: After 6:00 PM

  • Friday: After 3:00 PM and before Monday morning

  • 1.25 hours per visit – 6.25 hours per week

Opportunity for Additional Hours – Clinic 2

We also have the opportunity to offer cleaning work at another clinic, located just 3 minutes away from the first clinic.

  • Monday to Friday

  • 2 hours per visit – 10 hours per week

  • Work at this clinic can start 2 hours earlier, allowing both cleaning jobs to be completed one after the other.

Total working hours: Up to 16.25 hours per week.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who:

  • Lives in Middelfart, Fredericia, or the surrounding area.

  • Can work independently and take responsibility.

  • Is reliable, loyal, and committed to their work.

  • Is organized and pays attention to detail.

  • Is service-minded and has a positive attitude.

  • Speaks Danish or at least good English.

Previous cleaning experience is not required – we provide thorough training.

What do we offer?

  • Competitive pay.

  • Thorough training and support.

  • Friendly colleagues and a strong team spirit.

  • Opportunities for additional working hours.

  • Quick start by agreement.

Become Part of Max Service

At Max Service, quality, responsibility, and teamwork are a natural part of our daily work.

We believe that happy employees create satisfied customers, and we value colleagues who take responsibility and take pride in doing a good job.

Interested in joining our team?

We would love to hear from you!

Send us information about yourself and your experience.

jobs.title: Experienced High Voltage Specialist wanted for Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst
jobs.description: Do you have at least three years of high voltage experience? At Bravida, you will install circuit breakers, disconnectors and switchboards and help build substations. Here, you will put your experience to use on critical electrical infrastructure projects that help secure Denmark's power supply and support the green transition.On behalf of Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst, Career | a JKS Company is recruiting experienced High Voltage Specialists for projects across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst has secured the framework agreement with Energinet, becoming a regular supplier of high voltage installation work across Zealand and Lolland-Falster. With this agreement and a strong order book, Bravida is expanding the department. You will join the team responsible for building, expanding, refurbishing and maintaining the infrastructure that the power grid of the future relies on.Installation and construction of high voltage installationsYou will work at substations and other high voltage installations, putting your experience into practice. You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside your team to deliver safe, high-quality work.Your responsibilities will include:-Installing and replacing circuit breakers, disconnectors and other substation components-Carrying out cable work and working on earthing systems-Working on switchboards, electrical installations and dismantling tasks-Contributing to the construction, refurbishment and maintenance of high voltage installations-Carrying out quality assurance and maintaining documentationOver time, you will also share your knowledge by helping apprentices and new colleagues get to grips with their tasks.You bring solid high voltage experience and take responsibilityYou are a qualified electrician or have an equivalent electrical qualification, with at least three years of hands-on experience in high voltage work. You are familiar with the tasks described and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, recognise what needs doing and understand that safety is integral to every task.We are looking for someone who:-Works independently and takes a structured approach-Takes responsibility for the safety and quality of their work-Is proactive, well-presented and works well with others-Is physically fit and comfortable with hands-on work outdoors and at height-Holds a category B driving licence and can provide a criminal record certificateYou must be able to communicate clearly in English and have a valid work permit for Denmark.A company vehicle to take home and no on-call dutiesAt Bravida, you will join a team of skilled, dedicated technicians who take pride in their work.You will work daytime hours with no on-call duties, normally five days a week. Start times depend on the project, and the working week can be discussed. The role is paid hourly, with pay based on qualifications, plus pension contributions and a flexible benefits allowance under the Danish "fritvalgsordning" scheme.You will have a company vehicle equipped with the tools and equipment you need, which you can take home. Your exact location is therefore less important, provided you are willing to work at different sites across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.We look forward to hearing from youIf this sounds like the right role for you, please send us your CV. We review applications and invite suitable candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, and will close the vacancy once the right candidates have been found.If you have any questions about the role that are not covered in this advertisement, please contact Recruitment Specialist Kristine Askjær on +45 3085 1302.Please note that, for GDPR reasons, applications submitted directly by email will not be processed or receive a response.

jobs.title: Demonstratør: Et fleksibelt job, der passer ind i din hverdag
jobs.description:
Demonstratører / Demonstratricer søges til hele landet

Et fleksibelt job, der passer ind i din hverdag

Søger du et meningsfuldt og socialt job, der passer ind i netop din hverdag?

Hos IN-STORE søger vi kollegaer til en spændende stilling som demonstratør. Som demonstratør bliver du vores ansigt udadtil og er med til at skabe gode oplevelser for både kunder og butikker. Du uddeler smagsprøver, fortæller om produkterne og giver kunderne lyst til at prøve noget nyt. Her kommer din livserfaring og evne til at tale med mennesker dig til gode.

Uanset om du er pensionist, der ønsker at supplere din indkomst, selvstændig, der søger et fleksibelt bijob, eller noget helt tredje, kan dette være det perfekte match for dig. Du bliver vores ansigt udadtil og er med til at skabe gode oplevelser for både kunder og butikker. 

Dine opgaver indebærer:

  • Let tilberedning og uddeling af smagsprøver. 

  • Engagerende samtaler og salg af produkterne.

  • Opsætning af en pæn og indbydende stand.

  • Skabe en god relation til de butikker, du besøger.

Vi tilbyder et job, der passer til dig

Vi ved at fleksibilitet og frihed er vigtigt - derfor tilbyder vi: 

  • Frihed til at planlægge: Du bestemmer selv, hvor mange vagter du ønsker om måneden. Vores vagter er 6-8 timer ad gangen og spredt over hele ugen - fredage og lørdage er dog altid vores mest aktive dage. 

  • Social og aktiv arbejdsdag: Du bliver en del af et team af kollegaer, der ligesom dig selv, sætter pris på at holde sig aktiv og social.

  • Udstyr derhjemme: Du opbevarer dit udstyr hjemme og tager det med, når du skal på arbejde.

  • Kørsel i egen bil: Du får skattefri kørselsgodtgørelse efter gældende regler.

 

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er imødekommende, ansvarsfuld og glad for at tale med mennesker. Din livserfaring er en stor fordel, da du er god til at tale med alle slags mennesker og skabe tillid. Erfaring som demonstratør er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at præsentere produkter og give kunderne en god oplevelse.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at:

  • Du er god til at kommunikere og er god til at formidle et budskab.

  • Du er ansvarsfuld og mødestabil.

  • Du trives med at arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Du er fortrolig med IT (smartphone, e-mail) og har bil til rådighed. 

 

Sådan søger du jobbet:

Send os din ansøgning med CV og et vellignende billede af dig selv via vores hjemmeside www.in-store.dk.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte vores HR Koordinator, Emilie Braagaard, på tlf. 52 18 64 09 eller mail embra@in-store.dk, hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet.

 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Credit Union Member Service Officer (MSO)
jobs.description: The Member Service Officer (MSO) is a key front-line role responsible for delivering a friendly, efficient, and professional service to members. This includes handling financial transactions, supporting lending operations, advising on credit union products, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, including those set by the Central Bank of Ireland. Key Responsibilities● Serve as the first point of contact for members across all channels (in-branch, phone, email).● Process daily transactions such as lodgements, withdrawals, loan payments, and direct debits accurately.● Provide members with accurate information about products and services, including savings and loans.● Support members through the loan application process, including documentation gathering and system entry.● Promote credit union products and services to members in line with their financial needs and goals.● Ensure all activity complies with AML, CFT, and GDPR regulations, as well as Central Bank of Ireland guidelines.● Maintain accurate member records and update account information securely and confidentially.● Assist with balancing cash, preparing reports, and performing reconciliations.● Work closely with other departments to resolve member queries and deliver excellent member service.● Participate in training, upskilling, and CPD requirements related to your qualifications. Essential Skills & Qualifications● Minimum of Leaving Certificate or equivalent.● Holds a relevant qualification such as QFA (Qualified Financial Adviser) or APA (Accredited Product Adviser) as per Central Bank of Ireland Minimum Competency Code (MCC) requirements.○ Note: Candidates working towards APA/QFA may be considered depending on experience.● Previous experience in customer service, preferably in financial services, banking, or credit unions.● Strong IT skills, including competence in Microsoft Office and member/accounting systems.● Excellent communication, organisational, and interpersonal skills.● High level of accuracy and attention to detail.● Ability to work on own initiative and as part of a team. Desirable● Experience with loan processing, AML procedures, or GDPR compliance.● Knowledge of the credit union movement and its values.● Understanding of the regulatory environment in Irish financial services. Key Competencies● Member-first mindset● Accuracy and attention to detail● Teamwork and collaboration● Communication and interpersonal skills● Problem-solving ability● Compliance awareness● Initiative and accountability Other Requirements● Flexibility to work additional hours when required.● Commitment to ongoing CPD in line with MCC requirements (if APA/QFA is held).● Willingness to complete further relevant training (e.g., CUCP courses). Apply now: aidan@prorecruitmentireland.ie

jobs.title: Onboarding Enablement Manager, APAC
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Onboarding Enablement Manager, APAC to play a key role in enhancing our sales productivity in our APAC region. This role will design, deliver, and continuously improve sales onboarding for our new hires. You will work closely with sales leadership, enablement, and product marketing to ensure our field salesforce is equipped with the skills, tools, and knowledge needed to achieve revenue targets and drive customer success.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Lead APAC Sales & Success onboarding by facilitating Notion’s Sales Bootcamp for new hires across the region

 - Own the APAC Onboarding Calendar end-to-end, ensuring a consistent, well-sequenced new-hire experience

 - Establish a clear communication cadence with APAC frontline leaders, setting expectations and ensuring visibility into each new hire’s onboarding plan and progress

 - Partner with APAC Sales Leadership, Enablement and Revenue Operations to iterate on and deliver high-impact live sessions with clear objectives and strong SME alignment that is aligned to the global program and tailored for regional nuances (Korea, Japan, and APACx)

 - Operationalize the pre-work, certifications, and continued learning path so assignments land at the right time and reinforce on-the-job performance

 - Measure onboarding effectiveness through qualitative inputs (e.g., surveys), and translate insights into clear recommendations and iteration plans

 - Create engaging, multimodal learning experiences (AI-assisted content, short-form video, podcasts, and activity-based materials) that help sellers succeed in their segment and reach their full potential with Notion

 - Embed and reinforce Notion’s culture, product value, and customer-first mindset across all field enablement programs

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 4+ years of SaaS sales experience
   
   - Including:
     
     - 2+ years full cycle selling

 - Demonstrate agency to lead enablement within team

 - Strong executive presence, with excellent written and verbal communication skills and stakeholder management abilities

 - Clear understanding of B2B sales cycles, strategies, and buyers—ideally product-led growth, sales-led growth journeys, and enterprise sales

 - Proficiency and ability to coach proven sales methodologies, including MEDDPICC, core sales competencies, and Command of the Message with practicality

 - Self-motivated problem solver who excels in ambiguous situations and takes complete ownership of projects

 - Creative thinker able to build engaging, outcome-focused content that drives behavioral change

 - Coaching mindset with high empathy for new hires and current sellers, driving effective change by challenging perspectives and focusing the team on value-based conversations

 - Proactive by nature, takes decisive action when identifying skill gaps or risks that could impact the success of enablement initiatives

 - Culture carrier, with a strong ability and desire to roll up their sleeves and make an impact in a high-growth environment

 - Fluency in Japanese and business-level in English

 


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Fluency in Korean
   
   #LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

 Manual testing:

-         Experience using JIRA / Confluence is an asset
-         Intermediate SQL level

-         Experienced in QA with ISEB/ISTQB certification or similar experience
-         Experience in test design, risk management, defect management with a strong background in security
-         Solid knowledge of manual and automated software testing
-         Experience writing test documentation

Languages: French and English fluent. Any other language is an asset.

Technical / Specific skills:

-         Comfortable working in a fast paced Agile environment
-         Analytical mindset
-         Proactive and positive attitude with good Team-spirit
-         Good interpersonal relations and communications skills (written and oral)
-         Good time management and priority setting skills
-         Good at corner cases tests methodology
-          Ability to write or understand Bash, HTML/XML, SQL, JavaScript<>TypeScript, Java

-         Automation expertise

Core competencies at LuxTrust:

jobs.title: Senior Staff Infrastructure & Security Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT CIVILGRID

CivilGrid is the trusted civil design platform powering affordable infrastructure renewal and growth. We give utilities, civil engineers, and municipalities a single, collaborative source of truth for what's underground so teams can plan, design, and build faster, smarter, and safer.

Our platform consolidates utility records, geotechnical and environmental data, paving moratoriums, and jurisdictional requirements directly from 3,000+ utilities, agencies, and municipalities with full chain-of-custody documentation. Teams at PG&E, Mark Thomas, and dozens of leading engineering firms use CivilGrid to cut research time by up to 88%, reduce project costs, prevent dig-ins, and accelerate delivery on the projects that keep communities running.

We're a venture-backed Series A startup tackling a $4.7T US infrastructure market that has been underserved by software for decades. Founded by industry insiders, each with 10+ years in utilities and civil engineering, we move fast, ship work that matters, and stay close to the customers and field teams we build for.

WHY THIS ROLE

We're looking for a Security & Infrastructure Engineer to own our security posture and assist in supporting our cloud platform and reliability as we scale into large utilities and civil engineering firms. You'll take over and grow our security program, working across engineering, IT, and leadership. The role is on the Systems team that spans DevOps, SRE, and security. Your focus is security but you will contribute across the team.

This role reports to the Head of Engineering. It is a hybrid role with expectations that you are working from our Boston, MA office at least 3 days per week if hired.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Partner with engineering to embed reliability and security into the SDLC and infrastructure decisions

  • Run our security program: SOC 2 readiness and audits, vendor reviews, access controls, endpoint security, and threat modeling

  • Define and enforce policies for identity, secrets, data handling, and production access across the company

  • Lead incident response for both security events, and some reliability events, from detection through resolution and follow-up

  • Harden and monitor our GIS servers (Windows Server) alongside our AWS platform

  • Build and maintain our Trust Center, and lead security reviews with customers

  • Contribute to our AWS environment end to end: VPC architecture, ECS, RDS, secrets management, IAM, networking, and cost optimization

  • Contribute to improving reliability practices: SLOs, observability, alerting, on-call rotation, runbooks, and blameless post-incident reviews

  • The tech:

    • AWS ECS, Postgres on RDS managed with CDK

    • GitHub, Datadog, Slack, Notion, Drata

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • At least 5-8 years of experience across product security, platform security, or security engineering, with hands-on experience with DevOps or SRE of production AWS infrastructure

  • Experience running or supporting a SOC 2 program, including evidence collection, control design, and auditor coordination

  • Deep working knowledge of AWS (VPC, ECS, RDS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or equivalent)

  • Experience running vulnerability management, from scanner findings and outside reports to fixes shipped

  • Track record of improving reliability in production: defining SLOs, building observability, running on-call, and leading post-incident reviews

  • Startup ready: autonomous, moves fast, takes initiative without being asked

  • Strong verbal and written communication, able to articulate ideas clearly and collaborate effectively

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience supporting B2B products sold into regulated industries (utilities, energy, public sector)

HOW WE WORK

We're a small, but rapidly growing team that ships. Expect direct feedback, real ownership from day one, and proximity to customers â huge utilities, public agencies, and engineering firms whose work depends on what we build. We default to in-person collaboration where it matters and remote-friendly flexibility otherwise. We hire people who care deeply about their craft and the communities our customers serve.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

The base salary range for this role is $137,318 - $192,960.

Base salary is only one part of your total compensation package at CivilGrid, which also includes meaningful early-stage equity, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to shape a category-defining company. The base salary range listed above may encompass various levels and/or geographic locations; final offers are determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, level, and work location.

In addition to base and equity, we offer:

  • Company-funded medical, dental, and vision insurance â including medical plans at no cost to the employee

  • FSA (health and dependent care)

  • Unlimited PTO and a culture that expects you to actually use it

  • 401(k) plan

  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment

  • A high-trust team, real ownership, and the chance to do the most meaningful work of your career

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

CivilGrid is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Employment decisions at CivilGrid are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us â we're happy to help.

 - Drive technical and product vision as an engineering leader within the org, building alignment with other eng teams and cross functionally, bringing clarity to the roadmap.

 - Deliver experiments end-to-end, from ideation to analysis, that balance the dimensions of product and the business appropriately.

 - Get to know the Notion customer to understand key points in the customer journey and uncover insights that will drive activation and engagement




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Finding the problems worth solving: You don't wait to be handed a roadmap. You dig into growth data, customer research, and the codebase to find the highest-leverage opportunities, then make the case for them and drive alignment on what to pursue.

 - Data and experimentation as a practice: You have Growth Engineering experience at another company, and you've built experimentation into how a team works: defining success criteria, running A/B tests, and turning results into decisions others follow.

 - Shipping polished user interfaces: You build fast, well-crafted web experiences with React and modern web technologies, and you know what it takes to keep them working as usage grows.

You know how to build systems for agents and treat the system as the deliverable, improving it continuously for accelerated impact.

 - A history of strong cross-functional collaboration with marketing, sales, and/or other non-technical teams

 - You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others, and understand why we're big fans of their work.

jobs.description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. These guidelines are included in the job specification for the CE Supervisor.  Job Title: Supervisor - Community Employment  Reporting to: Project Manager and Chairperson - RDRD Project Management Committee Function: To ensure the effective and efficient management and co-ordination of the human, financial and material resources of the CE Scheme and report to the Project Management Committee on its implementation. A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science

Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET

About Claims

AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.

We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.

The team

Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.

  • Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
  • Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
  • Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

You would be the fourth person on the team and our second engineer.

Our culture

We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are an AI-native company and expect you to be an AI-native Software Engineer we can trust.

About the role

Position: Software Engineer (Python, full-stack)
Location: Remote. You need to be able to join our team meetings in the afternoon, Central European Time.
Type: Full-time contractor. Start in December 2026 or January 2027.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to help maintain and build Claims and its supporting applications, services, and developer tools. Claims turns scientific research into structured claims and supporting evidence through document processing, AI pipelines, and automated evaluation.

This is a hands-on, backend-focused full-stack role. You'll work across Python services, web dashboards, data pipelines, integrations, and deployment tooling. Your work will combine delivering new features with debugging existing systems, improving reliability, and making the codebase easier to maintain.

You should be comfortable owning well-defined tasks from investigation through implementation, testing, and release, working with the team on larger design decisions and unfamiliar areas.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Python backend services, APIs, command-line tools, and background processing workflows.
  • Develop and improve web dashboards and internal review tools using TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks.
  • Maintain pipelines that ingest research papers, process documents, extract structured information, and evaluate results.
  • Integrate external APIs and AI model providers, handling validation, retries, timeouts, rate limits, and usage costs.
  • Work with relational databases and object storage, including schema changes, migrations, queries, and data integrity checks.
  • Investigate bugs and production issues across services, pipelines, and interfaces; address root causes and add useful regression coverage.
  • Help maintain deployment automation, continuous integration, logging, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Improve existing code through practical refactoring, dependency maintenance, automated tests, and code review.
  • Collaborate with engineering and research colleagues to turn requirements and experimental workflows into reliable software.

Required skills and experience

  • Typically 1â5 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience delivering and maintaining production software.
  • Strong Python skills, including building maintainable services or data processing applications, managing dependencies, and writing automated tests.
  • Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting HTTP APIs, with a sound understanding of JSON, validation, authentication, and error handling.
  • Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript and experience contributing to React applications or a comparable modern frontend framework.
  • Practical SQL and relational database experience, including data modelling, migrations, and debugging queries.
  • Confidence working in Linux environments and using the command line to investigate logs, configuration, processes, and service failures.
  • Experience with Git, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration.
  • An understanding of secure engineering practices, including access controls, secrets management, and careful handling of private data.
  • The ability to navigate an existing codebase, trace issues across components, and make focused, well-tested changes.
  • Clear communication, practical problem-solving, and the judgment to work independently while asking for input when requirements or risks are unclear.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Next.js, or similar tools.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs, building AI-assisted workflows, or evaluating model outputs for accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Familiarity with PDF parsing, OCR, document extraction, scientific datasets, or evidence provenance.
  • Experience with distributed jobs, asynchronous processing, reproducible pipelines, or automated benchmarking.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Ansible, systemd, GitHub Actions, cloud hosting, or infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with Bittensor, decentralized compute networks, or systems for evaluating independently submitted code.
  • Exposure to Rust, native Python extensions, or WebAssembly.
  • An interest in scientific research, open-source software, and tools that make research easier to inspect and reuse.

You don't need experience with every technology listed. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly across the stack matter most.

What success looks like

  • You can independently deliver scoped features and fixes across the backend and supporting web applications.
  • Your changes are understandable, tested, and documented, with appropriate attention to security and compatibility.
  • You help make processing pipelines and production services more reliable and easier to troubleshoot.
  • You contribute constructively to reviews, communicate progress and blockers, and help the team turn research ideas into maintainable software.

What we offer

  • $1500 - $2000 per month, depending on experience.
  • Opportunities for rapid professional growth in a high-impact role: a small team, a live network, and a senior engineer to learn from.
  • Quarterly team retreats in inspiring locations (e.g., Vilnius, Koh Samui).
  • Travel and visa support for business needs.
  • Flexible remote working.


Help us build the data layer that lets AI do science properly.

How to apply


Apply online through the link here: https://airtable.com/appZKkV7FT7eYBhKI/shrjJ3jYfxZjsNckR

It takes about 30 minutes: a few practical questions, four short written answers, links to your code, and your CV or personal website. No cover letter needed.

Applications close on Monday 16 November 2026, 23:59 CET.

We read every application after the deadline and reply to everyone.

jobs.title: Pricing / Underwriting Actuary (m/f)
jobs.description: Pricing / Underwriting Actuary locations Luxembourg - Cloche d'Ortime type Full timejob requisition id R13572Join our team. Your future starts here.Swiss Life Group is one of Europe's leading comprehensive life, pensions and financial solutions providers.Within the Group's International Division and with its two business lines, Swiss Life Global Solutions offers a broad range of tailored cross-border life insurance solutions to wealthy individuals for a suitable integrated wealth planning (Global Private Wealth Solutions) and to international companies to address the benefits needs of their local and mobile employees (Global Employee Benefits Solutions).Swiss Life Global Solutions is located in Luxembourg, Liechtenstein, Zurich and Singapore.At Swiss Life, our purpose is to enable people to lead a financially self-determined life. Join us if: • you enjoy working in a truly international and entrepreneurial environment• you have strong business acumen and are able to think consistently from the customer's point of view• you are willing to work in an efficient, committed and agile manner, in the best interests of our company• collaboration, trust and self-development are key elements for you in your future position.The Central Underwriting Team (based in Luxembourg and Zurich) is responsible to ensure that our Employee Benefits Business writes profitable business while supporting growth. For this team, we are looking for a commercially minded Pricing/Underwriting Actuary to lead the assessment of new Managing General Agent (MGA) partnerships, perform onboarding, review pricing and ensure ongoing monitoring of new and existing MGAs. (You have the possibility to be implicated in the whole cycle). The role is based in Luxembourg and will be reporting into the Chief Underwriting Officer of Swiss Life Global Solutions. Your Role• Act jointly with Sales as the primary interface between Swiss Life Luxembourg and MGA partners combining Underwriting rigor with commercial judgement  • Lead the evaluation of prospective MGA partnerships in collaboration with Sales, assess business plans, profitability, underwriting strategies, product offerings, pricing methodologies.• Challenge pricing assumptions, identify key risks and red flags, and develop recommendations for senior management• Support Swiss Life Luxembourg with the retention of existing MGAs while ensuring adequate profitability level• Perform or review pricing on cases that the MGAs have to report to Swiss Life Luxembourg• Implement with Operations and Reserving proper monitoring and governance frameworks for MGA portfolios, monitor underwriting performance and coordinate remediation actions• Act as the key liaison between MGA partners and internal stakeholders. You will work closely with teams across Sales, Operations, Reserving, Legal and Product to ensure successful onboarding and ongoing oversight of MGA arrangements. Coordinate with local underwriting committee and with internal and external reinsurance. Support jointly with Operations audits of MGAs and follow-up of SLAs. Maintain close interaction with Reserving to ensure info is available to assess required reserves• Support pricing and underwriting of Life & Health contracts written through Swiss Life International and review of large and complex offers  Your Profile• Master's degree in actuarial sciences; alternatively university degree in mathematics or similar with relevant experience• Solid experience in underwriting, pricing and evaluating profitability of Life and Health products (be able to work autonomously)• Proven ability to assess MGA new opportunities, review proposed pricing, define underwriting framework and monitoring MGA deals considered as an advantage• Knowledge of medical business considered an advantage• Knowledge of performing audit and a good understanding of operational process• Business Fluency in English• Self-driven individual with excellent commercial acumen combined with strong analytical and actuarial capabilities• Ability to work autonomously and comfortable working across multiple functions. Our Offer• A varied work within a multicultural team where you can shape your career• A company culture characterized by its agility, expert know-how, customer-centricity and collaborative mindset• After trial period, home working is possible according to our internal rules• An attractive remuneration package in line with your position and responsibilities, including fringe benefits such as lunch vouchers, pension scheme and additional health insurancePlease note that a criminal record extract and a copy of your diplomas will be required in case of hiring.

jobs.description: Per conto di una realtà strutturata operante nel settore chimico-farmaceutico, inserita in una fase di trasformazione digitale e di rafforzamento dei presidi di governance, sicurezza e standardizzazione a livello di Gruppo, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Chief Technology Officer La posizione si colloca a diretto riporto del CIO e rappresenta un ruolo 'ponte' tra l'operatività quotidiana e la definizione/adozione di policy, processi e controlli, con focus particolare sulla gestione delle sussidiarie estere e sul governo dei fornitori. Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. jobs.title: Product Support Specialist, Eastern/Central Time
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become an instrumental tool for many of the world’s best product teams. We believe customer support should always feel like an extension of that experience. As a Product Support Specialist at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product by surfacing customer feedback and insights, contributing to our technical documentation, and engaging a technical customer community via social channels.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based within U.S. and Canada Eastern or Central Time. You can work from anywhere within those time zones. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Support customers in end-to-end engagement, including onboarding, account setup, debugging issues, feature and integration discovery

 - Investigate and resolve inbound customer issues reported through all communication channels, including email, Slack, Twitter, and Reddit

 - Partner with our engineering team to document and reproduce bugs

 - Surface trends and insights from customer feedback to the team at large to inform product choices

 - Lead select strategic projects to improve the support experience, internal knowledge sharing, and product operations

What we're looking for

 - Passion about technology, quality, and Linear’s mission

 - Excellent communication and customer service skills and experience working with a technical or engineering user base. Ability to adapt your communication approach to non-technical users.

 - Experience troubleshooting technical issues, including APIs and integration setups. Ability to reproduce bugs with Linear and our integrations in various environments (different browsers, Windows, Mac, Mobile).

 - Familiarity with SQL, Javascript, APIs, and GitHub is a plus. If you don’t have direct experience in these areas, curiosity to learn more is desirable as well. Please note that this is not a product engineering role.

 - Based in U.S. or Canada Eastern or Central Time only.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Compensation

For US-based candidates, the expected cash compensation range for this role is $95,000—$135,000. For sales roles, this range represents on-target earnings (OTE), including base salary and variable compensation; for all other roles, it represents base salary. Final compensation is determined based on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. For sales roles, actual earnings vary based on sales performance. Equity is a meaningful part of all offers at Linear.

jobs.title: Product Support Specialist
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. You will work closely with our enterprise customers and engineers to resolve the most complex issues. You will also help build out systems and processes to manage tasks from report to completion. You will problem solve with our technical teams and work to resolve as much as you can while scaling our systems and support processes.

 - Reproduce customer issues, perform initial triage and file software defects and feedback with Engineering

 - Manage to key performance metrics defined within the CX Team.

 - Create and maintain internal knowledge libraries and contribute to the creation of user-facing content.

 - Should be open to 24/5 shift model and participate in an on-call rotation to assist customers outside of normal working hours.

 - Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional partners (i.e. Engineering, Product, and Operations) to drive long-term solutions and ensure customer feedback informs product improvements.

 - Experience contributing or owning projects to optimizing processes, workflows, and support operations that drive performance improvements. You have strong organizational skills to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills**.** You are capable of distilling complex, technical material to non-technical audiences.

NICE TO HAVES:

 - Strong analytical skills with a passion for interpreting data to improve decision-making and outcomes.

 - Experience with tools and technologies like Zendesk, SQL databases, APIs, AI tools.

jobs.description:

Replit is experiencing extraordinary demand and seeking an Enterprise Account Executive with strong communication skills to drive our hyper-growth. Candidates with SaaS experience, particularly with some technical background (i.e. having some coding knowledge or prior experience at other developer tool companies) are ideal.



This full-cycle sales position encompasses new client acquisition. We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for people who excel in client-facing situations and have a passion for driving sales and AI. You'll leverage your skills to effectively communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

Kao obiteljsko poduzeće znamo da su ljudi ti, koji svojim znanjem i vještinama pridonose našem uspjehu. Isto im vraćamo sa stimulativnim primanjima i korporativnom kulturom u kojoj se žive obiteljske vrijednosti. Želimo biti više od skupine timova u jednom poduzeću. jobs.title: Freelance Copywriter
jobs.description:
CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.title: Support Engineer I (FC, Weekend Shift)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


As a Support Engineer you are at the forefront of helping those developers create. In a given day you’ll help folks with all sorts of things ranging from general Replit usage questions, identifying and debugging issues on the platform and helping to build and maintain the tools we use. We use tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and Replit itself to get the job done. We also value solving the problems we can ourselves. We have a number of tools we build and maintain ourselves.



You will work on a small, global team of support specialists and engineers united by Replit's mission to make the next billion software creators. Together, you'll ensure developers worldwide have the support they need to bring their ideas to life.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Work directly with Replit customers via support tickets to solve technical product issues, bugs, and provide technical guidance while meeting daily ticket volume and resolution time targets.

 - Collaborate with the rest of the Support team in telling the story of our users to the rest of Replit.

 - Directly contribute to and maintain the Support team's Knowledge Base.

 - Support customer-facing communications for outages and incidents and swiftly report ongoing bugs for Eng to triage and fix.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Prior experience in software development or relevant technical support experience

 - Proven ability to work efficiently in fast-paced, high-volume support environments with strict productivity metrics.

 - Strong time management and ticket triage skills with comfort in performance tracking and regular reporting.

 - Excellent communication skills with initiative to ask questions when encountered with the unknown.

 - Experience with support tools and ticketing systems (e.g. Zendesk)




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.)




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems



This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The schedule follows a Saturday through Wednesday work week, with an in-office requirement on Mondays and Wednesdays.

 - Cross-Functional Collaboration and Partnerships: You will partner with solutions consulting and forward deployed engineers to ensure smooth customer onboarding and continuously refine the customer journey to drive long-term success. You will also bridge the gap between customers and internal teams by channeling feedback into product development, ensuring continuous improvement of the platform.

 - Customer Leadership: You will serve as the key extension of your team for high-stakes customer engagements (both internally and externally), such as business reviews.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Software Engineer, Infrastructure

Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) Â· $185Kâ$215K base + meaningful early-stage equity + full benefits

Â 

About Sodalis

Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait.

Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist.

We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1.5B+ before its acquisition by OptumRx).

Â 

The Opportunity

Everything we run today is cloud-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own.
We've never shipped an on-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live.

We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range.
You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture.

What you'll do

  • Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between.

  • Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy.

  • Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site.

  • Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range.

  • Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering.

  • You've taken an AWS-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services.

  • You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on-prem, customer-hosted, edge, or embedded.

  • You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them.

  • You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity.

  • You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required.

How we work

We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk.

jobs.title: Partner Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Mecka AI

Mecka AI is building the data infrastructure layer for robotics and embodied AI.
We design and operate global systems for data capture, data labeling, and hardware-enabled workflows used by leading AI labs and robotics companies to train and validate humanoid and embodied AI systems.
We work closely with frontier robotics teams to bridge real-world data, simulation, learning-based systems, and deployed hardware.

About the Role

Signing a capture partner is the start of the work. Getting that partner to steady, high-quality output takes onboarding, training, hardware, support, and reporting, and every step has to run on time.

As Partnership Operations Manager, you will own that path for our regional partnership leads so they can focus on finding and signing partners. This is a new function, so you will set the standards and tooling yourself and make them repeatable across regions.

What You Will Do

  • Deal support: Prepare proposals and agreements from approved templates and keep a clean record of every partnerâs rates, volumes, and term dates.

  • Onboarding: Set partners up on the platform, issue devices and accounts, and train their teams on capture standards so they reach full output quickly.

  • Hardware: Manage device allocation, tracking, replacements, and returns with our hardware and logistics teams, and keep inventory records accurate.

  • Partner support: Be the first point of contact for partners, and run the support channel to clear service levels. Resolve problems yourself or route them to product, engineering, or finance before capture is disrupted, and pass on what partners need from the platform and devices.

  • Performance and reporting: Monitor daily performance and quality across partners, including recorded, approved, and deliverable hours, recording counts, and QA rejection rates. Act when numbers slip, and raise anything commercial with the partnerâs regional lead. Keep scorecards, business reviews, and the data behind them current.

  • Payments: Own partner payments and reconciliation, making sure hours are approved correctly and paid accurately and on time.

  • Playbook: Build and improve the processes, checklists, and tools that keep partner operations running as the network grows.

What You Bring

  • Experience: 3 to 5+ years in partner or vendor operations, supply or merchant onboarding, business operations, program or project management, or account management, ideally at a high-growth marketplace, delivery, or BPO company.

  • Execution: A record of running many partner launches at once across time zones, with clear process and tight follow-up.

  • Organization: Highly organized and detail-focused, able to manage many partners and tasks at once without letting things slip.

  • AI fluency: You use AI tools in your day-to-day work to pull and analyze data, draft partner communications, and streamline your own processes.

  • Problem solving: A practical problem-solver who stays calm under pressure and sees problems through to resolution.

  • Relationships: Strong interpersonal skills. You work well with both partners and internal teams.

  • Agency: A high degree of initiative and comfort with ambiguity. This is an early and unstructured role, so you will set your own priorities, work without an established playbook, and build processes where none yet exists.

Even better if you have

  • Industry: Background in data collection, AI training data, or BPO services.

  • Field deployment: Experience with device deployment and inventory tracking across partner sites.

  • Multi-country: Experience running partner operations across several countries and time zones.

  • Languages: Working fluency in one or more of our regionsâ main business languages, alongside professional English.

If you don't check every box above but believe you can do the job, we encourage you to apply â we're looking for capability and trajectory, not a perfect checklist match.

We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, we will partner with you to meet your needs.

We may use AI-assisted tools to help evaluate applications against the requirements of this role. These tools support our recruiting team in identifying qualified candidates but do not replace human judgment or limit which applications may be reviewed or considered.

jobs.title: Scientific Account Executive
jobs.description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments.

We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.

We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.

Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.

Weâre growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.

About the role

This is a hybrid sales and customer success role for someone with real scientific depth. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers â from first conversation through ongoing engagement. That means understanding what a protein design team is actually trying to achieve, helping them pick the right assays, making sure their experiments are set up correctly, and translating results back into language that's useful for their programs.

The day-to-day:

  • Running technical sales calls where you discuss binding kinetics, expression systems, and assay design, not just pricing

  • Onboarding new customers and helping them design their first experiments on the platform

  • Monitoring ongoing accounts, flagging issues early, and proactively suggesting next steps based on their results

  • Working with the biology team to troubleshoot when a customer's experiment doesn't go as expected

  • Identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts â new targets, new assay types, larger campaigns

You won't be handed a script. You'll need to understand the science well enough to earn trust from PhD-level protein engineers and CSOs, while also being commercially sharp enough to close deals and grow accounts.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full customer lifecycle: prospecting, technical sales conversations, deal closing, onboarding, and ongoing account management.

  • Serve as the technical point of contact for customers. Understand their protein engineering goals and recommend the right experiments (binding, expression, thermostability, enzyme activity).

  • Understand and explain our assay capabilities in depth: BLI, SPR, cell-free expression, and emerging assay types. Know when each is appropriate and what the data means.

  • Work closely with the biology team to ensure experiments are designed correctly and results are communicated clearly.

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of commercial opportunities across customer segments: AI-driven protein design companies, biotech startups, pharma R&D teams, and academic labs.

  • Develop proposals and quotes tailored to customer needs, from small pilot experiments to large-scale data generation campaigns.

  • Represent Adaptyv at conferences and industry events. Be able to have deep technical conversations at the booth, not just hand out brochures.

  • Feed customer insights back to the product and biology teams: what assays are people asking for, what's missing, where are we losing deals.

What we're looking for

  • Scientific background in protein engineering, biochemistry, biophysics, or a related field. You should be comfortable discussing binding kinetics (KD, kon, koff), expression systems, and assay design without needing to look things up.

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role: field application scientist, technical sales, scientific account management, or similar. CRO or biotech vendor experience is a strong plus.

  • Commercially driven. You care about revenue, pipeline, and closing deals, not just having interesting scientific conversations.

  • Strong communicator who can adapt to the audience: detailed and technical with a scientist, concise and business-focused with a VP.

  • Self-starter who can manage their own pipeline and priorities without heavy oversight.

  • Genuine interest in AI-driven protein design and the companies working in this space. You follow what's happening in the field.

Application deadline

We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.
